entries.note: H904 points to H903, which gives Persian origin without a lexical meaning.

entries.name: Bigvai
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H902 does not establish in my body. [Strong H902](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/902.htm).

entries.name: Bildad
entries.note: Strong H1085 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: old friendship. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Bileam
entries.displayMeaning: Possibly not of the people; foreigner
entries.note: The place in 1 Chronicles 6:70 shares the form H1109 with Balaam; the derivation is explicitly probable.

entries.name: Bilgah
entries.note: H1083 differs from ancient countenance. [Strong H1083](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1083.htm).

entries.name: Bilhah
entries.note: Bilhah is not automatically Bilhan; H1090 identifies the woman and a place, and derives timid.

entries.name: Bilshan
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Binea
entries.note: H1150 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H1150](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1150.htm).

entries.name: Binnui
entries.note: Strong H1131 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: building. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Birsha
entries.note: H1306 marks the derivation probable; son who beholds is not supplied. A name proposal is not a character verdict.

entries.name: Bishlam
entries.note: H1312 does not establish in peace. [Strong H1312](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1312.htm).

entries.name: Bithiah
entries.note: Strong H1332 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: daughter of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Bithron
entries.note: H1338 derives from cutting; divisions is broadly related but less precise.

entries.name: Bithynia
entries.note: G978 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong G978](https://biblehub.com/greek/978.htm).

entries.name: Bizjothjah
entries.note: Hitchcock's despite is an older contempt sense; Strong additionally preserves the Jah element. The word is a place-name (Joshua 15:28).

entries.name: Blastus
entries.note: G986's relation to G985 is expressly tentative.

entries.name: Boanerges
entries.note: Mark 3:17 explicitly interprets the epithet; G993 gives sons of commotion. It applies to James and John together. [Strong G993](https://biblehub.com/greek/993.htm).

entries.name: Boaz
entries.note: Strong expressly gives an unused root of uncertain meaning. In strength is not corroborated by that entry; person and temple-pillar usages must be distinguished.

entries.name: Bocheru
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Bochim
entries.note: Judges 2:5 and H1066 support weeping; mulberry-trees is unsupported here. [Strong H1066](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1066.htm).

entries.name: Bohan
entries.note: Strong H932 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: in them. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Boskath
entries.note: No KJV references supplied for this spelling; H1218 does not propose poverty.

entries.name: Boson
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference or exact Strong identification for Boson.

entries.name: Bozez
entries.note: Strong H949 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: mud; bog. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Bozrah
entries.note: H1224 is the place-name entry; H1223 supplies its common-noun base.

entries.name: Bukki
entries.note: H1231 is related to emptying but does not simply gloss the name void. [Strong H1231](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1231.htm).

entries.name: Bukkiah
entries.note: Strong H1232 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the dissipation of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Bul
entries.note: H945 selects the rain sense; 1 Kings 6:38 identifies a month, not a person.

entries.name: Bunah
entries.note: H946 supports understanding, not building. [Strong H946](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/946.htm).

entries.name: Bunni
entries.note: Strong supports the building root but not Hitchcock's possessive me.

entries.name: Buz
entries.note: H938 refers to H937 disrespect; despised agrees, plundered is not separately supported.

entries.name: Buzi
entries.note: H941 points to the gentilic H940, not specifically my contempt. [Strong H941](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/941.htm).

entries.name: Cabbon
entries.note: Strong H3522 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: as though understanding. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Cabul
entries.note: H3521 proposes sterility/limitation rather than dirty. 1 Kings 9:13 supplies the naming context.

entries.name: Cain
entries.displayMeaning: Genesis wordplay: acquired; Strong: related to lance
entries.note: Genesis 4:1 gives the acquisition wordplay; H7014 points to H7013 lance while noting affinity with H7069 acquire. Preserve Scripture and keep the town/tribal uses distinct. [Strong H7014](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7014.htm); [Strong G2535](https://biblehub.com/greek/2535.htm).

entries.name: Cainan
entries.note: Strong's proposed fixed differs from possessor/purchaser; Greek Cainan identifies two patriarchs, requiring Luke 3:36,37 context.

entries.name: Caiphas
entries.note: The input misspelling Caiphas likely targets Caiaphas G2533, which gives dell; identity/spelling needs review before canonical linking.

entries.name: Calah
entries.note: H3625 points to H3624 maturity, not favorable/opportunity. [Strong H3625](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3625.htm).

entries.name: Calcol
entries.note: Strong H3633 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: nourishing. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Caleb
entries.note: H3612 explicitly offers alternatives; crow and basket are unsupported.

entries.name: Caleb-Ephratah
entries.note: 1 Chronicles 2:24 in the local KJV witness reads Caleb-ephratah. No exact compound entry is supplied in the pinned dictionaries; the Hitchcock cross-reference to Ephratah alone does not establish the full compound's etymology.

entries.name: Calneh
entries.note: Strong H3641 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: our consummation. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Calno
entries.note: H3641 includes Calno/Calneh, but gives foreign origin without an English meaning.

entries.name: Calvary
entries.note: Luke 23:33 uses the translated place designation; G2898 is also a common noun. [Strong G2898](https://biblehub.com/greek/2898.htm).

entries.name: Camon
entries.note: Strong H7056 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: his resurrection. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Cana
entries.note: G2580 compares Kanah H7071 (reediness); zeal/jealousy/possession are uncorroborated.

entries.name: Canaan
entries.note: H3667 supports the low/humbled association; merchant is a secondary usage elsewhere, not its explicit proper-name gloss. [Strong H3667](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3667.htm).

entries.name: Candace
entries.note: Acts 8:27 calls Candace queen of the Ethiopians; Strong's Egyptian queen label is not the KJV wording. Contrition is not established.

entries.name: Capernaum
entries.note: G2584 probably combines village H3723 and Nahum H5151; comfort is a further name association, repentance is unsubstantiated.

entries.name: Caphtor
entries.note: H3731 points to H3730 knop/chaplet; hand is unsupported. [Strong H3731](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3731.htm).

entries.name: Cappadocia
entries.note: Strong does not equate Cappadocia with Caphtor; geographical identity needs separate evidence.

entries.name: Carcas
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Careah
entries.note: H7143 supports bald, not ice. [Strong H7143](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7143.htm).

entries.name: Carmel
entries.note: Strong supports fruitful-field/produce senses; circumcised lamb is not established. Hill and town are distinct uses.

entries.name: Carmi
entries.note: H3756 derives from vineyard but does not parse the name as lamb of waters.

entries.name: Carpus
entries.note: G2591 only tentatively relates Carpus to G2590 fruit. [Strong G2591](https://biblehub.com/greek/2591.htm).

entries.name: Carshena
entries.note: Strong H3771 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a lamb; sleeping. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Casiphia
entries.note: H3703's derivation is explicitly tentative; covetousness is not supported.

entries.name: Casluhim
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign people-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H3695 does not establish hopes of life. [Strong H3695](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3695.htm).

entries.name: Cedron
entries.note: G2748 identifies Cedron with Hebrew Kidron; black is a close lexical proposal, sad is not independently established.

entries.name: Cenchrea
entries.note: G2747 explicitly gives a probable millet derivation for the Corinthian port; the digital KJV field spells Cencrea. Small pulse is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Cephas
entries.note: John 1:42 expressly applies the surname to Simon Peter. [Strong G2786](https://biblehub.com/greek/2786.htm).

entries.name: Cesar
entries.note: The input spelling Cesar is not the KJV ligature Caesar entry; G2541 gives Latin origin, not a birth-by-incision derivation.

entries.name: Chalcol
entries.note: Core nourishment broadly agrees; consumes the whole is not established.

entries.name: Chaldea
entries.displayMeaning: land of the Chaldaeans; people associated with Kesed
entries.note: H3778 supplies an ethnonym, not demons or robbers. Do not impose an insulting gloss on an entire people from an uncorroborated proposal. [Strong H3778](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3778.htm).

entries.name: Charchemish
entries.note: H3751 identifies Carchemish (2 Chronicles 35:20), not exact Charchemish. It gives foreign derivation; lamb/withdrawn are not established.

entries.name: Charran
entries.note: G5488 points to Haran H2771; singing/calling is a different derivation.

entries.name: Chebar
entries.note: H3529 differs from force/strength. [Strong H3529](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3529.htm).

entries.name: Chedorlaomer
entries.note: Strong supplies foreign origin, not sheaf. Genesis 14:1 calls him king of Elam; early Persian king is Strong's historical label, not the verse wording.

entries.name: Chelal
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Chelluh
entries.note: H3622 differs from all. [Strong H3622](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3622.htm).

entries.name: Chelub
entries.note: Strong H3620, H3619 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a basket. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Chelubai
entries.note: H3621 points to H3612, whose alternatives are dog or forcible; Hitchcock's phrase is unsupported.

entries.name: Chemarims
entries.note: H3649 describes a priestly class in Zephaniah 1:4; black ones is not Strong's gloss and this is not a personal name. [Strong H3649](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3649.htm).

entries.name: Chemosh
entries.note: Strong H3645 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: handling; stroking; taking away. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Chenaanah
entries.note: H3668 is the feminine of H3667; broken in pieces is not its supplied derivation.

entries.name: Chenani
entries.note: H3662 differs from my pillar. [Strong H3662](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3662.htm).

entries.name: Chenaniah
entries.note: Strong H3663 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: preparation, or disposition, or strength, of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Chephirah
entries.note: H3716 explicitly selects village for the place name, despite the similar lion word.

entries.name: Cheran
entries.note: H3763 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H3763](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3763.htm).

entries.name: Cherethims
entries.note: An ethnic/guard designation, not a single man's name; Ezekiel 25:16 uses the collective Cherethims. Strong's cut-root proposal is probable.

entries.name: Cherith
entries.note: Cutting agrees; slaying is not a moral or biographical claim about the brook.

entries.name: Chesed
entries.note: H3777 explicitly marks the root's meaning uncertain; devil/destroyer is uncorroborated. [Strong H3777](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3777.htm).

entries.name: Chesil
entries.note: Strong H3686, H3684 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: foolishness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Chesulloth
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Chidon
entries.note: H3592 points to H3591, applied to the threshing-floor location. [Strong H3592](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3592.htm).

entries.name: Chiliab
entries.note: H3609 corresponds to KJV Chileab (2 Samuel 3:3), not the Hitchcock spelling Chiliab; Strong's proposed restraint conflicts with perfection.

entries.name: Chilion
entries.note: H3630 points to H3631; complete/perfect is not its supplied sense.

entries.name: Chilmad
entries.note: H3638 does not establish teaching/learning. [Strong H3638](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3638.htm).

entries.name: Chimham
entries.note: Strong H3643 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: as they; like to them. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Chios
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Chisleu
entries.note: H3691 does not establish rashness/confidence. [Strong H3691](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3691.htm).

entries.name: Chislon
entries.note: Strong H3692 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: hope, trust. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Chisloth-tabor
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Chittem
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference for Chittem; H3794 records Chittim/Kittim, a people-name, not a bruisers/gold gloss.

entries.name: Chloe
entries.note: Strong G5514 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: green herb. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Chorazin
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Chozeba
entries.note: H3578 is digitally rendered Choseba but identifies the Cozeba place-name of 1 Chronicles 4:22; liers in wait is not its gloss. [Strong H3578](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3578.htm).

entries.name: Christ
entries.note: This is the title of Jesus as the Christ (Matthew 1:16), not an unrelated ordinary personal name. The lexical proposal does not reduce His identity to a dictionary definition.

entries.name: Chun
entries.note: H3560's derivation is probable, though making ready is related.

entries.name: Chushan-rishathaim
entries.note: H3573 supports the second component; blackness is not given as the meaning of Cushan. This remains an attributed lexical proposal. [Strong H3573](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3573.htm).

entries.name: Chuza
entries.note: Strong G5529 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the seer or prophet. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Cilicia
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Cis
entries.note: G2797 explicitly identifies the Greek Cis with Kish. [Strong G2797](https://biblehub.com/greek/2797.htm).

entries.name: Clauda
entries.note: Strong G2802 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a lamentable voice. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Claudia
entries.note: G2803/G2804 establish the relationship and Latin origin; they do not supply lame as the etymology.

entries.name: Clement
entries.note: The pinned Strong G2815 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G2815](https://biblehub.com/greek/2815.htm).

entries.name: Cleophas
entries.note: Strong derives Cleophas from the Chaldee corresponding to H256, brother of father; it does not give the whole glory. Do not confuse John 19:25's Cleophas with Luke 24:18's Cleopas solely by spelling.

entries.name: Cnidus
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Colhozeh
entries.note: H3626 supports every seer; Nehemiah 3:15 and 11:5 directly attest the joined KJV spelling Colhozeh. [Strong H3626](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3626.htm).

entries.name: Colosse
entries.note: Strong G2857 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: punishment; correction. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Coniah
entries.note: H3659 points to Jeconiah H3204, not a strength root.

entries.name: Coos
entries.note: G2972's KJV field says Cos; Acts 21:1 supplies Coos. Top/summit is unestablished. [Strong G2972](https://biblehub.com/greek/2972.htm).

entries.name: Corinth
entries.note: Strong G2882 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: which is satisfied; ornament; beauty. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Cornelius
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Cosam
entries.note: G2973 compares H7081 divination, rather than giving an independently certain etymology. [Strong G2973](https://biblehub.com/greek/2973.htm).

entries.name: Coz
entries.note: H6976 uses Koz/Hakkoz for this name family; 1 Chronicles 4:8 prints Coz. The name is related to H6975, thorn.

entries.name: Cozbi
entries.note: This is a lexical proposal, not a general character judgment based on names.

entries.name: Crescens
entries.note: The pinned Strong G2913 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G2913](https://biblehub.com/greek/2913.htm).

entries.name: Crete
entries.note: G2912 is a Cretan inhabitant, not an independent etymology for Crete; carnal/fleshly is unestablished.

entries.name: Crispus
entries.note: G2921 gives crisp as its Latin name gloss.

entries.name: Cush
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H3568 includes Ham's son, people/territory and another bearer; blackness is not supplied as its etymology. [Strong H3568](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3568.htm).

entries.name: Cuth
entries.note: Strong H3575 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: Cuthah, burning. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Cyprus
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Cyrene
entries.note: G2957 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong G2957](https://biblehub.com/greek/2957.htm).

entries.name: Cyrenius
entries.note: Strong G2958 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: who governs. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Cyrus
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Dabareh
entries.displayMeaning: perhaps related to word or pasture
entries.note: H1705 offers a tentative connection, not all four historical glosses. [Strong H1705](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1705.htm).

entries.name: Dabbasheth
entries.note: H1708 Dabbesheth corresponds to Joshua 19:11; it relates to H1707, hump, not flowing honey.

entries.name: Daberath
entries.note: H1705 tentatively refers to H1697/H1699; Hitchcock supplies only a cross-reference.

entries.name: Dagon
entries.note: H1712 supports fish, not corn; its cultic etymology remains attributed. [Strong H1712](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1712.htm).

entries.name: Dalaiah
entries.note: Strong H1806 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the poor of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Dalmanutha
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Dalmatia
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign region-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: G1149 does not establish deceitful lamps/vain brightness. [Strong G1149](https://biblehub.com/greek/1149.htm).

entries.name: Dalphon
entries.note: Strong H1813 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the house of caves. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Damaris
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Damascus
entries.note: H1834 and G1154 identify Damascus without establishing blood/burning compounds. [Strong H1834](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1834.htm); [Strong G1154](https://biblehub.com/greek/1154.htm).

entries.name: Dan
entries.note: H1835 identifies Dan, the son, tribe, territory and city; its KJV field Daniel is a digital error. Genesis 30:6 expressly links the son's name with judgment.

entries.name: Daniel
entries.note: H1840/G1158 are Daniel; H1835 is Dan, a component rather than an additional Daniel identity. God my judge reverses Strong's relation.

entries.name: Dannah
entries.note: H1837 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H1837](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1837.htm).

entries.name: Darah
entries.displayMeaning: Possible Dara form; related to Darda
entries.note: H1873 probably contracts Darda, whose H1862 gloss is pearl of knowledge. The input Darah has no supplied exact KJV occurrence; generation/house of shepherd is unestablished.

entries.name: Darda
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Darius
entries.displayMeaning: Persian royal designation; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H1867/H1868 call Darius a title used by several kings; do not identify all references as one man or assert Hitchcock's informs himself. [Strong H1867](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1867.htm); [Strong H1868](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1868.htm).

entries.name: Darkon
entries.note: Strong H1874 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: of generation; of possession. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Dathan
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: David
entries.note: H1732 derives from love; Hitchcock's beloved/dear is compatible but not an exact grammatical equivalent. [Strong H1732](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1732.htm); [Strong G1138](https://biblehub.com/greek/1138.htm).

entries.name: Debir
entries.note: H1688 relates Debir to sanctuary/oracle; Joshua 13:26 is separately treated under H3810 Lo-debar, pastureless. King, towns and boundary reading must not be flattened to orator.

entries.name: Deborah
entries.note: H1683 points to H1682; bee agrees, word/thing are not separate name meanings.

entries.name: Decapolis
entries.note: The pinned Strong G1179 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G1179](https://biblehub.com/greek/1179.htm).

entries.name: Dedan
entries.note: Strong does not establish breasts/friendship/judge. Its two Cushites label is unreliable for Genesis 25:3, whose Dedan descends from Abraham through Jokshan, unlike Genesis 10:7.

entries.name: Dedanim
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Dekar
entries.note: H1857 differs from force. [Strong H1857](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1857.htm).

entries.name: Delaiah
entries.note: Strong H1806 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the poor of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Delilah
entries.note: Strong does not supply a hair-related derivation.

entries.name: Demas
entries.note: G1214 refers to G1216, associated with Ceres; popular is not established. The name's background does not define the Christian's faith. [Strong G1214](https://biblehub.com/greek/1214.htm).

entries.name: Demetrius
entries.note: Strong associates the personal name with the pagan deity Ceres. Acts 19:24's silversmith and 3 John 12's Demetrius must be distinguished.

entries.name: Derbe
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Deuel
entries.note: H1845 differs in grammatical relationship from knowledge of God. [Strong H1845](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1845.htm).

entries.name: Deuteronomy
entries.note: A biblical book title, not a person/place name in the supplied occurrences; no corresponding Strong headword supplied to establish its historical title derivation.

entries.name: Diana
entries.note: G735 concerns Greek Artemis, translated Diana by KJV; Strong's probable Greek proposal does not establish the etymology of the Latin name Diana.

entries.name: Diblaim
entries.note: H1691 gives two cakes from H1690 fig-cake, not a fresh cluster. [Strong H1691](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1691.htm).

entries.name: Diblath
entries.note: Strong proposes an orthographical error for Riblah, not dried-fig paste; Ezekiel 6:14 is a textual place-name question and remains unresolved.

entries.name: Dibon
entries.note: H1769 covers several places named Dibon; abundance of knowledge is unsupported.

entries.name: Dibon-gad
entries.note: H1769 explicitly includes Dibon-gad with Gad added; great understanding/abundance of sons is unsupported. [Strong H1769](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1769.htm).

entries.name: Dibri
entries.note: Strong H1704 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: an orator. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Dibzahab
entries.note: Dibzahab is an unlocated form of supplied cross-reference Dizahab H1774; verify spelling before canonical inclusion.

entries.name: Didymus
entries.note: John 11:16 identifies Thomas called Didymus. [Strong G1324](https://biblehub.com/greek/1324.htm).

entries.name: Diklah
entries.note: Genesis 10:27 lists Diklah among Joktan's descendants; Strong's region label is a historical association, not the complete KJV identity.

entries.name: Dilean
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Dimon
entries.note: H1775 offers only a tentative relationship to Dibon; where it is red is unestablished. [Strong H1775](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1775.htm).

entries.name: Dimonah
entries.note: Strong relates Dimonah to Dimon but does not establish dunghill.

entries.name: Dinah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Dinhabah
entries.note: H1838 identifies Dinhabah through lemma/transliteration, though its digital KJV field misspells Dinhaban; it explicitly gives uncertain derivation. [Strong H1838](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1838.htm).

entries.name: Dionysius
entries.note: Strong derives from Bacchus and glosses reveller; divinely touched is Hitchcock's different formulation, not biblical characterization of this convert.

entries.name: Diotrephes
entries.note: The pagan theophoric element is lexical history, not Christian endorsement; Strong's opponent label is commentary.

entries.name: Dishan
entries.note: H1789 refers to H1787/H1788 Dishon, not threshing; do not collapse the Edomite bearers solely from spelling similarity. [Strong H1789](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1789.htm).

entries.name: Dishon
entries.note: H1787 relates Dishon to H1788, an antelope. H1789 has KJV Dishan and is not an independent proof of fatness or ashes.

entries.name: Dodai
entries.note: The love sense agrees; Dodanim is not established as the same individual/name by H1737.

entries.name: Dodavah
entries.note: H1735 adds the divine-name component absent from the short love gloss. [Strong H1735](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1735.htm).

entries.name: Dodo
entries.note: Strong H1734 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: his uncle. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Doeg
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Dophkah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H1850 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H1850](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1850.htm).

entries.name: Dor
entries.note: Strong supports habitation, not an independently established generation sense for this place.

entries.name: Dorcas
entries.note: Acts 9:36 explicitly supplies the Tabitha/Dorcas translation; species wording is approximate.

entries.name: Dothan
entries.note: H1886 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H1886](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1886.htm).

entries.name: Drusilla
entries.note: Strong gives the Roman name relationship; watered by dew is unestablished.

entries.name: Dumali
entries.note: No candidate or KJV occurrence supplied; spelling requires source review.

entries.name: Dura
entries.note: H1757 identifies a Babylonian location; Hitchcock's same as Dor obscures the distinct place and form. [Strong H1757](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1757.htm).

entries.name: Ebal
entries.note: Strong gives a probable bald/bare root, not ancient heaps. Genesis 36:23 also uses Ebal as a personal name, although this source description only mentions the mountain.

entries.name: Ebed
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Ebed-melech
entries.note: The pinned Strong H5663 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H5663](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5663.htm).

entries.name: Eben-ezer
entries.note: Strong H72 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the stone of help. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eber
entries.note: H5677 points to H5676 across/beyond; passing is related, anger is unsupported.

entries.name: Ebiasaph
entries.note: H43 contracts H23; adding is a loose expansion of gathering. [Strong H43](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/43.htm).

entries.name: Ebronah
entries.note: Strong's related Ebron gives transitional; being angry is not established. The place occurs in Numbers 33:34.

entries.name: Ecclesiastes
entries.note: Book title rather than a personal name in the supplied KJV corpus; no verse reference supplied.

entries.name: Ed
entries.note: Joshua 22:34 supplies the altar designation Ed, corresponding to H5707 witness. Reject unrelated candidates caused by English inflection fragments such as -ed. [Strong H5707](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5707.htm).

entries.name: Eden
entries.note: Two Hebrew entries distinguish the Mesopotamian Eden from the region of Adam's home. Shared English spelling is not proof of geographical identity.

entries.name: Eder
entries.note: H5740 covers a person and places; distinguish the identities in context.

entries.name: Edom
entries.note: H123 and Genesis 25:30 support red; earthy/of blood is an expansion. Esau, his descendants and territory are distinct referents. [Strong H123](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/123.htm).

entries.name: Edrei
entries.note: Strong H154 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a very great mass, or cloud. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eglah
entries.note: H5698 supports heifer; chariot/round are not separate supported name meanings.

entries.name: Eglaim
entries.note: H97 differs from drops of the sea. [Strong H97](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/97.htm).

entries.name: Eglon
entries.note: Strong gives vituline, calf-like; Hitchcock's cross-reference to Eglah alone does not supply a meaning and should not merge their identities.

entries.name: Egypt
entries.note: H4714 refers to Upper/Lower Egypt through H4693 boundary/fortification; G125 explicitly has uncertain derivation. English Egypt should not be parsed as Hebrew.

entries.name: Ehud
entries.note: Both H164 and H261 give united, not praises; the spelling covers distinct bearers. [Strong H164](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/164.htm); [Strong H261](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/261.htm).

entries.name: Eker
entries.note: Strong H6134, H6133 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: barren, feeble. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ekron
entries.note: Torn away broadly agrees; barrenness is not independently supplied.

entries.name: El-beth-el
entries.note: Genesis 35:7 applies it to the consecrated place. [Strong H416](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/416.htm).

entries.name: El-elohe-Israel
entries.note: Genesis 33:20 names Jacob's altar El-elohe-Israel. Strong's the mighty god if Jisrael has an obvious transcription error; retain KJV spelling and divine capitalization.

entries.name: Eladah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Elah
entries.note: H414/H425 identify oak-derived names, not curse/perjury. The place and men with this spelling remain distinct. [Strong H414](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/414.htm); [Strong H425](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/425.htm).

entries.name: Elam
entries.note: Strong H5867 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a young man; a virgin; a secret. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Elasah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Elath
entries.note: H359 gives trees/grove, not hind or strength. [Strong H359](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/359.htm).

entries.name: Eldaah
entries.note: Strong H420 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: knowledge of God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eldad
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Elead
entries.note: The pinned Strong H496 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H496](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/496.htm).

entries.name: Elealeh
entries.note: Strong H500 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: burnt-offering of God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eleazar
entries.note: Help agrees; court of God is not corroborated.

entries.name: Eleph
entries.note: H507 points to H505 thousand, not learning. [Strong H507](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/507.htm).

entries.name: Elhanan
entries.note: H445 identifies Elchanan, despite its mistaken KJV-field Elkanan; 2 Samuel 21:19 and 23:24 contain Elhanan. Keep the verse's identity wording distinct from etymology.

entries.name: Eli
entries.displayMeaning: Priest Eli: lofty; spoken Eli: my God
entries.note: H5941 is the priest; G2241 is a first-person invocation in Matthew 27:46, not another person's name. Keep the Hebrew words distinct.

entries.name: Eliab
entries.note: H446 differs in grammatical relationship from God is my father. [Strong H446](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/446.htm).

entries.name: Eliada
entries.note: Strong H450 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: knowledge of God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eliah
entries.note: H452's stated relation differs from Hitchcock's compressed wording; lexical comparison does not adjudicate theology.

entries.name: Eliahba
entries.note: H455 spells it Eliahbah; the KJV references identify the same warrior. Do not confuse with Eliab and its father component. [Strong H455](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/455.htm).

entries.name: Eliakim
entries.note: Strong gives raising; resurrection is a more specific theological claim than this compound establishes.

entries.name: Eliam
entries.note: Hitchcock reverses the people/God relation given in H463.

entries.name: Elias
entries.note: G2243 explicitly equates Elias with Elijah H452; this name link does not make every narrative identification literal identity. [Strong G2243](https://biblehub.com/greek/2243.htm).

entries.name: Eliasaph
entries.note: Strong H460 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the Lord increaseth. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eliashib
entries.note: H475 proposes restoration rather than an abstract God of conversion.

entries.name: Eliathah
entries.note: H448 differs from thou art my God. [Strong H448](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/448.htm).

entries.name: Elidad
entries.note: Strong H449 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: beloved of God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eliel
entries.note: H447 repeats El and interprets the grammatical relation differently from Hitchcock.

entries.name: Elienai
entries.displayMeaning: towards Jehovah are my eyes (probable fuller form)
entries.note: H462 probably contracts H454; God of my eyes differs from that proposed construction. [Strong H462](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/462.htm).

entries.name: Eliezer
entries.note: Help is supported; court is not established by these entries.

entries.name: Elihoreph
entries.note: H456 specifies autumn, not youth; winter is only a related seasonal word.

entries.name: Elihu
entries.note: H453's literal component relation differs from he is my God; several bearers are listed. [Strong H453](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/453.htm).

entries.name: Elijah
entries.note: Strong preserves the El and Jah elements. A lexical compound alone does not constitute a separate doctrinal argument.

entries.name: Elika
entries.note: H470 derives the second element from rejection, not pelican.

entries.name: Elim
entries.note: H362 selects the palm-tree sense for the place, not rams/stags. [Strong H362](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/362.htm).

entries.name: Elimelech
entries.note: Strong phrases this God of the king, whereas Hitchcock gives my God is king. Retain the grammatical disagreement as attributed lexical interpretation.

entries.name: Elioenai
entries.note: No exact candidate supplied for this spelling; do not choose between eyes and fountains without a matched lemma.

entries.name: Eliphal
entries.note: H465 differs from miracle of God. [Strong H465](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/465.htm).

entries.name: Eliphalet
entries.note: Strong H467 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the God of deliverance. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eliphaz
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Elisabeth
entries.note: G1665 refers to H472 Elisheba; oath is supported, fullness is not its stated sense. [Strong G1665](https://biblehub.com/greek/1665.htm).

entries.name: Elisha
entries.note: Strong derives Elisha from H474, God of supplication (or riches), rather than explicitly salvation. This is a disagreement between dictionaries; do not claim this establishes the only correct etymology.

entries.name: Elishah
entries.note: Do not conflate Elishah with Elisha or infer a help/lamb derivation.

entries.name: Elishama
entries.note: The pinned Strong H476 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H476](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/476.htm).

entries.name: Elishaphat
entries.note: Strong H478 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: my God judgeth. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Elisheba
entries.note: H472 supplies this proposal; Hitchcock only redirects to Elisabeth without giving the meaning here.

entries.name: Elishua
entries.note: H474 differs from salvation. [Strong H474](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/474.htm).

entries.name: Eliud
entries.note: Strong G1664 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: God is my praise. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Elizur
entries.note: Rock is shared, but God is my strength/rock of God reverse or paraphrase Strong's construction.

entries.name: Elkanah
entries.note: H511 differs from zeal/zealous. [Strong H511](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/511.htm).

entries.name: Elkeshai
entries.note: H512 identifies the Elkoshite designation (Nahum 1:1), with an underlying name of uncertain derivation. The input Elkeshai is not an exact KJV spelling; rigor/strength is unestablished.

entries.name: Elkoshite
entries.displayMeaning: Native of Elkosh; place derivation uncertain
entries.note: An ethnic/geographical adjective, not a distinct personal name.

entries.name: Ellasar
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign country-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H495 does not establish revolting from God. [Strong H495](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/495.htm).

entries.name: Elmodam
entries.note: G1678 only suggests perhaps H486, which itself is probably foreign; God of measure/garment is not established.

entries.name: Elnaam
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Elnathan
entries.note: The pinned Strong H494 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H494](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/494.htm).

entries.name: Elohi
entries.note: Elohim is a Hebrew word commonly rendered God, not an independently attested English KJV personal name Elohi here. Distinguish the referent and context before importing a name record.

entries.name: Elon
entries.note: Oak/grove agrees; strong is not independently given as the name meaning. People and place remain distinct.

entries.name: Elon-beth-hanan
entries.displayMeaning: oak-grove of the house of favor
entries.note: H358 includes the oak-grove component omitted by Hitchcock. [Strong H358](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/358.htm).

entries.name: Elpaal
entries.note: Strong H508 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: God's work. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Elpalet
entries.note: Hitchcock provides only a spelling cross-reference; H467 gives the lexical proposal.

entries.name: Eltekeh
entries.note: H514 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H514](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/514.htm).

entries.name: Elteketh
entries.note: H514 identifies Eltekeh/Elteke (Joshua 19:44); it explicitly leaves the derivation uncertain. The exact Elteketh spelling is not established.

entries.name: Eltolad
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Elul
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign month-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H435 does not establish cry/outcry. [Strong H435](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/435.htm).

entries.name: Eluzai
entries.note: Strong H498 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: God is my strength. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Elymas
entries.note: Acts 13:8 explicitly calls Elymas a name interpreted as sorcerer. G1681 supplies foreign origin and wizard as the referent, without a root derivation; do not classify the biblical name merely as a non-name title. Corrupter is uncorroborated.

entries.name: Elzabad
entries.note: H443 supports a divine bestowal; dowry is a narrower historical gloss. [Strong H443](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/443.htm).

entries.name: Elzaphan
entries.note: Strong H469 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: God of the northeast wind. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Emims
entries.note: A people designation, not one person's name; generic people is not the lexical meaning.

entries.name: Emmanuel
entries.note: Matthew 1:23 explicitly interprets Emmanuel, a name of Christ. [Strong G1694](https://biblehub.com/greek/1694.htm).

entries.name: Emmaus
entries.note: Strong compares the Hebrew warm-spring word; people despised/obscure is a competing gloss, and the derivation is explicitly probable.

entries.name: Emmor
entries.note: G1697 refers to Hamor H2544; archaic ass here means the animal.

entries.name: En-dor
entries.note: H5874 supports the habitation sense; supplied En-dor references are empty, and the eye/generation alternatives need qualification. [Strong H5874](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5874.htm).

entries.name: En-eglaim
entries.note: Strong H5882 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: eye, or fountain, of calves. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: En-gannim
entries.note: Gardens agrees; protection is not independently given in H5873.

entries.name: En-gedi
entries.note: H5872 supports goat/kid, not happiness. [Strong H5872](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5872.htm).

entries.name: En-haddah
entries.note: Strong H5876 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: quick sight; well of gladness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: En-hakkore
entries.note: H5875 supplies the compound; Judges 15:19 explicitly associates the name with Samson calling. The digital KJV field is En-hakhore.

entries.name: En-hazor
entries.note: H5877 differs from grass of the well. [Strong H5877](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5877.htm).

entries.name: En-mishpat
entries.note: Strong H5880 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fountain of judgment. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: En-rimmon
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: En-rogel
entries.note: H5883 differs from fuller's fountain or well of searching. [Strong H5883](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5883.htm).

entries.name: En-shemesh
entries.note: Strong H5885 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fountain, or eye, of the sun. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: En-tappuah
entries.note: Apple agrees; inflation is unsupported as a second place-name meaning.

entries.name: Enam
entries.note: H5879 identifies Enam in Joshua 15:34 and gives a double fountain; open place is not its stated proper-name sense. [Strong H5879](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5879.htm).

entries.name: Enan
entries.note: Strong H5881 relates Enan to eye, not cloud; Numbers 1:15 identifies Ahira's father.

entries.name: Eneas
entries.note: G132 identifies KJV Aeneas (input Eneas) but gives uncertain derivation, not laudable.

entries.name: Enoch
entries.note: H2585/G1802 support the dedicated sense. Genesis 4:17 and Genesis 5:18 concern different men; the city is another referent. [Strong H2585](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2585.htm); [Strong G1802](https://biblehub.com/greek/1802.htm).

entries.name: Enon
entries.note: The transcription uses AEnon ligature (John 3:23) and incorrectly links G5869; the Hebrew eye/spring word is H5869. Cloud/darkness is not established.

entries.name: Enos
entries.note: H583 points to H582; mortal man agrees, while the additional adjectives are not established name senses.

entries.name: Epaphras
entries.displayMeaning: shortened form of Epaphroditus; associated with Aphrodite
entries.note: G1889 refers to G1891, devoted to Venus; covered with foam is not its stated derivation. This background does not define the Christian's allegiance. [Strong G1889](https://biblehub.com/greek/1889.htm).

entries.name: Epaphroditus
entries.note: Strong's derivation uses devoted to Venus, not simply handsome; the name's pagan linguistic origin is not a claim about the Christian's allegiance.

entries.name: Epenetus
entries.note: G1866 matches the historical spelling but the input has no supplied KJV references.

entries.name: Eph-lal
entries.note: H654 supports judging; supplied Eph-lal has no KJV reference to validate its hyphenated spelling. [Strong H654](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/654.htm).

entries.name: Ephah
entries.note: The proper name is linked to H5890 (darkness), distinct from the common ephah measure.

entries.name: Epher
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Ephes-dammim
entries.note: H658 differs from effusion of blood. [Strong H658](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/658.htm).

entries.name: Ephesus
entries.note: Strong G2181 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: desirable. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Ephphatha
entries.note: Mark 7:34 explicitly translates the spoken command; it is not a personal name.

entries.name: Ephraim
entries.note: H669 identifies Joseph's son, tribe and territory; G2187 may instead correspond to H6085 for the town in John 11:54. Do not force a single Hebrew derivation on all uses. [Strong H669](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/669.htm); [Strong G2187](https://biblehub.com/greek/2187.htm).

entries.name: Ephratah
entries.note: A woman (1 Chronicles 2:19) and the Bethlehem designation share the form. Strong's place-only description must not erase the woman.

entries.name: Ephron
entries.note: H6085 covers a person and places; do not derive this from the similar dust word.

entries.name: Epicurean
entries.note: G1946 is a school designation, not a personal name. Acts 17:18 has Epicureans; the singular supplied spelling has no references, and the founder-name etymology is only a comparison. [Strong G1946](https://biblehub.com/greek/1946.htm).

entries.name: Er
entries.note: The English name is shared by distinct people; Genesis 38:3's Er must not be merged with Luke 3:28's ancestor.

entries.name: Eran
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Erastus
entries.note: The pinned Strong G2037 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G2037](https://biblehub.com/greek/2037.htm).

entries.name: Erech
entries.note: Length is supported; health and physic are not established.

entries.name: Eri
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Esaias
entries.note: G2268 equates the Greek form with Isaiah H3470. [Strong G2268](https://biblehub.com/greek/2268.htm).

entries.name: Esar-haddon
entries.note: Strong H634 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that closes the point; joy; cheerfulness. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Esau
entries.note: H6215 proposes rough from handling; acts/finishes is not its selected sense.

entries.name: Esek
entries.note: Genesis 26:20 explains the name through contention. [Strong H6230](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6230.htm).

entries.name: Esh-baal
entries.note: Strong H792 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the fire of the idol, or of the ruler. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Esh-ban
entries.note: H790 does not propose fire of the sun; input spelling has no supplied KJV references.

entries.name: Eshcol
entries.note: H812 points to H811. Genesis 14 concerns the man; Numbers 13 the valley. [Strong H812](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/812.htm).

entries.name: Eshean
entries.note: Strong H824 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: held up. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eshek
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Eshkalon
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference for Eshkalon; H831 Ashkelon/Askalon is a possible alias requiring confirmation.

entries.name: Eshtaol
entries.note: Strong H847 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a strong woman. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eshtemoa
entries.note: H851 relates the name to hearing/obedience; woman's bosom is unsupported.

entries.name: Esli
entries.displayMeaning: probably towards Jehovah are my eyes (Hebrew comparison)
entries.note: G2069 probably refers to H454; near me/separates is not established. [Strong G2069](https://biblehub.com/greek/2069.htm).

entries.name: Esmachiah
entries.displayMeaning: Possible Ismachiah form; Jah will sustain
entries.note: H3253 identifies Ismachiah in 2 Chronicles 31:13, not exact Esmachiah; its sustain sense differs from joined. Preserve the spelling uncertainty.

entries.name: Esrom
entries.note: G2074 refers to Hezron H2696, not darts or songs.

entries.name: Esther
entries.note: H635 gives Persian origin; secret/hidden remains an attributed historical proposal. [Strong H635](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/635.htm).

entries.name: Etam
entries.note: Strong supports a bird connection but not their covering. Distinguish the rock (Judges 15) and towns by verse context.

entries.name: Etham
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Ethan
entries.note: H387 supports strength/endurance broadly, not gift of the island. [Strong H387](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/387.htm).

entries.name: Ethanim
entries.note: KJV 1 Kings 8:2 names a month; strong/valiant reflects the related root without Strong's specific month gloss.

entries.name: Ethbaal
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Ether
entries.note: H6281 differs from talk. [Strong H6281](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6281.htm).

entries.name: Ethiopia
entries.note: Strong's Hebrew headword is Cush; a territory translation Ethiopia is not proof that all bearers of Cush share the same identity or that blackness is the established etymology.

entries.name: Ethnan
entries.note: H869 refers to H868 in the sense of H867; gift is a broad equivalent.

entries.name: Ethni
entries.note: H867 differs from strong and marks the derivation tentative. [Strong H867](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/867.htm).

entries.name: Eubulus
entries.note: Strong G2103 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: prudent; good counselor. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eunice
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Euodias
entries.note: G2136 differs from sweet scent; Philippians 4:2 names the Christian woman. [Strong G2136](https://biblehub.com/greek/2136.htm).

entries.name: Euphrates
entries.note: Strong H6578, G2166 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that makes fruitful. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Eutychus
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Eve
entries.note: Genesis 3:20 explicitly connects Eve with mother of all living. [Strong H2332](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2332.htm); [Strong G2096](https://biblehub.com/greek/2096.htm).

entries.name: Evi
entries.note: Strong H189 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: unjust. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Evil-merodach
entries.note: H192 proposes an Aramaic derivation, not Hebrew evil/fool; the English spelling is not an English moral adjective.

entries.name: Exodus
entries.note: No supplied verse identifies Exodus as a personal/place name; distinguish the English book title from named biblical entities.

entries.name: Ezbon
entries.note: Strong H675 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: hastening to understand. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Ezekiel
entries.note: Strength is shared; Strong supplies a verbal construction.

entries.name: Ezel
entries.note: H237 applies the designation to a memorial stone. [Strong H237](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/237.htm).

entries.name: Ezem
entries.note: Strong H6107 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a bone. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ezer
entries.displayMeaning: Edomite Ezer: treasure; Israelite Ezer: help
entries.note: The candidate list supplied only H687 (Edomite). Later references concern H5827/H5829 with help; merging all as help loses a distinct name.

entries.name: Ezion-geber
entries.note: H6100 differs from wood of the man. [Strong H6100](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6100.htm).

entries.name: Ezra
entries.note: Aid/help is supported by H5833; court is not established. Distinguish Ezra in 1 Chronicles 4:17 from the priest/scribe.

entries.name: Ezri
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Felix
entries.note: The pinned Strong G5344 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G5344](https://biblehub.com/greek/5344.htm).

entries.name: Festus
entries.note: Strong G5347 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: festive, joyful. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Fortunatus
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Gaal
entries.note: H1603 is compatible with contempt/abomination without making it a biographical verdict. [Strong H1603](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1603.htm).

entries.name: Gaash
entries.note: Strong H1608 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: tempest; commotion. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gabbai
entries.note: H1373 derives from the root of back H1354 but gives collective as the name proposal, not simply back.

entries.name: Gabbatha
entries.note: John 19:13 identifies the place of the judgment seat. [Strong G1042](https://biblehub.com/greek/1042.htm).

entries.name: Gabriel
entries.note: H1403 gives man of God, not God is my strength; its KJV field Garbriel is misspelt. Daniel 8:16 and Luke 1:19 identify the angel; archangel is The pinned transcription's classification, not an explicit title there.

entries.name: Gad
entries.note: Genesis 30:11 supplies the naming association; distinguish Jacob's son/tribe from the prophet.

entries.name: Gadarenes
entries.note: G1046 identifies a people by their town; surrounded/walled is not established by the Greek entry. [Strong G1046](https://biblehub.com/greek/1046.htm).

entries.name: Gaddi
entries.note: Strong makes Gaddi an intensive of Gadi, fortunate; my troop/kid is not its actual gloss.

entries.name: Gaddiel
entries.note: H1427 does not contain a goat element.

entries.name: Gaius
entries.displayMeaning: Latin personal name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: G1050 does not establish lord/earthly man; the supplied references concern distinct bearers. [Strong G1050](https://biblehub.com/greek/1050.htm).

entries.name: Galal
entries.note: Strong H1559 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a roll, a wheel. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Galatia
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Galeed
entries.note: Genesis 31:47–48 also explicitly explains the memorial. [Strong H1567](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1567.htm).

entries.name: Galilee
entries.note: Strong uses a geographical circuit/circle sense; wheel/revolution are root associations, not the actual regional gloss.

entries.name: Gallim
entries.note: H1554 selects springs for this place name.

entries.name: Gallio
entries.note: G1058 does not establish sucks/lives on milk. [Strong G1058](https://biblehub.com/greek/1058.htm).

entries.name: Gamaliel
entries.note: Recompense is supported; camel is not established as the actual compound gloss. Numbers 1:10 and Acts 5:34 refer to different men.

entries.name: Gammadims
entries.note: H1575 gives warrior as the lexical proposal; dwarfs is a different historical interpretation.

entries.name: Gamul
entries.note: Use H1577 for the man in 1 Chronicles 24:17. H1014 belongs to the compound place Beth-gamul, a spurious candidate for this row. [Strong H1577](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1577.htm).

entries.name: Gareb
entries.note: Strong H1619 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a scab. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Garmites
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for the plural form.

entries.name: Gatam
entries.note: H1609 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H1609](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1609.htm).

entries.name: Gath
entries.note: Strong H1661, H1660 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a wine-press. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gath-rimmon
entries.note: H1667 gives a pomegranate component rather than high.

entries.name: Gaza
entries.note: H5804 supports strong, not goat. [Strong H5804](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5804.htm); [Strong G1048](https://biblehub.com/greek/1048.htm).

entries.name: Gazabar
entries.note: Gazabar corresponds to a common office word, not an English KJV personal name; Ezra 1:8 and 7:21 use treasurer/treasurers.

entries.name: Gazer
entries.note: H1507 points to H1506; dividing is related, sentence is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Gazez
entries.note: H1495 differs from passing over; two men may share the name. [Strong H1495](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1495.htm).

entries.name: Gazzam
entries.note: Strong H1502 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the fleece of them. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Geba
entries.note: H1387 supplies hillock; cup belongs to the related common-noun entry and is not the selected place sense.

entries.name: Gebal
entries.note: H1380/H1381 name different regions (Phoenicia and Idumaea); bound/limit is a different derivational emphasis. [Strong H1380](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1380.htm); [Strong H1381](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1381.htm).

entries.name: Geber
entries.note: Strong H1398, H1397 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: manly, strong. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gebim
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Gedaliah
entries.note: H1436 differs from God is my greatness, though sharing greatness/divine-name components. [Strong H1436](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1436.htm).

entries.name: Geder
entries.note: Geder is a particular place (Joshua 12:13); the similar Gederah and Gederoth spellings are separate entries/locations, not automatically interchangeable entities.

entries.name: Gederothaim
entries.note: Hedges broadly agrees with the enclosure sense; Strong specifies a dual form.

entries.name: Gehazi
entries.note: H1522 tentatively derives the name, broadly compatible with sight. [Strong H1522](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1522.htm).

entries.name: Geliloth
entries.note: Strong H1553 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: rolling, wheel, heap. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gemalli
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Gemariah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H1587 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H1587](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1587.htm).

entries.name: Genesis
entries.note: The book-title use is distinct from the Greek common noun G1078 (nativity/nature); a Strong word match does not make a Bible book title a person/place.

entries.name: Gennesaret
entries.note: G1082 compares Kinnereth H3672; garden of the prince is not corroborated.

entries.name: Genubath
entries.note: The pinned Strong H1592 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H1592](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1592.htm).

entries.name: Gera
entries.note: Strong H1617 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: pilgrimage, combat; dispute. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gerar
entries.note: H1642 supplies a probable derivation; Hitchcock's Gera cross-reference does not establish it.

entries.name: Gergesenes
entries.note: G1086 connects the form to Girgashites H1622, not pilgrimage/fight. [Strong G1086](https://biblehub.com/greek/1086.htm).

entries.name: Gerizim
entries.note: Strong H1630 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: cutters, hatchets. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gershom
entries.note: H1647/H1648 propose refugee. Exodus 2:22 explicitly explains Moses' naming with being a stranger in a strange land; preserve the scriptural explanation separately from lexicography.

entries.name: Gershon
entries.note: H1648 supports banishment/refugee, not change of pilgrimage. [Strong H1648](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1648.htm).

entries.name: Geshur
entries.note: Strong H1650 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: Geshuri, sight of the valley; a walled valley. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gether
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Gethsemane
entries.note: G1068 differs from plentiful valley. [Strong G1068](https://biblehub.com/greek/1068.htm).

entries.name: Geuel
entries.note: Strong H1345 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: God's redemption. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gezer
entries.note: H1507 points to H1506; dividing broadly agrees, sentence not independently supported.

entries.name: Giah
entries.note: H1520 differs from guide/draw out/groan. [Strong H1520](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1520.htm).

entries.name: Gibbar
entries.note: Strong treats Gibbar as intensive of the man/strength word; Ezra 2:20 identifies the family ancestor.

entries.name: Gibbethon
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Gibeah
entries.note: H1387/H1388/H1390 include variant and distinct town forms; do not merge every Gibeah into one location. [Strong H1387](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1387.htm); [Strong H1388](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1388.htm); [Strong H1390](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1390.htm).

entries.name: Gibeon
entries.note: Hill is supported; cup and thing lifted up are not established by this derivation.

entries.name: Giddel
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Gideon
entries.note: H1439 gives the cutting-down sense, compatible with breaking/destroying as a lexical proposal. [Strong H1439](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1439.htm).

entries.name: Gideoni
entries.note: Strong compares Gideon but gives Gideoni its own derivation and sense. The name does not identify the father in Numbers 1:11 as Gideon.

entries.name: Gihon
entries.note: H1521 covers the Eden river and a Jerusalem water feature; valley of grace is unsupported.

entries.name: Gilalai
entries.note: H1562 differs from wheel; retain the disagreement as an attributed lexical proposal, not a judgment about the bearer. [Strong H1562](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1562.htm).

entries.name: Gilboa
entries.note: Strong H1533 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: revolution of inquiry. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gilead
entries.note: H1568 marks the relation to Galeed H1567 probable; Genesis 31 supplies a naming association.

entries.name: Gilgal
entries.note: H1537 points to H1536 wheel; Joshua 5:9 also explains rolling away. H1019 denotes the larger compound Beth-gilgal, not every Gilgal. [Strong H1537](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1537.htm).

entries.name: Giloh
entries.note: Strong H1542 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: he that rejoices; he that overturns. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gimzo
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Ginath
entries.note: H1527 explicitly marks derivation uncertain; the cross-reference to Ginnetho should not erase this. [Strong H1527](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1527.htm).

entries.name: Girgashite
entries.note: A tribal designation, not one person's name; Strong expressly leaves the underlying name's derivation uncertain.

entries.name: Gispa
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Gittah-hepher
entries.note: H1662's digital KJV field has Gittah-kephr, but the lemma includes Gittah-hepher; Joshua 19:13 anchors the spelling. [Strong H1662](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1662.htm).

entries.name: Gittaim
entries.note: Strong H1664 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a wine-press. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Gittites
entries.note: H1663 is an inhabitant adjective, not one person's name; winepress is a further etymology of Gath.

entries.name: Goath
entries.note: H1601 supports an animal-cry sense; touching is unsupported. [Strong H1601](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1601.htm).

entries.name: Gob
entries.note: Cistern broadly accords with pit; grasshopper is not established by this entry.

entries.name: Gog
entries.note: H1463/G1136's identifications and eschatological comments are commentary, not a lexical derivation or a settled interpretation of Revelation.

entries.name: Golan
entries.note: H1474 differs from passage/revolution. [Strong H1474](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1474.htm).

entries.name: Golgotha
entries.note: Matthew 27:33 explicitly explains place of a skull; neither a heap of multiple skulls nor a physical skull-shaped hill is established by the verse or the bare lexical meaning.

entries.name: Goliath
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Gomer
entries.note: H1586 includes Japheth's son/people and Hosea's wife; keep them distinct. [Strong H1586](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1586.htm).

entries.name: Gomorrah
entries.note: Strong H6017 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: rebellious people. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Goshen
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Gozan
entries.note: H1470 differs from fleece/pasture/nourishing. [Strong H1470](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1470.htm).

entries.name: Gudgodah
entries.note: Strong H1412 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: happiness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Guni
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Gur
entries.note: The pinned Strong H1483 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H1483](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1483.htm).

entries.name: Gur-baal
entries.note: Strong H1485 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the governor's whelp. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Haahashtari
entries.note: No exact candidate supplied; 1 Chronicles 4:6 grounds the personal-name context.

entries.name: Habaiah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H2252 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H2252](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2252.htm).

entries.name: Habakkuk
entries.note: Strong supports embrace; wrestler is not an independent lexical gloss in the entry.

entries.name: Habazinaiah
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this form.

entries.name: Habor
entries.note: H2249 supports a joining/companion association, though its name gloss is united. [Strong H2249](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2249.htm).

entries.name: Hachaliah
entries.note: Strong H2446 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: who waits for the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hachilah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hachmoni
entries.note: The pinned Strong H2453 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H2453](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2453.htm).

entries.name: Hadad
entries.displayMeaning: Foreign royal name; or fierce (different forms)
entries.note: H1908 covers Edomite royal/deity usages with foreign origin; H2301 identifies an Ishmaelite and gives fierce. The English spelling must not collapse these forms.

entries.name: Hadadezer
entries.note: H1909 contains the proper name Hadad, not beauty.

entries.name: Hadadrimmon
entries.note: H1910 names a place and retains the two component names; invocation is not stated as its literal meaning. [Strong H1910](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1910.htm).

entries.name: Hadar
entries.note: Genesis 36:39's Edomite name relates to splendor (H1924); Genesis 25:15's Ishmaelite form relates to chamber (H2316). One gloss cannot govern both.

entries.name: Hadarezer
entries.note: H1928 relates this spelling to Hadadezer H1909; Hitchcock only provides a cross-reference.

entries.name: Hadashah
entries.note: H2322 does not give news or month for this place. [Strong H2322](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2322.htm).

entries.name: Hadassah
entries.note: Myrtle is supported; joy is not established. Esther 2:7 identifies Hadassah as Esther.

entries.name: Hadid
entries.note: Sharp broadly agrees; rejoicing is not supplied.

entries.name: Hadlai
entries.note: The pinned Strong H2311 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H2311](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2311.htm).

entries.name: Hadoram
entries.note: Strong H1913 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: their beauty; their power. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Hadrach
entries.note: H2317 calls Hadrach a Syrian deity; Zechariah 9:1 speaks of the land of Hadrach. Dictionary identification should not override verse wording.

entries.name: Hagab
entries.note: The pinned Strong H2285 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H2285](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2285.htm).

entries.name: Hagar
entries.note: Strong H1904, G28 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a stranger; one that fears. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Haggai
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Haggeri
entries.displayMeaning: Hagrite; member of an Arabian clan
entries.note: H1905 only tentatively connects to Hagar; it does not equate Haggeri with Haggi. [Strong H1905](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1905.htm).

entries.name: Haggiah
entries.note: Strong H2293 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the Lord's feast. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Haggith
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Hakkatan
entries.note: The pinned Strong H6997 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H6997](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6997.htm).

entries.name: Hakkoz
entries.note: Strong supports thorn and includes the article in Hakkoz; summer and end are not established.

entries.name: Hakupha
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Halah
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign region-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H2477 does not establish moist table. [Strong H2477](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2477.htm).

entries.name: Halak
entries.note: Strong H2510 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: part. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Halhul
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hali
entries.note: H2482 points to H2481; sickness/beginning is not the selected place-name sense. [Strong H2482](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2482.htm).

entries.name: Hallelujah
entries.note: A Hebrew praise formula, not a personal name; Psalm 148:1 translates Praise ye the LORD rather than printing Hallelujah.

entries.name: Halloesh
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Ham
entries.displayMeaning: Noah's son: hot; region Ham: uncertain
entries.note: H2526 supplies hot for Noah's son and his descendants; H1990 is a different region with uncertain derivation (Genesis 14:5). Brown is not established. [Strong H1990](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1990.htm); [Strong H2526](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2526.htm).

entries.name: Haman
entries.note: Strong H2001 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: noise; tumult. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Hamath
entries.note: Wall agrees; anger/heat are not the supplied name derivation.

entries.name: Hamath-zobah
entries.note: H2578 retains place-name components; H2574 walled and H6678 station do not yield heat of an army. [Strong H2578](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2578.htm).

entries.name: Hammedatha
entries.note: The KJV form Hammedatha corresponds to Strong's Medatha spelling; troubles the law is not established.

entries.name: Hammelech
entries.note: Jeremiah's Hammelech may represent the definite phrase the king; the candidate H4429 Melek is not automatically this form. H4428 is the common noun king, not counselor.

entries.name: Hammon
entries.note: H2540 supports warmth, not sun. [Strong H2540](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2540.htm).

entries.name: Hamon-gog
entries.note: H1996's KJV field Hamogog is misspelt; Ezekiel 39:11,15 print Hamon-gog. Retain the biblical place designation without importing the source's fanciful adjective.

entries.name: Hamonah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Hamor
entries.note: H2544 supports ass/donkey, not clay/dirt. [Strong H2544](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2544.htm).

entries.name: Hamoth
entries.note: No exact name headword or defensible alias was established in the supplied Strong snapshot. Hitchcock: indignation. Keep this name and gloss unresolved; do not guess from a similar spelling.

entries.name: Hamul
entries.note: Merciful/pitied share the pity sense; godly is not independently established.

entries.name: Hamutal
entries.note: H2537 differs from shadow of his heat. [Strong H2537](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2537.htm).

entries.name: Hanameel
