entries.note: Strong treats Hanameel as probably an orthographic variant of Hananeel, whose sense is God has favored; the probability should remain visible.

entries.name: Hanan
entries.note: H2605's digital KJV field has Canan, explaining the missed exact match; the lemma and identity represent Hanan.

entries.name: Hananeel
entries.note: H2606 describes the man for whom Jerusalem's tower was probably named; the cited verses name the tower. [Strong H2606](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2606.htm).

entries.name: Hanani
entries.note: Strong supports grace but not Hitchcock's possessive my.

entries.name: Hananiah
entries.note: Grace/favor broadly agrees; gift is not a separate derivation. Multiple people share this name; Daniel 1:7 establishes one Hananiah's Shadrach alias.

entries.name: Hanes
entries.note: H2609 does not establish banishment of grace. [Strong H2609](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2609.htm).

entries.name: Haniel
entries.note: Haniel (1 Chronicles 7:39) corresponds to the Hanniel name; H2592 identifies two Israelites. Do not infer that Numbers 34:23 names the same man.

entries.name: Hannah
entries.note: Gracious agrees; he that gives is not independently supplied by H2584.

entries.name: Hannathon
entries.note: The pinned Strong H2615 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H2615](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2615.htm).

entries.name: Hanniel
entries.note: Strong H2592 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: grace or mercy of God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hanoch
entries.note: Hanoch is associated with H2585 Enoch; this digital entry lists only the antediluvian patriarch, so it does not by itself establish each KJV Hanoch identity.

entries.name: Hanun
entries.note: H2586 shares the grace/favor sense; the Ammonite king and Israelite bearers are distinct. [Strong H2586](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2586.htm).

entries.name: Hapharaim
entries.note: H2663 uses Haphraim; Joshua 19:19's Hapharaim spelling is a variant. Strong gives double pit rather than searching.

entries.name: Hara
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Haradah
entries.note: H2732 points to H2731 fear; well is not a component of this name. [Strong H2732](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2732.htm).

entries.name: Haran
entries.note: Strong distinguishes Hebrew forms: H2039 mountaineer and H2771 parched. Haran the person and Haran the location also need contextual separation.

entries.name: Harbonah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hareph
entries.note: H2780 supports reproach, not winter. [Strong H2780](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2780.htm).

entries.name: Harhaiah
entries.note: Strong gives fearing Jah although its linked H2734 is normally an anger root; the internal inconsistency requires original-edition checking, not a confident choice between sources.

entries.name: Harhas
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Harhur
entries.note: H2744 supports a heat association. [Strong H2744](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2744.htm).

entries.name: Harim
entries.note: Strong H2766 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: destroyed; dedicated to God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Harnepher
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Harod
entries.note: Judges 7:1 names the well of Harod; H5878 gives the complete compound fountain of trembling. [Strong H5878](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5878.htm).

entries.name: Harosheth
entries.note: Workmanship is supported by H2799; forest/agriculture/deafness/silence are not all established as the place-name's meaning.

entries.name: Harran
entries.note: Cross-reference spelling Harran lacks a supplied verse or exact candidate; see Charran without assuming canonical spelling.

entries.name: Harsha
entries.note: H2797 differs from workmanship/wood. Preserve the attribution without deriving a biography from the gloss. [Strong H2797](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2797.htm).

entries.name: Harum
entries.note: High is supported; throwing down is not established.

entries.name: Harumaph
entries.note: H2739 supplies this anatomical proposal, not destruction; no judgment of a person is implied.

entries.name: Haruphite
entries.note: H2741 is a gentilic, not a man named slender/sharp. [Strong H2741](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2741.htm).

entries.name: Haruz
entries.note: Strong H2743 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: careful. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hasadiah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Hashabiah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H2811 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H2811](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2811.htm).

entries.name: Hashabnah
entries.note: H2812 is Hashabnah; Hashabniah is a separate form (H2813), so the cross-reference alone must not merge their senses or people.

entries.name: Hashem
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hashub
entries.note: H2815 differs from esteemed/numbered. [Strong H2815](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2815.htm).

entries.name: Hashubah
entries.note: Strong H2807 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: estimation; thought. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hashum
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hashupha
entries.note: H2817 differs from spent/made base. [Strong H2817](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2817.htm).

entries.name: Hasrah
entries.note: Strong H2641 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: wanting. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hatach
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hathath
entries.note: H2867's digital KJV field is corrupted (cathath. f); lemma and 1 Chronicles 4:13 identify Hathath, referring to H2866. [Strong H2867](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2867.htm).

entries.name: Hatita
entries.note: Strong H2410 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a bending of sin. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hattil
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hattipha
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference or exact Hattipha entry; H2412 Hatipha gives robber, but the spelling link is unconfirmed.

entries.name: Hattush
entries.note: Strong H2407 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: forsaking sin. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Hauran
entries.note: Hole is related; liberty/whiteness are not independent selected name senses.

entries.name: Havilah
entries.note: H2341 differs from pain/bringing forth; names regions and possibly men, requiring contextual distinctions. [Strong H2341](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2341.htm).

entries.name: Havoth-jair
entries.note: Strong preserves Jair as a personal name; villages that enlighten replaces the compound's owner with an inferred root meaning.

entries.name: Hazael
entries.note: Hitchcock reverses who sees whom in H2371's proposal.

entries.name: Hazaiah
entries.note: H2382 differs in subject from seeing the Lord. [Strong H2382](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2382.htm).

entries.name: Hazar-addar
entries.note: Strong H2692 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: an imprisoned generation. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hazar-hatticon
entries.note: Middle village agrees; preparation is not corroborated.

entries.name: Hazar-shual
entries.note: H2705 differs from wolf's house. [Strong H2705](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2705.htm).

entries.name: Hazar-susah
entries.note: Strong H2701 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: or susim, the hay-paunch of a horse. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hazarenan
entries.note: No KJV refs supplied for this unhyphenated spelling; cloud/imprisonment is unsupported.

entries.name: Hazargaddah
entries.note: H2693 differs from imprisoned band; no supplied reference validates the joined spelling. [Strong H2693](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2693.htm).

entries.name: Hazarmaveth
entries.note: Genesis 10:26 lists Hazarmaveth among Joktan's descendants; Strong's place description reflects the regional association, not a reason to omit the personal occurrence.

entries.name: Hazelelponi
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hazeroth
entries.note: H2698 supports villages loosely; palaces is an expansion. [Strong H2698](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2698.htm).

entries.name: Hazezon-tamar
entries.displayMeaning: Division; perhaps row of palm trees
entries.note: Strong H2688 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: drawing near to bitterness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hazo
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Hazor
entries.note: H2674 supports settlement, not hay. H2675 is the compound Hazor-hadattah, not an identical simple-name candidate. [Strong H2674](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2674.htm).

entries.name: Heber
entries.note: Hebrew Heber H2268 has community; NT Heber (Luke 3:35) represents Eber H5677. Do not collapse two source forms into one etymology or identity.

entries.name: Hebrews
entries.note: H5680 supplies the ethnic adjective; it is not a separate person's name.

entries.name: Hebron
entries.note: H2275 names both the town and different men. [Strong H2275](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2275.htm).

entries.name: Hegai
entries.note: Strong H1896 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: or Hege, meditation; word; groaning; separation. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Helam
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Helbah
entries.note: H2462 identifies Helbah in Judges 1:31; H2463 is Helbon, a distinct Syrian place. Shared root does not identify the two locations. [Strong H2462](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2462.htm).

entries.name: Heldai
entries.note: World is supported; rustiness is not established. Similar Heleb and Heled forms require separate variant/identity review.

entries.name: Helek
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Helem
entries.note: H1987 differs from dreaming/healing. [Strong H1987](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1987.htm).

entries.name: Heleph
entries.note: Strong H2501 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: changing; passing over. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Helez
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Heli
entries.note: G2242 points to H5941; the man in Luke 3:23 is distinct from the high priest Eli. [Strong G2242](https://biblehub.com/greek/2242.htm).

entries.name: Helkai
entries.note: Strong gives apportioned; Hitchcock's bare same as Helek is not enough to validate a lexical equivalence or personal identity.

entries.name: Helkath-hazzurim
entries.note: H2521's selected construction differs from field of strong men.

entries.name: Helon
entries.note: H2497 differs from window/grief. [Strong H2497](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2497.htm).

entries.name: Heman
entries.note: Strong H1968 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: their trouble; tumult; much; in great number. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hen
entries.note: H2581 identifies a figurative personal designation; quiet/rest is not separately supplied.

entries.name: Hena
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign place-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H2012 does not establish troubling. [Strong H2012](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2012.htm).

entries.name: Henadad
entries.note: Strong H2582 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: grace of the beloved. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Henoch
entries.note: H2585 is the Enoch form represented by 1 Chronicles 1:3 Henoch; Hitchcock gives a spelling cross-reference.

entries.name: Hepher
entries.note: H2660 relates to digging/shame but differs from digger; men and a location share the spelling. [Strong H2660](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2660.htm).

entries.name: Hephzibah
entries.note: Isaiah 62:4 uses the symbolic designation; 2 Kings 21:1 also names Hephzi-bah, Hezekiah's wife. The source's fanciful name label must not erase the KJV person or determine biblical interpretation.

entries.name: Heres
entries.note: The Hitchcock phrase the son may be a textual error, but it is not silently corrected to sun; H2776 supplies shining.

entries.name: Heresh
entries.note: H2792 points to H2791, not carpenter. [Strong H2792](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2792.htm).

entries.name: Hermas
entries.note: Strong proposes the Hermes relationship, not gain/refuge. Romans 16:14's Hermas and 16:14's Hermes are separately named people.

entries.name: Hermogenes
entries.note: Mercury is the corresponding Latin deity name; Strong's apostate label is commentary rather than etymology.

entries.name: Hermon
entries.note: H2768 differs from anathema/devoted to destruction. [Strong H2768](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2768.htm).

entries.name: Herod
entries.note: Strong gives heroic, not specifically son of a hero; several rulers named Herod require KJV-context separation.

entries.name: Herodion
entries.note: G2267 derives from Herod G2264, not Juno or song.

entries.name: Heshbon
entries.note: H2809 points to H2808; invention is related, industry not its stated gloss. [Strong H2809](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2809.htm).

entries.name: Heshmon
entries.note: Strong H2829 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a hasty messenger. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Heth
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Hethlon
entries.note: H2855 differs from fearful dwelling. [Strong H2855](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2855.htm).

entries.name: Hezekiah
entries.note: Strong gives the same sense for both forms; H3169's cross-reference H3388 is a digital inconsistency, since its printed strengthened root is not Jerusha.

entries.name: Hezer
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this form.

entries.name: Hezrai
entries.note: H2695 differs from entry/vestibule. [Strong H2695](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2695.htm).

entries.name: Hezron
entries.note: Strong H2696 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the dart of joy; the division of the song. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hiddai
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hiddekel
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign river-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H2313 identifies the Tigris without establishing sharp voice/sound. [Strong H2313](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2313.htm).

entries.name: Hiel
entries.note: Strong H2419 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: God lives; the life of God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hierapolis
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Higgaion
entries.note: H1902 is a term/notation in Psalm 9:16, with meditation-related usage, not a person's name. [Strong H1902](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1902.htm).

entries.name: Hilen
entries.note: Strong H2432 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a window; grief. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hilkiah
entries.note: H2518's digital KJV field misspells Hillkiah. The relation differs from God is my portion.

entries.name: Hillel
entries.note: The pinned Strong H1985 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H1985](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1985.htm).

entries.name: Hinnom
entries.note: Strong H2011 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: there they are; their riches. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Hirah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hiram
entries.note: H2438 refers to H2361, not exaltation of life/destroyer. The Tyrian king and craftsman are distinct men. [Strong H2438](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2438.htm).

entries.name: Hittite
entries.note: A patronymic ethnic name; H2845 gives Heth as terror. Broken/fearing are proposed root associations, not the explicit meaning of Hittite in this entry.

entries.name: Hivites
entries.note: H2340 proposes villagers for this people designation; wickedness is not corroborated.

entries.name: Hizkijah
entries.note: H2396 covers several men; Nehemiah 10:17 does not refer to the king merely because the name shares his form. [Strong H2396](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2396.htm).

entries.name: Hobab
entries.note: Numbers 10:29 explicitly calls Hobab the son of Raguel; Strong's father-in-law label intersects a kinship/translation question and must not override the verse.

entries.name: Hobah
entries.note: Secrecy loosely agrees; love/friendship is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Hod
entries.note: H1936 points to H1935, not confession. [Strong H1936](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1936.htm).

entries.name: Hodaiah
entries.note: Strong H1939, H1938 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the praise of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hodaviah
entries.note: H1938 is Hodaviah; Hitchcock's series of cross-references is not a reliable merger of every Hodiah/Hodijah form.

entries.name: Hodesh
entries.note: H2321 points to H2320, not table/news. [Strong H2321](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2321.htm).

entries.name: Hoglah
entries.note: Strong marks its derivation uncertain and probably partridge, not his festival/dance.

entries.name: Hoham
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Holon
entries.note: H2473 differs from window/grief. [Strong H2473](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2473.htm).

entries.name: Homam
entries.note: H1950 identifies Homam (1 Chronicles 1:39) and points to Hemam as a variant.

entries.name: Hophin
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV occurrence supplied; likely spelling issue requires review.

entries.name: Hor
entries.note: H2023 supports hill/mountain, not conceiving/showing; it lists two distinct peaks. [Strong H2023](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2023.htm).

entries.name: Hor-hagidgad
entries.note: Strong H2735 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the hill of felicity. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Horam
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Horeb
entries.note: The pinned Strong H2722 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H2722](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2722.htm).

entries.name: Horem
entries.note: Strong H2765 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: an offering dedicated to God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hori
entries.note: H2753 refers to H2752, not princely/freeborn.

entries.name: Horims
entries.note: H2752 is a people-name; princes/angry is unsupported. [Strong H2752](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2752.htm).

entries.name: Hormah
entries.note: Numbers 21:3 expressly connects the name with utterly destroying the cities. Strong's short devoted gloss must be read in that context, not only as benign dedication.

entries.name: Horonaim
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Horonites
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference or exact plural candidate for Horonites; do not substitute a different gentilic without evidence.

entries.name: Hosah
entries.note: Strong H2621 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: trusting. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hosanna
entries.note: An acclamation/petition in the Gospel references, not a personal name; no exact candidate supplied.

entries.name: Hosea
entries.note: H1954 covers Hosea/Hoshea forms; the prophet is one of multiple bearers. [Strong H1954](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1954.htm).

entries.name: Hoshaiah
entries.note: Strong H1955 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the salvation of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Hoshama
entries.note: Hearing agrees; Strong supplies an explicit divine subject, not he obeys.

entries.name: Hotham
entries.note: The pinned Strong H2369 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H2369](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2369.htm).

entries.name: Hothir
entries.note: Remaining is supported; excelling is not the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Hukkok
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Hul
entries.note: H2343 differs from pain/infirmity. [Strong H2343](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2343.htm).

entries.name: Huldah
entries.note: Strong relates Huldah to H2467, weasel; world is a competing derivation. An animal-derived name is not a character judgment.

entries.name: Hupham
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Huppim
entries.note: H2650 points to H2646 canopy; sea-shore is unsupported. [Strong H2650](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2650.htm).

entries.name: Hur
entries.note: Strong offers two possible source words; whiteness and hole have support, liberty does not. The etymology cannot be narrowed confidently from this entry.

entries.name: Huram
entries.note: Input includes the Benjaminite in 1 Chronicles 8:5; H2361 covers him, while supplied H2438 is the Hiram variant for Tyrians. Do not collapse identities.

entries.name: Huri
entries.note: H2359 differs from angry and does not equate Huri with Huram. [Strong H2359](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2359.htm).

entries.name: Hushah
entries.note: Haste is supported; holding peace is not established.

entries.name: Hushai
entries.note: Haste agrees; sensuality/silence is not supplied.

entries.name: Hushathite
entries.note: H2843 is a gentilic, distinct from Hushim; haste/silence is not its supplied meaning. [Strong H2843](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2843.htm).

entries.name: Huz
entries.note: KJV Genesis 22:21 prints Huz; H5780 uses Uz and proposes consultation. The headword's brief identity description omits Nahor's son, so spelling alone must not merge all bearers.

entries.name: Huzoth
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this form.

entries.name: Huzzab
entries.note: Nahum 2:7 prints Huzzab in the KJV. H5324 treats the form as stationed/established and says the proper-name reading is a mistake (digitally spelled Huzzah); retain the KJV form and flag the dictionary's interpretation rather than erase it. [Strong H5324](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5324.htm).

entries.name: Hymeneus
entries.note: G5211 prints the ligature form Hymenaeus; 1 Timothy 1:20 and 2 Timothy 2:17 identify the man. A name from a pagan deity is not a claim that its bearer is that deity.

entries.name: Ibhar
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Ibleam
entries.note: H2991 differs from ancient/decreasing people. [Strong H2991](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2991.htm).

entries.name: Ibneiah
entries.note: Strong supports building of Jah, not understanding or adoption as separate derivations. Ibneiah and Ibniah are closely spelled but separately listed persons in 1 Chronicles 9:8.

entries.name: Ibri
entries.note: H5681 points to the ethnic adjective H5680; anger/pregnancy are unsupported.

entries.name: Ibzan
entries.note: H78 differs from father of a target/coldness. [Strong H78](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/78.htm).

entries.name: Ichabod
entries.note: 1 Samuel 4:21 explicitly explains I-chabod through the glory's departure; where is the glory is a related alternative formulation.

entries.name: Iconium
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Idalah
entries.note: H3030 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H3030](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3030.htm).

entries.name: Idbash
entries.note: Honey is supported with uncertainty; land of destruction is not established.

entries.name: Iddo
entries.note: Distinct Hebrew forms H112/H3035/H3260/H5714 share this English spelling; do not assign one gloss to every person.

entries.name: Idumea
entries.note: H123 supports red, not bloody; Idumea is a territorial designation. [Strong H123](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/123.htm).

entries.name: Igal
entries.note: Strong H3008 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: redeemed; defiled. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Igdaliah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Igeal
entries.note: H3008 differs from defiled; redemption is related to the root but not its given name gloss. [Strong H3008](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3008.htm).

entries.name: Iim
entries.note: Strong H5864 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: heaps of Hebrews, or of angry men. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ije-abarim
entries.note: Heaps/passers broadly agrees; Hebrews is not independently established as the whole name meaning.

entries.name: Ijon
entries.note: H5859 differs from eye/fountain. [Strong H5859](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5859.htm).

entries.name: Ikkesh
entries.note: Hitchcock's forward may be a digital error for froward; do not interpret forward as progress. Strong gives perverse.

entries.name: Illyricum
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Imlah
entries.note: H3229 supports fullness, not circumcision. [Strong H3229](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3229.htm).

entries.name: Immanuel
entries.note: Isaiah 7:14 and Matthew 1:23 govern the scriptural identification. The pinned transcription's type name of Isaiah's son is interpretive commentary, not the lexical gloss or a replacement for Matthew's application to Jesus Christ.

entries.name: Immer
entries.note: Speaking agrees; lamb is not the selected name derivation.

entries.name: Imnah
entries.note: H3232 records Imnah/Jimnah spelling forms. [Strong H3232](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3232.htm).

entries.name: Imrah
entries.note: Strong supports the changing/interchange alternative, not all rebel/bitter senses.

entries.name: Imri
entries.note: H566 points to H564; speaking agrees, bitter/lamb/exalting are not independently supplied.

entries.name: India
entries.note: H1912 identifies Hodu as Hindustan; praise/law is unestablished. [Strong H1912](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1912.htm).

entries.name: Iphedeiah
entries.note: Strong H3301 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: redemption of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ir
entries.note: H5893 points to H5892; city agrees, watchman/vision are not separate selected name senses.

entries.name: Ira
entries.note: H5896 supports a watchful association, not making bare/pouring out. [Strong H5896](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5896.htm).

entries.name: Irad
entries.note: Strong H5897 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: wild ass; heap of empire; dragon. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Iram
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Iri
entries.note: H5901 differs from fire/light. [Strong H5901](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5901.htm).

entries.name: Irijah
entries.note: Strong H3376 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the fear of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Irpeel
entries.note: Health/healing agrees; exulting is not independently established.

entries.name: Irshemesh
entries.note: H5905 differs from city of bondage; no supplied reference confirms the joined spelling. [Strong H5905](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5905.htm).

entries.name: Isaac
entries.note: Strong H3327 supplies laughter; Genesis 17:19 and 21:6 connect Isaac with laughter. The source's mochery is a transcription flaw, not a reason to replace the biblical explanation.

entries.name: Isaiah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Iscah
entries.note: H3252 differs from anoints. [Strong H3252](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3252.htm).

entries.name: Iscariot
entries.note: Strong gives a probable geographical epithet for Judas, not murder/hireling as its established derivation.

entries.name: Ish-pan
entries.note: Hide agrees; broken in two is not supplied. No refs supplied for hyphenated spelling.

entries.name: Ish-tob
entries.note: H382 retains Tob as a place-name, whereas Hitchcock reads it adjectivally as good; preserve the distinction. [Strong H382](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/382.htm).

entries.name: Ishbak
entries.note: Strong H3435 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: who is empty or exhausted. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ishbi-benob
entries.note: The name contains the place Nob; respiration/captivity is unsupported by H3430.

entries.name: Ishbosheth
entries.note: H378 supports this lexical sense; 2 Samuel 2:12 and 3:8 directly attest the KJV unhyphenated form Ishbosheth. The name's gloss alone is not a moral judgment. [Strong H378](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/378.htm).

entries.name: Ishi
entries.note: The personal name H3469 has saving; Hosea 2:16's Ishi means my husband, from H376. A single English spelling must retain this word-versus-name distinction.

entries.name: Ishiah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Ishma
entries.note: H3457 supports desolation, not named/marveling. [Strong H3457](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3457.htm).

entries.name: Ishmachiah
entries.displayMeaning: Possible Ismachiah form; Jah will sustain
entries.note: H3253 identifies KJV Ismachiah (2 Chronicles 31:13), not exact Ishmachiah; cleaving is not the stated derivation.

entries.name: Ishmael
entries.note: Genesis 16:11 explicitly associates the naming with the LORD hearing affliction.

entries.name: Ishmaiah
entries.note: H3460 differs in subject from hearing/obeying the Lord. [Strong H3460](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3460.htm).

entries.name: Ishmerai
entries.note: Strong H3461 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: keeper, or keeping. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ishod
entries.note: Comely loosely overlaps honor/renown; not an independent exact etymology.

entries.name: Ishua
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied references or exact entry for Ishua; do not silently equate Ishuah H3438 or Ishuai H3440.

entries.name: Ispah
entries.note: Strong H3472 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a jasper stone. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Israel
entries.displayMeaning: Prevailing with God (Genesis naming); rule as God (Strong)
entries.note: Genesis 32:28 explicitly speaks of power with God and prevailing; H3478's he will rule as God is a different lexical proposal. Keep scriptural explanation and dictionary wording distinct.

entries.name: Issachar
entries.note: Genesis 30:18 explicitly associates the name with hire/reward. [Strong H3485](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3485.htm); [Strong G2466](https://biblehub.com/greek/2466.htm).

entries.name: Isui
entries.note: Strong gives Jishvi/Isui its own level derivation; Hitchcock's equation to Ishuah does not establish identical roots or people.

entries.name: Italy
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Ithai
entries.note: H863 differs from strong/sign/plowshare. [Strong H863](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/863.htm).

entries.name: Ithamar
entries.note: Strong H385 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: island of the palm-tree. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ithiel
entries.note: H384 expressly qualifies the derivation; sign is not separately established.

entries.name: Ithmah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H3495 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H3495](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3495.htm).

entries.name: Ithran
entries.note: Strong H3506 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: remaining; searching out diligently. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ithream
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Ittah-kazin
entries.displayMeaning: time of a judge or prince
entries.note: H6278 supports the title sense, but its digital derivation cites H7011 rather than H7101 magistrate; the original scan requires checking. [Strong H6278](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6278.htm).

entries.name: Iturea
entries.note: G2484 identifies Ituraea with Jetur; the historical geographical name is not established merely as mountainous. Luke 3:1 supplies the KJV occurrence.

entries.name: Ivah
entries.note: H5755 refers to H5754, not iniquity.

entries.name: Izehar
entries.note: Num 3:19's Izehar is the Izhar form H3324, pointing to H3323 oil; clearness is a looser expansion. [Strong H3324](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3324.htm).

entries.name: Izrahiah
entries.note: Strong H3156 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the Lord ariseth; the clearness of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Izri
entries.note: H3339's digital KJV field spells Isri; it is the candidate for the musician in 1 Chronicles 25:11.

entries.name: Jaakan
entries.note: H3292 refers to H6130 Akan, not Achan. Deuteronomy 10:6 has the larger wells-of-the-children-of-Jaakan designation (H885); separate ancestor and compound place. [Strong H3292](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3292.htm); [Strong H885](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/885.htm).

entries.name: Jaakobah
entries.note: Strong derives Jaakobah from Jacob; deceiver is an interpretive characterization beyond the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Jaala
entries.note: H3279 offers relation to H3280 or direct derivation from ascend H3276, so alternatives remain.

entries.name: Jaalam
entries.note: H3281 gives occult or concealed for the Jaalam/Jalam form; young man/heir is not supported. [Strong H3281](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3281.htm).

entries.name: Jaanai
entries.note: Answering is supported; afflicting and making poor are not established.

entries.name: Jaasau
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Jaasiel
entries.note: The pinned Strong H3300 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H3300](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3300.htm).

entries.name: Jaazah
entries.note: No exact name headword or defensible alias was established in the supplied Strong snapshot. Hitchcock: Jaazar, helper. Keep this name and gloss unresolved; do not guess from a similar spelling.

entries.name: Jaazaniah
entries.note: H2970 supplies the hearing/Jah proposal; exact index omitted the name.

entries.name: Jaaziah
entries.note: H3269 supports strength broadly; Jaaziel is a distinct form and should not be silently merged. [Strong H3269](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3269.htm).

entries.name: Jabal
entries.note: Strong H2989, H2988 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: which glides away. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jabbok
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jabesh
entries.note: H3003 gives dry for Jabesh/Jabesh-gilead. H3001's broader root senses explain confusion/shame, but the proper-name gloss is dry. [Strong H3003](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3003.htm).

entries.name: Jabez
entries.note: Strong H3258 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: sorrow; trouble. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jabin
entries.note: Understanding agrees; Jabneh is a different name and building is not a sense of H2985.

entries.name: Jabneel
entries.note: H2995 lists two distinct places. [Strong H2995](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2995.htm).

entries.name: Jachan
entries.note: Strong H3275 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: wearing out; oppressing. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jachin
entries.note: Name also given to a temple pillar; distinguish personal and pillar uses.

entries.name: Jacob
entries.note: Genesis 25:26 and 27:36 supply the heel/supplant wordplay. [Strong H3290](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3290.htm).

entries.name: Jada
entries.note: Strong H3047 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: knowing. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jadau
entries.note: Ezra 10:43 gives a personal-name context, but no exact candidate supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Jaddua
entries.note: H3037 differs in grammatical voice from known. [Strong H3037](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3037.htm).

entries.name: Jael
entries.note: Strong's Jael entry calls a Canaanite, but Judges 4:17 identifies her as the wife of Heber the Kenite; preserve that KJV relation.

entries.name: Jagur
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jah
entries.note: H3050 contracts H3068; Psalm 68:4 expressly prints JAH. This is a divine name, not a created personal bearer. [Strong H3050](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3050.htm).

entries.name: Jahaleel
entries.note: The input Jahaleel lacks an exact supplied KJV occurrence. Jahleel H3177 gives expectant of God; Jehalellel/Jehalelel H3094 gives praising God. Similar spelling alone cannot decide which name Hitchcock intended.

entries.name: Jahath
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jahaz
entries.note: H3096 differs from quarrel/dispute and marks the derivation tentative. [Strong H3096](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3096.htm).

entries.name: Jahaziah
entries.note: Strong H3167 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the vision of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jahaziel
entries.note: Hitchcock reverses the beholder/object relation supplied by H3166.

entries.name: Jahdiel
entries.note: H3164 supports unity, not sharpness/revenge. [Strong H3164](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3164.htm).

entries.name: Jahdo
entries.note: Strong H3163 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: I alone; his joy; his sharpness of wit; his newness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jahleel
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Jahmai
entries.note: The pinned Strong H3181 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H3181](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3181.htm).

entries.name: Jahzeel
entries.note: H3183 explicitly identifies Jahzeel (Genesis 46:24); divideth broadly agrees with allot, hasteth is not established.

entries.name: Jair
entries.note: H2971/H3265 are distinct Hebrew forms sharing Jair in English; Jairus is a related Greek form, not permission to merge every identity.

entries.name: Jakan
entries.note: H3292 gives Jakan/Jaakan forms related to Akan H6130, not Achan H5912. [Strong H3292](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3292.htm).

entries.name: Jakim
entries.note: H3356 explicitly identifies Jakim and gives he will raise; the Compare suffix obscured the exact match.

entries.name: Jalon
entries.note: Tarrying broadly agrees; murmuring is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Jambres
entries.note: G2387 does not establish poverty/bitter/rebel. [Strong G2387](https://biblehub.com/greek/2387.htm).

entries.name: James
entries.note: Strong identifies James as the Greek form of Jacob; this linguistic relationship does not identify all named James with one person.

entries.name: Jamin
entries.note: H3226 points to H3225; south wind is more specific than the entry establishes.

entries.name: Jamlech
entries.note: H3230 supports reigning, not asking counsel. [Strong H3230](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3230.htm).

entries.name: Janna
entries.note: Strong compares a root meaning oppress, not confidently speaks/answers. Janna (Luke 3:24) and Jannes (2 Timothy 3:8) are different names.

entries.name: Janoah
entries.note: Rest agrees; deriving is unsupported.

entries.name: Janum
entries.note: The pinned Strong H3241 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H3241](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3241.htm).

entries.name: Japhet
entries.note: H3315's Japheth is the KJV spelling (Genesis 5:32); enlarged agrees, fair/persuading are not the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Japhia
entries.note: Several people and a place share this form; distinguish identities by context.

entries.name: Japhlet
entries.note: H3310 supports delivery, not banishment. [Strong H3310](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3310.htm).

entries.name: Japho
entries.note: Joshua 19:46 has Japho; H3305's strongs_def identifies Japho although its KJV field prints Japha/Joppa.

entries.name: Jarah
entries.note: H3294 refers to H3295; watching closely is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Jareb
entries.note: H3377 supplies a symbolic Assyrian designation; revenger is a different grammatical/semantic proposal. [Strong H3377](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3377.htm).

entries.name: Jared
entries.note: Coming down agrees; ruling/commanding are not established.

entries.name: Jaresiah
entries.note: H3298 explicitly says the unused root has uncertain meaning.

entries.name: Jarib
entries.note: H3402 points to H3401 adversary; fighting/chiding fits, multiplying is unsupported. [Strong H3402](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3402.htm).

entries.name: Jarmuth
entries.note: Strong H3412 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fearing, or seeing, or throwing down, death. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jarvah
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV occurrence supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Jashem
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference for Jashem; do not silently substitute Jashen H3464.

entries.name: Jasher
entries.note: Joshua 10:13 and 2 Samuel 1:18 refer to the book of Jasher; H3477 is an adjective. The title alone does not establish an author named Jasher.

entries.name: Jashobeam
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jashub
entries.note: H3437 supports return, not controversy/dwelling. [Strong H3437](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3437.htm).

entries.name: Jasiel
entries.note: Strong H3300 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the strength of God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jason
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Jathniel
entries.note: H3496 differs from gift of God. [Strong H3496](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3496.htm).

entries.name: Jattir
entries.note: Strong H3492 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a remnant; excellent. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Javan
entries.note: H3120's lexical proposal is probable. Its digital identification as son of Joktan conflicts with Genesis 10:2 (son of Japheth), so retain KJV identity.

entries.name: Jazeel
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference or exact entry for Jazeel.

entries.name: Jazer
entries.note: Strong H3270 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: assistance; helper. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jaziz
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jearim
entries.note: H3297 supports woods, not leap. H7157 belongs to Kirjath-jearim, a different compound. [Strong H3297](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3297.htm).

entries.name: Jeaterai
entries.note: Strong H2979 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: searching out. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jeberechiah
entries.note: The passive relation differs from speaking well of/kneeling to the Lord.

entries.name: Jebus
entries.note: H2982 supports treading, not manger; Judges 19 identifies the earlier Jerusalem name. [Strong H2982](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2982.htm).

entries.name: Jebusi
entries.note: Jebusi is an ethnic/territorial designation from Jebus; Joshua 18:16,28 require context. Treading/mangers are not its direct lexical gloss.

entries.name: Jecamiah
entries.note: Jecamiah corresponds to Jekamiah H3359; revenge is not supplied by that entry.

entries.name: Jecoliah
entries.note: H3203 supports divine enabling/power, not perfection. [Strong H3203](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3203.htm).

entries.name: Jeconiah
entries.note: H3204 identifies the king Jeconiah; the Compare suffix caused the missing exact candidate.

entries.name: Jedaiah
entries.displayMeaning: Praised of Jah; Jah has known
entries.note: H3042 and H3048 are distinct Hebrew names sharing Jedaiah in English; one gloss cannot be assigned to every reference.

entries.name: Jedeiah
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference or exact entry for Jedeiah; do not conflate Jedaiah or Jedidiah.

entries.name: Jediael
entries.note: Knowledge is supported; science here is an older knowledge sense, not a claim about a modern academic discipline.

entries.name: Jedidah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Jedidiah
entries.note: 2 Samuel 12:25 applies the name to Solomon. [Strong H3041](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3041.htm).

entries.name: Jediel
entries.note: H3043 identifies Jediael, not exact Jediel. Knowledge of God is supported for that proposed alias; renewing is not established.

entries.name: Jeduthun
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jeezer
entries.note: H372 differs from island of help; its first element is interpreted negatively. [Strong H372](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/372.htm).

entries.name: Jegar-sahadutha
entries.note: Strong H3026 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: heap of witness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jehaleleel
entries.note: Jehaleleel corresponds to H3094 Jehallelel; praising God agrees, clearness is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Jehaziel
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference or exact entry establishes Jehaziel; Jahaziel is a possible alias requiring confirmation.

entries.name: Jehdeiah
entries.note: Strong H3165 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: joy together, one Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jeheiel
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this form.

entries.name: Jehezekel
entries.note: H3168 gives the verbal construction. [Strong H3168](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3168.htm).

entries.name: Jehiah
entries.note: Strong H3174 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the Lord liveth. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jehiskiah
entries.note: Likely spelling variant of Jehizkiah H3169; the digital root cross-reference H3388 is anomalous and should not be trusted without checking original printing.

entries.name: Jehoadah
entries.note: H3085 identifies Jehoadah through its lemma/transliteration, while the digital KJV field says Jehoada; testimony/passing over is unsupported. [Strong H3085](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3085.htm).

entries.name: Jehoaddan
entries.note: Pleasure is supported; time is not established.

entries.name: Jehoahaz
entries.note: H3099 points to H3059; the divine-name relation differs from possession of the Lord.

entries.name: Jehoash
entries.note: H3060 itself marks the fire component tentative; two kings share the name. [Strong H3060](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3060.htm).

entries.name: Jehohanan
entries.note: Strong H3076 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: grace, or mercy, or gift, of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jehoiachin
entries.note: H3112 points to H3078; establishment, not simply preparation/strength.

entries.name: Jehoiada
entries.note: H3077 is the Jehoiada entry; H3111 is the shortened Joiada form. Do not replace the direct entry with the related form. [Strong H3077](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3077.htm); [Strong H3111](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3111.htm).

entries.name: Jehoiakim
entries.note: Strong H3079 supports establishing/raising, not necessarily avenging or bodily resurrection.

entries.name: Jehoiarib
entries.note: H3080 supplies contending; multiplying is not corroborated.

entries.name: Jehonadab
entries.note: H3082 includes the divine-name component missing from free giver; distinct bearers share it. [Strong H3082](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3082.htm).

entries.name: Jehonathan
entries.note: H3083 identifies Jehonathan; its KJV field lists Jonathan only. Gift of a dove is not established.

entries.name: Jehoram
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Jehoshaphat
entries.note: H3092 gives the verbal form, broadly compatible with Lord is judge; several people and a valley use the name. [Strong H3092](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3092.htm).

entries.name: Jehosheba
entries.note: Strong supports oath, not fullness; 2 Kings 11:2 identifies the woman.

entries.name: Jehoshua
entries.note: H3091 supports Joshua as an equivalent form; Hitchcock provides a cross-reference rather than its own gloss.

entries.name: Jehovah
entries.note: H3068 supports Hitchcock's lexical proposal; this is God's name. Supplied references are empty, so the occurrence list is incomplete (for example Exodus 6:3). [Strong H3068](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3068.htm).

entries.name: Jehovah-jireh
entries.note: Genesis 22:14 gives the place-name and in the mount of the LORD it shall be seen; provide is an interpretive gloss reflected in Strong's see to it.

entries.name: Jehovah-nissi
entries.note: Exodus 17:15 names an altar, not a person.

entries.name: Jehovah-shalom
entries.note: Judges 6:24 names Gideon's altar; H3073 gives is peace, not send peace. [Strong H3073](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3073.htm).

entries.name: Jehovah-shammah
entries.note: Ezekiel 48:35 explicitly gives The LORD is there as the city's name; preserve it as a symbolic place designation.

entries.name: Jehovah-tsidkenu
entries.note: Jeremiah 23:6 gives this exact explanation; H3072 is the corresponding epithet.

entries.name: Jehozabad
entries.note: H3075 includes three bearers; dowry is a narrower historical gloss for endowment. [Strong H3075](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3075.htm).

entries.name: Jehozadak
entries.note: H3087's printed Jehozadek/Josedech corresponds to KJV Jehozadak (1 Chronicles 6:14,15); keep the textual spelling.

entries.name: Jehu
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jehubbah
entries.note: H3160 supports hiding, not binding. [Strong H3160](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3160.htm).

entries.name: Jehucal
entries.note: H3081 supports mighty; perfect and wasted are not its explicit gloss.

entries.name: Jehud
entries.note: H3055 relates Jehud to H3061 Judah; Jehudi is not thereby the same place/person.

entries.name: Jehudijah
entries.note: H3057 is the feminine ethnic designation; praise of the Lord is a different derivation. KJV capitalizes Jehudijah in 1 Chronicles 4:18. [Strong H3057](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3057.htm).

entries.name: Jehush
entries.note: Strong H3266 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: keeping counsel; fastened. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jekabzeel
entries.note: H3343 gives gathering with God as subject.

entries.name: Jekamean
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No reference for Jekamean; H3360 Jekameam supports people will rise, but the final-letter difference needs confirmation.

entries.name: Jekamiah
entries.note: H3359 supports rising/establishing, not avenging.

entries.name: Jekuthiel
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jemima
entries.note: H3224 identifies Jemimah, Job's daughter; handsome as the day differs from its tentative derivation. [Strong H3224](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3224.htm).

entries.name: Jemuel
entries.note: God's day is supported; son of God is not the entry's derivation.

entries.name: Jephunneh
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jerah
entries.note: H3392 points to H3391 month, not smelling sweet. [Strong H3392](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3392.htm).

entries.name: Jerahmeel
entries.note: Mercy is supported; beloved is not the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Jerebai
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Jered
entries.note: H3382 identifies Jered through lemma/transliteration though digital KJV field says Jared; ruling is unsupported. [Strong H3382](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3382.htm).

entries.name: Jeremai
entries.note: Height is supported; the possessive my and throwing waters are not established.

entries.name: Jeremiah
entries.note: Exaltation/rising broadly agrees; multiple bearers require separate identity context.

entries.name: Jeremoth
entries.note: H3406 identifies Jeremoth in its definition, while digital KJV field misspells Jermoth; fears death is unsupported. [Strong H3406](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3406.htm).

entries.name: Jeriah
entries.note: Throwing is supported; fear is not the explicit derivation.

entries.name: Jericho
entries.note: H3405 explicitly offers competing roots; do not combine the alternatives into one established meaning.

entries.name: Jeriel
entries.note: H3400 differs from fear/vision of God. [Strong H3400](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3400.htm).

entries.name: Jerijah
entries.note: Strong includes the Jeriah/Jerijah forms; 1 Chronicles 23:19 and 26:31 supply the textual contexts.

entries.name: Jerimoth
entries.note: H3406 does not derive the name from fear/rejection of death.

entries.name: Jerioth
entries.note: H3408 differs from kettles/breaking asunder. [Strong H3408](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3408.htm).

entries.name: Jeroboam
entries.note: Strong H3379 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: he that opposes the people. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jeroham
entries.note: Merciful agrees; high/beloved is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Jerubbaal
entries.note: Judges 6:32 explains the name as Baal pleading against Gideon for throwing down the altar. Do not reverse this into Gideon defending Baal. [Strong H3378](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3378.htm).

entries.name: Jerubbesheth
entries.note: Strong explicitly treats shame as an idol substitution in this symbolic name for Gideon. Preserve the attributed wording without inventing confusion as another root.

entries.name: Jeruel
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jerusalem
entries.note: H3389 differs from vision of peace and marks the derivation tentative. Greek forms G2414/G2419 identify the same city. [Strong H3389](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3389.htm); [Strong G2414](https://biblehub.com/greek/2414.htm); [Strong G2419](https://biblehub.com/greek/2419.htm).

entries.name: Jerusha
entries.note: Possession/inheritance agrees; banished is not established.

entries.name: Jesaiah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Jeshebeab
entries.note: H3428 supports a seated/settled relation, not captivity. [Strong H3428](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3428.htm).

entries.name: Jesher
entries.note: Right is supported; singing is not established.

entries.name: Jeshimon
entries.note: A geographical/descriptive designation, not a person's name.

entries.name: Jeshishai
entries.note: H3454 supports ancient, not rejoicing exceedingly. [Strong H3454](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3454.htm).

entries.name: Jeshohaia
entries.displayMeaning: Possible Jeshoaiah form; Jah will empty
entries.note: H3439 identifies KJV Jeshoaiah (1 Chronicles 4:36), not exact Jeshohaia. Its empty sense differs from pressing/meditation.

entries.name: Jeshua
entries.note: H3442/H3443 relate Jeshua to Joshua but do not identify all bearers as Joshua son of Nun.

entries.name: Jesiah
entries.note: H3449 differs from sprinkling. [Strong H3449](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3449.htm).

entries.name: Jesimiel
entries.note: H3450 identifies Jesimael (1 Chronicles 4:36), corresponding to the input Jesimiel spelling. Naming/astonishment are not its proposed root.

entries.name: Jesse
entries.note: One who is agrees with H3448; gift/oblation is not independently established.

entries.name: Jesui
entries.note: H3440 does not establish the bearer's temperament or a flat-country referent. [Strong H3440](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3440.htm).

entries.name: Jesus
entries.note: G2424 points to Joshua H3091. Matthew 1:21 explicitly explains Jesus by He shall save his people from their sins; Colossians 4:11 and Acts 7:45 also require distinct bearer/context handling.

entries.name: Jether
entries.note: H3500 points to H3499; excellence broadly agrees.

entries.name: Jetheth
entries.note: H3509 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H3509](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3509.htm).

entries.name: Jethlah
entries.note: Hanging is supported with probability; heaping is not established.

entries.name: Jethro
entries.note: H3503 explicitly gives this; posterity is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Jetur
entries.note: H3195 differs from order/succession/mountainous. [Strong H3195](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3195.htm).

entries.name: Jeuel
entries.note: H3262 explicitly includes Jeuel, Jeiel and Jehiel spellings; heaping up is not its given gloss.

entries.name: Jeush
entries.note: H3266 covers several people; devoured is unsupported.

entries.name: Jew
entries.note: H3062/H3064/G2453 establish an ethnic designation derived from Judah, not the patriarch himself. [Strong H3062](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3062.htm); [Strong H3064](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3064.htm); [Strong G2453](https://biblehub.com/greek/2453.htm).

entries.name: Jezaniah
entries.note: Strong relates Jezaniah probably to Jaazaniah (heard of Jah), not nourishment/weapons.

entries.name: Jezebel
entries.note: H348 lists components H336/H2083 but gives no explicit English whole-name meaning; chaste is uncorroborated. Do not invent a derogatory replacement.

entries.name: Jezer
entries.note: H3337 points to H3336, not island of help. [Strong H3337](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3337.htm).

entries.name: Jeziah
entries.note: The supplied record establishes Jeziah, not that Jeziel is an identical name or person.

entries.name: Jezneel
entries.note: No candidate or KJV occurrence supplied; likely misspelling requires review.

entries.name: Jezoar
entries.note: H3328 identifies the Jezoar variant through lemma and 1 Chronicles 4:7; digital KJV field gives Zehoar. [Strong H3328](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3328.htm).

entries.name: Jezrahiah
entries.note: Strong H3156 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the Lord arises; brightness of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jibsam
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jidlaph
entries.note: H3044's dripping/tears sense is compatible with distilling water as a traditional phrasing. [Strong H3044](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3044.htm).

entries.name: Jimnah
entries.note: Strong supports right-hand association; numbering/preparing are not established.

entries.name: Jiphtah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Jiphthael
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference for Jiphthael; H3317 Jiphthah-el gives God will open, but do not silently replace the spelling.

entries.name: Joab
entries.note: Strong H3097 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: paternity; voluntary. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Joah
entries.note: Brotherhood/Jehovah broadly agrees; do not treat the name as a doctrinal definition.

entries.name: Joahaz
entries.note: H3099 refers to H3059; seeing is unsupported and the divine-name component is missing in Hitchcock. [Strong H3099](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3099.htm).

entries.name: Joakim
entries.note: The supplied spelling Joakim lacks a KJV occurrence; H3113 is Joiakim, a form of Jehoiakim. This is a spelling proposal, not a verified exact match.

entries.name: Joanna
entries.displayMeaning: Joanna the woman; Joannas the male ancestor
entries.note: G2489 is feminine; Luke 3:27 has a male ancestor represented by G2490. Both relate to John, but their identities must be separate.

entries.name: Joash
entries.note: H3101 refers to H3060, while H3135 has a distinct hastened construction. Multiple bearers need verse-by-verse assignment; despair is unsupported. [Strong H3101](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3101.htm); [Strong H3135](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3135.htm).

entries.name: Joatham
entries.note: G2488 expressly relates Joatham to Jotham; Matthew 1:9 names the king.

entries.name: Job
entries.displayMeaning: Patriarch Job: hated/persecuted; Genesis Job: uncertain
entries.note: H347/G2492 concern the patriarch; H3102 is the Genesis 46:13 Israelite and explicitly discusses a possible textual/spelling issue. Do not give both one derivation.

entries.name: Jobab
entries.note: H3103 differs from sorrowful/hated. [Strong H3103](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3103.htm).

entries.name: Jochebed
entries.note: Strong preserves the Jehovah element, which the short Hitchcock gloss omits.

entries.name: Joed
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Joel
entries.note: H3100/G2493 differ substantially from wills/commands. [Strong H3100](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3100.htm); [Strong G2493](https://biblehub.com/greek/2493.htm).

entries.name: Joelah
entries.note: Strong H3132 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: lifting up; profiting; taking away slander. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Joezer
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Jogbehah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H3011 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H3011](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3011.htm).

entries.name: Jogli
entries.note: Strong H3020 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: passing over; turning back; rejoicing. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Joha
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Johanan
entries.note: H3110 refers to H3076; Hitchcock's wording obscures the divine-name component. [Strong H3110](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3110.htm).

entries.name: John
entries.note: Strong's John to Johanan to Jehohanan chain supports the grace/favor sense. Distinguish John the Baptist, the apostle and other bearers by context.

entries.name: Joiarib
entries.note: H3114 points to H3080; multiplying is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Jokdeam
entries.note: H3347 supports burning, not crookedness. [Strong H3347](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3347.htm).

entries.name: Jokim
entries.note: Strong relates Jokim through Joiakim to Jehoiakim, not a claim that this man made the sun stand still.

entries.name: Jokmeam
entries.note: H3361 broadly supports raising/confirmation; revenge is not its supplied meaning.

entries.name: Jokneam
entries.note: H3362 differs from possessing/building up the people. [Strong H3362](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3362.htm).

entries.name: Jokshan
entries.note: Strong H3370 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: an offense; hardness; a knocking. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Joktan
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Jonadab
entries.note: H3122 refers to H3082; the divine-name element should not disappear. [Strong H3122](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3122.htm).

entries.name: Jonah
entries.note: Dove is supported; oppressor/destroyer are not established by this entry. A cross-reference to Jonas must not merge distinct NT bearers without context.

entries.name: Jonan
entries.displayMeaning: Possibly a form of John or Jonah
entries.note: G2494 explicitly offers alternatives; dove is only an association with one option, not a settled derivation.

entries.name: Jonathan
entries.note: H3129 refers to H3083; several different people share the name. [Strong H3129](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3129.htm).

entries.name: Joppa
entries.note: Strong H3305, G2445 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: beauty; comeliness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jorah
entries.note: H3139 is not a conflation with Jorai; cauldron is unsupported.

entries.name: Joram
entries.note: H3141 refers to H3088; elevated is related, to cast unsupported. [Strong H3141](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3141.htm); [Strong G2496](https://biblehub.com/greek/2496.htm).

entries.name: Jordan
entries.note: Strong H3383, G2446 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the river of judgment. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jorim
entries.note: G2497 only perhaps equals G2496/H3141; do not present a certain derivation.

entries.name: Josabad
entries.note: H3107 refers to H3075; Hitchcock omits the divine-name element. [Strong H3107](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3107.htm).

entries.name: Josaphat
entries.note: Strong explicitly identifies Josaphat as Jehoshaphat; Matthew 1:8 identifies the king.

entries.name: Jose
entries.note: G2499 is a form of G2500, which perhaps equals Joseph. Raised/pardons is not established.

entries.name: Joseph
entries.note: H3130 is the direct Hebrew entry missing from the initial candidates; H3084 is the fuller Jehoseph form and G2501 covers Greek Joseph. Distinct bearers remain distinct. [Strong H3130](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3130.htm); [Strong H3084](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3084.htm); [Strong G2501](https://biblehub.com/greek/2501.htm).

entries.name: Joses
entries.note: Strong's perhaps relationship is tentative. Hitchcock's same as Jose does not establish a certain origin or identity.

entries.name: Joshah
entries.note: H3144 probably points to H3145; forgetting/owing are unsupported.

entries.name: Joshaviah
entries.note: H3145 differs from seat/alteration/captivity of the Lord. [Strong H3145](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3145.htm).

entries.name: Joshbekesha
entries.note: H3436 identifies Joshbekashah (1 Chronicles 25:4,24), not exact Joshbekesha; requiring/beseeching is a competing etymology.

entries.name: Joshua
entries.note: H3091 is the Joshua/Jehoshua entry; savior is related but omits the divine-name component.

entries.name: Josiah
entries.note: H2977 differs from burns/fire of the Lord. [Strong H2977](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2977.htm).

entries.name: Josibiah
entries.note: Dwelling is supported; captivity is a competing association.

entries.name: Josiphiah
entries.note: Increase agrees; finishing is not corroborated.

entries.name: Jotham
entries.note: The pinned Strong H3147 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H3147](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3147.htm).

entries.name: Jothath
entries.note: H3193 identifies Jotbath/Jotbathah, related to H3192 pleasantness; exact Jothath/Jothatha is not established. A spelling proposal must not merge different places automatically.

entries.name: Jozabad
entries.note: H3107 points to H3075; Hitchcock supplies a spelling cross-reference.

entries.name: Jozachar
entries.note: H3108 supports remembering, not male sex; restore the divine-name component. [Strong H3108](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3108.htm).

entries.name: Jubal
entries.note: Strong H3106 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: he that runs; a trumpet. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Jucal
entries.note: H3116 points to H3081; mighty agrees, perfect is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Judaea
entries.note: G2449 identifies Judaea, whose digital spelling uses the ligature Judæa. The region is not the patriarch. [Strong G2449](https://biblehub.com/greek/2449.htm).

entries.name: Judah
entries.note: Genesis 29:35 connects Judah's name with praise. Persons, tribe, region and the Greek geographical possibility Juttah (G2448) require contextual separation; the name itself does not contain an explicit Jah element in Strong's derivation.

entries.name: Judas
entries.note: G2455 refers to Judah H3063. Hitchcock gives only cross-references. Many people share Judas/Jude; the Matthew 1:2 ancestor must not be merged with Judas Iscariot or Jude.

entries.name: Judith
entries.note: H3067 is the feminine ethnic/name form, not simply the same person or form as Judah. [Strong H3067](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3067.htm).

entries.name: Julia
entries.note: Strong gives the family-name relationship but does not establish downy hair in these entries.

entries.name: Julius
entries.note: G2457 gives no luminous/white derivation; Hitchcock only redirects to Julia.

entries.name: Junia
entries.displayMeaning: Latin personal name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: Romans 16:7 prints Junia; G2458 prints Junias with a masculine accent. Preserve the KJV form and flag the historical source's form/gender difference; youth is not supplied. [Strong G2458](https://biblehub.com/greek/2458.htm).

entries.name: Jupiter
entries.note: Acts 14:12,13 use the pagan deity's name; Strong says uncertain affinity and does not establish father that helpeth. Its historical supreme deity label is a description of Greek belief, not a Christian confession.

entries.name: Jushabhesed
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Justus
entries.note: The pinned Strong G2459 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G2459](https://biblehub.com/greek/2459.htm).

entries.name: Juttah
entries.note: Strong H3194 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: turning away. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Kabzeel
entries.note: H6909 supplies gathering with God as subject.

entries.name: Kadesh
entries.note: H6946 supplies sanctuary; do not import the neighboring common-word entry's cultic senses as a description of the place. [Strong H6946](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6946.htm).

entries.name: Kadesh-barnea
entries.displayMeaning: Kadesh of the wilderness of wandering
entries.note: Strong's compound includes an uncertain second element interpreted desert of a fugitive; holiness of an inconstant son is a competing reconstruction.

entries.name: Kadmiel
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Kadmonites
entries.note: H6935 supports ancient, not chiefs; this is a people-name. [Strong H6935](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6935.htm).

entries.name: Kallai
entries.note: Strong H7040 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: light; resting by fire; my voice. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Kanah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Kareah
entries.note: H7143 supports bald, not ice. [Strong H7143](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7143.htm).

entries.name: Karkaa
entries.note: Floor is supported; dissolving coldness is not established.

entries.name: Karkor
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Karnaim
entries.note: H6255 is the full Ashtaroth-karnaim compound; Karnaim is its dual horns component. [Strong H6255](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6255.htm).

entries.name: Kartah
entries.note: Strong H7177 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: calling; meeting. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Kedar
entries.note: Blackness broadly agrees; sorrow is not independently established as the name sense.

entries.name: Kedemah
entries.note: H6929 supports priority/first as a lexical proposal. [Strong H6929](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6929.htm).

entries.name: Kedemoth
entries.note: Strong H6932 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: antiquity; old age. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Kehelahath
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Keiiah
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: Keiiah has no reference or exact entry; possible typographic confusion with Keilah is unconfirmed.

entries.name: Kelaiah
entries.note: Strong H7041 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: voice of the Lord; gathering together. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Kelitah
entries.note: Only a cross-reference to Kelaiah is supplied; no exact candidate or KJV reference.

entries.name: Kemuel
entries.note: The pinned Strong H7055 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H7055](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7055.htm).

entries.name: Kenah
entries.note: H7079 identifies Kenath (Numbers 32:42), not exact Kenah; possession is supported only for that proposed spelling relationship.

entries.name: Kenan
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Kenaz
entries.note: H7073 differs from purchase/lamentation. [Strong H7073](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7073.htm).

entries.name: Kenites
entries.displayMeaning: Members of the tribe of Cain
entries.note: A collective patronymic, not a personal name; Strong identifies descent from Cain/Kajin rather than directly glossing purchase/lamentation.

entries.name: Kenizzites
entries.note: H7074 is an ethnic adjective, not a common noun meaning possession or purchase.

entries.name: Keren-happuch
entries.note: H7163 differs from horn/child of beauty. [Strong H7163](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7163.htm).

entries.name: Kerioth
entries.note: Cities is supported; callings is not established.

entries.name: Keros
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Keturah
entries.note: H6989 gives a passive perfumed sense, whereas Hitchcock describes someone actively making incense fume. [Strong H6989](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6989.htm).

entries.name: Kezia
entries.note: Cassia is supported; superficies and angle are not established by the cassia entry.

entries.name: Keziz
entries.note: End/extremity broadly relates to cutting off; not an independently established second sense.

entries.name: Kibroth-hattaavah
entries.note: Numbers 11:34 explicitly explains the memorial through the people who lusted. [Strong H6914](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6914.htm).

entries.name: Kibzaim
entries.note: Strong H6911 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: congregation. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Kidron
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Kinah
entries.note: H7016 points to H7015 lamentation; a bare same as Kenah does not supply that sense. [Strong H7016](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7016.htm).

entries.name: Kir
entries.note: Strong names separate Assyrian and Moabite places; 2 Kings 16:9 and Isaiah 15:1 must not be merged into one city.

entries.name: Kirharaseth
entries.note: Burnt-brick wall broadly agrees; city of the sun is not supported by H7025.

entries.name: Kirioth
entries.note: H7152 supports Kerioth/Kirioth forms; Amos 2:2 directly attests Kirioth for the Moabite town. [Strong H7152](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7152.htm).

entries.name: Kirjath
entries.note: Joshua 18:28 uses the shortened place-name; vocation/meeting are not established by Strong.

entries.name: Kirjath-arba
