entries.displayMeaning: City of Arba; alternatively city of four
entries.note: H7153 offers Arba or four as component analysis; Genesis 23:2 locates it at Hebron.

entries.name: Kirjath-arim
entries.note: H7157 differs from city of those who watch. [Strong H7157](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7157.htm).

entries.name: Kirjath-baal
entries.note: Strong preserves the deity/name Baal rather than replacing it with a generic ruler.

entries.name: Kirjath-huzoth
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Kirjath-jearim
entries.note: The pinned Strong H7157 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H7157](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7157.htm).

entries.name: Kirjath-sannah
entries.note: Strong distinguishes the Sannah branches gloss from Sepher book within the related place-name; blackberry/enmity are competing etymologies.

entries.name: Kirjath-sepher
entries.note: H7158 distinguishes Sannah branches and Sepher book as alternative place-name forms; not both meanings for Sepher alone.

entries.name: Kirjathaim
entries.note: H7156 supports two cities, not callings/meetings; it lists two distinct places. [Strong H7156](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7156.htm).

entries.name: Kish
entries.note: Strong H7027 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: hard; difficult; straw; for age. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Kishi
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Kishion
entries.note: The pinned Strong H7191 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H7191](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7191.htm).

entries.name: Kishon
entries.note: Strong H7028 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: hard; sore. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Kithlish
entries.note: H3798 does not give lioness as a component.

entries.name: Kitron
entries.note: H7003 differs from making sweet/binding together. [Strong H7003](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7003.htm).

entries.name: Kittim
entries.note: An ethnic plural tied by Strong to an otherwise unused Cyprus name; breaking/bruising/gold/coloring are not established. Genesis 10:4's genealogical use needs its own context.

entries.name: Koa
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Kohath
entries.note: H6955 differs from wrinkle/bluntness; congregation is only loosely related. [Strong H6955](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6955.htm).

entries.name: Kolariah
entries.displayMeaning: Possible Kolaiah spelling; voice of Jah
entries.note: H6964 gives Kolaiah (Nehemiah 11:7; Jeremiah 29:21), not the exact input Kolariah; flag a spelling problem rather than manufacture a new KJV person.

entries.name: Korah
entries.note: Ice agrees with H7141; baldness/frost are related possibilities but not all separately established by the name entry.

entries.name: Kushaiah
entries.note: H6984 is not the same derivation as Kishi; retain the historical cross-reference as an identity proposal only. [Strong H6984](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6984.htm).

entries.name: Laadah
entries.note: Strong H3935 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: to assemble together; to testify; passing over. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Laadan
entries.note: H3936 points to Laadah H3935, whose root meaning is uncertain.

entries.name: Laban
entries.note: H3837 points to H3836 white; gentle/brittle is unsupported. The man and desert location are distinct. [Strong H3837](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3837.htm).

entries.name: Labana
entries.note: H3838 is Lebana/Lebanah, not the exact Labana spelling. Ezra 2:45 and Nehemiah 7:48 need spelling confirmation before equivalence is asserted.

entries.name: Lachish
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Lael
entries.note: The pinned Strong H3815 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H3815](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3815.htm).

entries.name: Lahad
entries.note: Strong supplies two possible unused-root explanations, not praise/confession; the derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Lahairoi
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this form.

entries.name: Lahmam
entries.note: H3903 gives food-like, not war, and flags a Hebrew textual/transcription variant. [Strong H3903](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3903.htm).

entries.name: Lahmi
entries.note: Strong gives foodful and a possible textual relationship to Bethlehemite. Its Israelite attribution conflicts with 1 Chronicles 20:5, which names Lahmi as brother of Goliath the Gittite; do not reproduce the attribution.

entries.name: Laish
entries.note: H3919 is the place Laish and points to lion H3918; distinguish places and personal uses.

entries.name: Lamech
entries.note: H3929 explicitly marks root meaning uncertain; Genesis 4 and Genesis 5 name different Lamechs. [Strong H3929](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3929.htm); [Strong G2984](https://biblehub.com/greek/2984.htm).

entries.name: Laodicea
entries.note: Strong's elements are people and justice; just people is a concise interpretive expansion, not an explicit biblical explanation.

entries.name: Lapidoth
entries.note: Input Lapidoth corresponds to Lappidoth H3941; lamps agrees, enlightened is figurative.

entries.name: Lasea
entries.note: G2996 explicitly marks origin uncertain. [Strong G2996](https://biblehub.com/greek/2996.htm).

entries.name: Lashah
entries.note: H3962 identifies KJV Lasha (Genesis 10:19), not exact Lashah. Calling/anointing is not established by its proposed break-through root.

entries.name: Lazarus
entries.note: G2976 probably relates to Eleazar H499. Its imaginary label for one Lazarus is interpretive commentary, not a textual identity proof.

entries.name: Leah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H3812 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H3812](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3812.htm).

entries.name: Lebanon
entries.note: White mountain is the explicit Strong gloss; its linked H3825 (heart) does not substantiate that root and needs original-edition checking. Incense is not the actual place-name gloss.

entries.name: Lebaoth
entries.note: H3822 supplies the place-name proposal, not lividness.

entries.name: Lebbeus
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference or exact entry for Lebbeus; G3002 Lebbaeus is a possible spelling relation requiring confirmation.

entries.name: Lebonah
entries.note: Strong links the place Lebonah to frankincense. Hitchcock's bare equation with Labana must not merge Lebonah with the person Lebana.

entries.name: Lehabim
entries.note: A people designation; swords is not independently supplied as the name meaning.

entries.name: Lehi
entries.note: H3896 is Lehi; H7437 is the larger Ramath-lehi compound, not a second sense for every occurrence. [Strong H3896](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3896.htm).

entries.name: Lekah
entries.note: H3922 explicitly supplies Lekah despite the input's missing exact candidate; 1 Chronicles 4:21 names it.

entries.name: Lemuel
entries.note: Proverbs 31:1 names king Lemuel; Strong's identification as a symbolic Solomon is commentary, not expressly stated by the verse.

entries.name: Leshem
entries.note: H3959 points to H3958 gem; name/putting is unsupported. [Strong H3959](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3959.htm).

entries.name: Letushim
entries.note: Strong H3912 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: hammermen; filemen. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Leummim
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Levi
entries.note: H3878 and Genesis 29:34 establish the joining association. G3017/G3018 name later bearers; the digital G3018 gloss Lewis is an apparent transcription problem. [Strong H3878](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3878.htm); [Strong G3017](https://biblehub.com/greek/3017.htm); [Strong G3018](https://biblehub.com/greek/3018.htm).

entries.name: Libnah
entries.note: Strong connects Libnah to a whitish tree rather than merely the abstract color; the Desert station and Palestinian city are separate places.

entries.name: Libni
entries.note: H3845 supplies white; Hitchcock provides only a cross-reference to Libnah.

entries.name: Libya
entries.displayMeaning: Libya; probably associated with southwest wind
entries.note: G3033 probably refers to G3047 southwest wind, not heart of the sea/fat. Hebrew Libya references require distinct underlying people-names rather than applying a Greek derivation backward. [Strong G3033](https://biblehub.com/greek/3033.htm).

entries.name: Linus
entries.note: Strong tentatively links Linus to flax/linen, not a net.

entries.name: Lo-ammi
entries.note: Hosea 1:9 explicitly explains the symbolic personal name.

entries.name: Lo-ruhamah
entries.note: The pinned digital H3819 record supports not pitied but calls Lo-ruhamah a son; Hosea 1:6 explicitly says daughter. This is a discrepancy in the transcription/source presented here; the original printed entry was not checked. [Strong H3819](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3819.htm).

entries.name: Lod
entries.note: Strong H3850 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: nativity; generation. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Lois
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Lot
entries.note: H3876 points to H3875 veil; myrrh/rosin belongs to a different word, not this personal name. Lotan is a distinct name. [Strong H3876](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/3876.htm); [Strong G3091](https://biblehub.com/greek/3091.htm).

entries.name: Lubin
entries.note: H3864 identifies Lubim (2 Chronicles 12:3), not exact Lubin; Strong proposes a probably thirst/dry-region root, not heart of man/sea.

entries.name: Lucas
entries.note: G3065 establishes the Latin form, not luminous/white; Lucas and Lucius are not interchangeable people.

entries.name: Lucifer
entries.note: H1966 supplies morning-star in Isaiah 14:12. The chapter's address to Babylon's king and later theological interpretation must be distinguished; the lexical entry alone does not identify every use as a personal name of Satan. [Strong H1966](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1966.htm).

entries.name: Lud
entries.note: Strong does not equate Lud with Lod; its nations description does not erase Genesis 10:22's named son of Shem.

entries.name: Luhith
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Luke
entries.note: G3065 does not establish luminous/white. [Strong G3065](https://biblehub.com/greek/3065.htm).

entries.name: Luz
entries.note: Strong tentatively relates the place to a nut-tree; separation/departure are not the explicit proposal.

entries.name: Lycaonia
entries.note: G3071 only perhaps remotely derives from wolf G3074; she-wolf is too certain/specific.

entries.name: Lydda
entries.note: G3069 identifies Lydda with H3850 Lod, whose root is uncertain; Lydda and Lydia are distinct names. [Strong G3069](https://biblehub.com/greek/3069.htm).

entries.name: Lysanias
entries.note: Strong G3078 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that drives away sorrow. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Lysias
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Lysimachus
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established in the KJV name set
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference or exact Strong entry for Lysimachus; do not import an Apocryphal bearer into the approved KJV corpus.

entries.name: Lystra
entries.note: Strong G3082 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that dissolves or disperses. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Maachah
entries.note: Pressure/depression broadly agrees; people and places sharing this spelling remain distinct.

entries.name: Maachathi
entries.note: H4602 supports Deuteronomy 3:14's gentilic form; broken is not its stated sense. [Strong H4602](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4602.htm).

entries.name: Maadai
entries.note: Strong H4572 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: pleasant; testifying. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Maadiah
entries.note: H4573 supplies ornament, not testimony.

entries.name: Maai
entries.note: H4597 differs from belly/heaping up. [Strong H4597](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4597.htm).

entries.name: Maale-akrabbim
entries.note: H4610 expressly identifies Maaleh-accrabim (Joshua 15:3), underlying this alternate spelling; the scorpions/ascent sense agrees.

entries.name: Maarath
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Maaseiah
entries.displayMeaning: Maaseiah: work of Jah; Mahseiah: refuge in Jah
entries.note: The pinned digital H4641 record supplies work of Jah for Maaseiah; H4271's lemma/transliteration identifies Mahseiah but its KJV field reads Maaseiah. Do not apply H4271's refuge sense to every Maaseiah bearer; the printed original was not checked. [Strong H4271](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4271.htm); [Strong H4641](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4641.htm).

entries.name: Maasiai
entries.note: Strong H4640 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the defense, or strength, or trust of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Maath
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Maaz
entries.note: H4619 differs from wood/wooden. [Strong H4619](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4619.htm).

entries.name: Macedonia
entries.note: Macedonia comes through Macedon, which Strong calls uncertain derivation; burning/adoration are not established.

entries.name: Machbenah
entries.note: H4343 describes a place settled by the named ancestor; poverty/smiting his son is uncorroborated.

entries.name: Machi
entries.note: H4352 differs from smiter; poor is only a related conjecture. [Strong H4352](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4352.htm).

entries.name: Machir
entries.note: Selling is supported; knowing is not established.

entries.name: Machnadebai
entries.displayMeaning: What is like a liberal man?
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Machpelah
entries.note: H4375 gives fold from doubling; the cave and field designation is a place-name. [Strong H4375](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4375.htm).

entries.name: Madai
entries.note: Genesis 10:2 names a son of Japheth; Strong's country description reflects a national association, not an exhaustive identity.

entries.name: Madian
entries.note: G3099 refers to Midian H4080/H4079; striving/chiding agrees, covering is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Madmannah
entries.note: H4089 points to H4087; measure of gift/preparation of garment is unsupported. This proposal does not define the settlement's occupants. [Strong H4089](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4089.htm).

entries.name: Madon
entries.note: Strong H4068, H4067 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a chiding; a garment; his measure. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Magbish
entries.note: H4019 leaves person versus place uncertain; preserve that identification limit.

entries.name: Magdala
entries.note: The pinned Strong G3093 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G3093](https://biblehub.com/greek/3093.htm).

entries.name: Magdalene
entries.note: A geographical designation of Mary, not an independent personal given name.

entries.name: Magdiel
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Magog
entries.displayMeaning: name related to Gog; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H4031 derives from Gog without establishing covering/roof/dissolving. Keep person, region/people and Revelation's use distinct. [Strong H4031](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4031.htm); [Strong G3098](https://biblehub.com/greek/3098.htm).

entries.name: Magor-missabib
entries.note: Strong H4036 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fear on every side. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Magpiash
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Mahalah
entries.note: H4244 also covers Mahalah in 1 Chronicles 7:18; do not conflate it with Mahalath or assume dancers/harp. [Strong H4244](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4244.htm).

entries.name: Mahaleleel
entries.note: H4111's KJV form Mahalaleel corresponds to this misspelt Mahaleleel; Genesis 5:12 supplies the patriarch.

entries.name: Mahali
entries.note: No exact candidate supplied for this spelling; Exodus 6:19 grounds the personal context.

entries.name: Mahanaim
entries.note: Genesis 32:2 explicitly connects the name to God's host; two fields is not Strong's literal compound. [Strong H4266](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4266.htm).

entries.name: Mahanehdan
entries.note: Strong preserves Dan as the tribal name (Judges 18:12); tents of judgment substitutes a root gloss for the actual compound.

entries.name: Mahanem
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV occurrence supplied; do not silently identify with another name.

entries.name: Maharai
entries.note: H4121 supports haste, not hill. [Strong H4121](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4121.htm).

entries.name: Mahath
entries.note: Strong gives a probable erasure derivation; same as Maath alone is not independent corroboration.

entries.name: Mahavites
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV occurrence supplied for this ethnic form.

entries.name: Mahaz
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference or exact entry for Mahaz; do not silently normalize to Maaz or Mahazioth.

entries.name: Mahazioth
entries.note: Strong H4238 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: seeing a sign; seeing a letter. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz
entries.displayMeaning: Hasting to the spoil; swift to the prey
entries.note: Isaiah 8:1 supplies the wording; H4122's digital KJV field has a corrupt hash/bash spelling, requiring source care.

entries.name: Mahlah
entries.note: H4244 distinguishes Mahlah from Mahli H4249 and Mahlon H4248; shared root does not make these identical names/bearers. [Strong H4244](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4244.htm).

entries.name: Makas
entries.note: H4739 identifies Makaz (1 Kings 4:9), not exact Makas; same as Mahaz does not establish a second name or exact equivalence.

entries.name: Makheloth
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Makkedah
entries.note: H4719 differs from worshiping/burning/raised/crookedness. [Strong H4719](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4719.htm).

entries.name: Malachi
entries.note: Strong gives ministrative and relates it to messenger; Hitchcock's specific possessive my is not in the entry's stated gloss. The dictionaries differ in grammatical formulation.

entries.name: Malcham
entries.note: 1 Chronicles 8:9 is a person. The supplied H4445 defines an Ammonite deity; it cannot justify treating that man as an idol. Derivation remains unresolved here.

entries.name: Malchiah
entries.note: H4441 differs in grammatical interpretation from Lord my king; counselor is unsupported. [Strong H4441](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4441.htm).

entries.name: Malchiel
entries.note: Strong phrases this king of God, appointed by God, rather than God is my king; counselor is not established.

entries.name: Malchus
entries.note: G3124 points to Melek H4429; king agrees but my and counselor are not separately established.

entries.name: Maleleel
entries.note: G3121 refers to H4111. [Strong G3121](https://biblehub.com/greek/3121.htm).

entries.name: Mallothi
entries.note: Strong H4413 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fullness; circumcision. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Malluch
entries.note: H4409 prints remnant despite deriving the name from reign H4427; this internal anomaly needs original-print verification before choosing a confident display meaning.

entries.name: Mammon
entries.note: G3126 is a wealth/personification term, not a historical human bearer. KJV passages include Matthew 6:24 and Luke 16:13; supplied references are empty. [Strong G3126](https://biblehub.com/greek/3126.htm).

entries.name: Mamre
entries.note: Strong's lusty means vigorous in this etymological proposal; it is not an accusation about conduct. Person and associated location require context.

entries.name: Manaen
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Manahethites
entries.note: H2679/H2680 underlie half the Manahethites; my lady/my prince of rest is unsupported. This is a group designation. [Strong H2679](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2679.htm); [Strong H2680](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2680.htm).

entries.name: Manasseh
entries.note: Genesis 41:51 explicitly explains God hath made me forget; passive forgotten is less precise. Different royal and tribal bearers must be separated.

entries.name: Manoah
entries.note: Present is not separately supplied by H4495.

entries.name: Maon
entries.note: H4584 supports house/residence, not place of sin; town and personal/genealogical uses need separation. [Strong H4584](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4584.htm).

entries.name: Mara
entries.note: Ruth 1:20 explicitly applies Mara to Naomi; Marah is also a distinct place designation, not the same entity.

entries.name: Maralah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Maranatha
entries.note: G3134 treats Maranatha as an exclamation, not a person's name. Hitchcock's is coming differs in tense; preserve the disagreement. [Strong G3134](https://biblehub.com/greek/3134.htm).

entries.name: Marcus
entries.note: Strong G3138 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: polite; shining. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Mareshah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Mark
entries.note: G3138 identifies the Christian Mark, while the supplied references include the English verb (2 Samuel 13:28; 1 Kings 20:7; Job 21:5). Those do not identify the evangelist; separate name references such as Acts 12:12. [Strong G3138](https://biblehub.com/greek/3138.htm).

english.edition: Noah Webster, American Dictionary of the English Language (1828)
english.definition: To notice; to take particular observation of.

entries.name: Maroth
entries.note: Strong H4796 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: bitterness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Marsena
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Martha
entries.note: G3136 differs from bitter/provoking. [Strong G3136](https://biblehub.com/greek/3136.htm).

entries.name: Mary
entries.note: Strong relates Mary to Miriam and proposes rebelliously at H4813. Hitchcock here supplies only a cross-reference; that does not validate a contested etymology or describe the character of Mary the mother of Jesus.

entries.name: Mash
entries.note: H4851 identifies Mash; Hitchcock's Meshech cross-reference does not establish identical derivation/identity.

entries.name: Mashal
entries.note: H4913 refers to H4861 Mishal, not the common word parable/ruling. [Strong H4913](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4913.htm).

entries.name: Masrekah
entries.note: Strong H4957 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: whistling; hissing. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Massa
entries.note: H4854 selects burden for Ishmael's son; prophecy is not independently established as the personal name meaning.

entries.name: Massah
entries.note: Exodus 17:7 expressly explains the name. [Strong H4532](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4532.htm).

entries.name: Matred
entries.note: Strong H4308 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: wand of government. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Matri
entries.note: Rain agrees; prison is not corroborated.

entries.name: Mattan
entries.note: H4977 points to H4976 present; rains is unsupported and Mattana/Mattenai are distinct forms. [Strong H4977](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4977.htm).

entries.name: Mattaniah
entries.note: Gift is supported; hope is not established.

entries.name: Mattatha
entries.note: G3160 probably shortens G3161/H4993; its digital G4992 comparison points to salvation and is anomalous for the name.

entries.name: Mattathias
entries.note: G3161 refers to H4993; Luke 3:25–26 contains distinct bearers. [Strong G3161](https://biblehub.com/greek/3161.htm).

entries.name: Matthal
entries.note: No exact name headword or defensible alias was established in the supplied Strong snapshot. Hitchcock: gift; he that gives. Keep this name and gloss unresolved; do not guess from a similar spelling.

entries.name: Matthan
entries.note: G3157 points to Mattan H4977/H4976; Hitchcock supplies only a cross-reference.

entries.name: Matthanias
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference or exact entry for Matthanias; do not silently normalize it to Mattaniah.

entries.name: Matthew
entries.note: G3156's printed cross-reference G3164 is the verb fight, a digital mismatch; H4993 gives Mattithiah gift of Jah. Do not derive Matthew from fighting or declare the corrupt reference verified.

entries.name: Matthias
entries.note: G3159 apparently shortens G3161/H4993; name relationship does not identify all similarly named people.

entries.name: Mazzaroth
entries.note: H4216's digital field says Mazzoroth; Job 38:32 prints Mazzaroth. Strong itself says perhaps, so twelve specific zodiac signs is stronger than the evidence. [Strong H4216](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4216.htm).

entries.name: Meah
entries.note: Strong gives a hundred for the tower-name; cubits is an explanatory unit absent from the headword itself.

entries.name: Mearah
entries.note: Making empty is not independently supplied as the selected place meaning.

entries.name: Mebunnai
entries.note: H4012 supports building, not son/understanding. [Strong H4012](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4012.htm).

entries.name: Mecherath
entries.note: H4382 derives the inhabitant designation Mecherathite (1 Chronicles 11:36) from an unused place name related to H4380, sword. Exact Mecherath is not independently attested in the supplied references; selling/knowledge is unestablished.

entries.name: Medad
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Medan
entries.note: H4091 points to H4090 strife, not process. [Strong H4091](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4091.htm).

entries.name: Medeba
entries.note: Strong H4311 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: waters of grief; waters springing up. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Media
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Megiddo
entries.note: H4023 differs from precious fruit/message; the digital derivation also contains a malformed Zechariah reference. [Strong H4023](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4023.htm).

entries.name: Megiddon
entries.note: Strong explicitly includes Megiddon and Megiddo. Its malformed Zechariah H12 reference is a digital citation defect, not a new Hebrew root.

entries.name: Mehetabel
entries.note: Genesis 36:39 identifies a woman; Strong covers multiple namesakes but should not override that identity.

entries.name: Mehida
entries.note: H4240 differs from riddle/sharp wit. [Strong H4240](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4240.htm).

entries.name: Mehir
entries.note: Strong H4243 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a reward. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Mehujael
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Mehuman
entries.note: H4104 does not establish uproar/multitude. [Strong H4104](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4104.htm).

entries.name: Mejarkon
entries.note: Strong identifies Me-haj-Jarkon, corresponding to KJV Me-jarkon in Joshua 19:46; Jordan is a different name/root.

entries.name: Mekonah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Melatiah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H4424 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H4424](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4424.htm).

entries.name: Melchi
entries.note: My king is explicit; my counsel is not established.

entries.name: Melchi-shua
entries.note: Input Melchi-shua corresponds to Malchishua H4444; health/magnificent is not its supplied meaning.

entries.name: Melchiah
entries.note: H4441 identifies the Malchiah/Melchiah form in Jeremiah 21:1; God is my king differs from the source's grammatical construction. [Strong H4441](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4441.htm).

entries.name: Melchizedek
entries.note: Hebrews 7:2 explicitly interprets the name King of righteousness; Genesis 14:18 identifies the priest-king.

entries.name: Melea
entries.note: G3190 identifies the Luke 3:31 ancestor as Meleas; its origin is uncertain, not supplying/supplied.

entries.name: Melech
entries.note: H4429 supports king, not counselor. [Strong H4429](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4429.htm).

entries.name: Melita
entries.note: Strong G3194 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: affording honey. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Mellicu
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this form.

entries.name: Melzar
entries.note: H4453 describes an office, not an etymology from circumcision/narrow place. Daniel 1:11,16 uses Melzar for the appointed officer. [Strong H4453](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4453.htm).

entries.name: Memphis
entries.note: H4644 supplies Moph/Memphis for Hosea 9:6 but no abode-of-the-good etymology.

entries.name: Memucan
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Menahem
entries.note: H4505 supports comforter, not conducts them/preparation of heat. [Strong H4505](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4505.htm).

entries.name: Menan
entries.note: The snapshot prints Mainan for this Luke 3:31 genealogical name; KJV Menan differs in spelling. Strong supplies probably Hebrew origin, not numbered/rewarded/prepared.

entries.name: Mene
entries.note: H4484 is the Aramaic inscription word, not a personal name; no reference supplied for this title-case form.

entries.name: Meonenim
entries.note: H6049 underlies the oak/plain of Meonenim in Judges 9:37; the digital KJV field misspells Meonemin. This is an occupational designation within a place phrase. [Strong H6049](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6049.htm).

entries.name: Mephaath
entries.note: Strong H4158 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: appearance, or force, of waters. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Mephibosheth
entries.note: H4648's etymology differs from Hitchcock; its Baal association is a historical proposal, not permission to merge the two Mephibosheths.

entries.name: Merab
entries.note: H4764 differs from fights/disputes. [Strong H4764](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4764.htm).

entries.name: Meraioth
entries.note: Strong supports rebellious, not bitterness/changing. This is an attributed name etymology, not a moral verdict about the individuals.

entries.name: Merari
entries.note: H4847 directly supplies bitter; provoke is not separately established.

entries.name: Mercurius
entries.note: G2060 identifies the Greek messenger deity; Acts 14:12 says people called Paul Mercurius because he was chief speaker. The context explains application, not a certain etymology; Paul did not adopt this worship identity. [Strong G2060](https://biblehub.com/greek/2060.htm).

entries.name: Mered
entries.note: Rebellion is supported; ruling is not established by the entry.

entries.name: Meremoth
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Meres
entries.note: H4825 does not establish defluxion/imposthume. [Strong H4825](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4825.htm).

entries.name: Meribah
entries.note: KJV Exodus 17:7 and Numbers 20:13 use the name in distinct wilderness accounts; do not merge places or events solely on spelling.

entries.name: Meribbaal
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for the unhyphenated form; do not confuse the Jonathan-son name with Gideon through a dictionary identification.

entries.name: Merodach
entries.note: Jeremiah 50:2 concerns H4781 Merodach the idol. H192 Evil-merodach and H4757 Merodach-baladan are larger royal-name compounds, not the same bearer. [Strong H4781](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4781.htm).

entries.name: Merodach-baladan
entries.note: H4757 explicitly identifies Merodach-baladan; bitter contrition without judgment is not established.

entries.name: Merom
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Meronothite
entries.note: H4824 is a gentilic; singing/rejoicing/ruling is unestablished. [Strong H4824](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4824.htm).

entries.name: Meroz
entries.note: Strong H4789 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: secret, leanness. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Mesha
entries.displayMeaning: Mesha: departure; safety; foreign place name
entries.note: H4331/H4337/H4338/H4852 are distinct forms/identities sharing the English spelling; Gen 10:30 place is not automatically the Moabite king.

entries.name: Meshach
entries.note: H4335/H4336 identify Meshach as Mishael's imposed Babylonian name in Daniel 1:7 and explicitly mark its significance doubtful; draws with force is unsupported. His faithfulness is grounded in Daniel's narrative, not this uncertain etymology. [Strong H4335](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4335.htm); [Strong H4336](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4336.htm).

entries.name: Meshech
entries.note: Strong warns that the resemblance to the word drawing is only formal; it does not establish a forceful-drawing etymology.

entries.name: Meshelemiah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Meshezaheel
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied references or exact entry for Meshezaheel; do not silently substitute Meshezabeel.

entries.name: Meshillamith
entries.note: H4921 identifies Meshillemith (1 Chronicles 9:12), the likely spelling behind Meshillamith; peace/reconciliation agrees, giving again is not its explicit gloss.

entries.name: Meshullam
entries.note: H4918 selects alliance, not parables; peace/perfection is only a related root association.

entries.name: Mesobaite
entries.note: H4677 supplies a tentative place-name behind the Mesobaite gentilic in 1 Chronicles 11:47; standing-place/little doe is unsupported. [Strong H4677](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4677.htm).

entries.name: Mesopotamia
entries.note: The compound H763 and Greek G3318 support the between-rivers sense. H758 alone is Aram, the broader region, and cannot identify every Mesopotamia occurrence by itself.

entries.name: Messiah
entries.note: Messiah is a title/designation in Daniel 9:25; H4899 also applies to other anointed persons in context.

entries.name: Metheg-ammah
entries.note: H4965 calls it an epithet of Gath; bondage is a different proposed reading, not established here. [Strong H4965](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4965.htm).

entries.name: Methusael
entries.note: Strong H4967 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: who demands his death. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Methusaleh
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Meunim
entries.note: H4586 is a people designation, not afflicted. [Strong H4586](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4586.htm).

entries.name: Mezahab
entries.note: Gilded broadly corresponds to the gold imagery, but Strong explicitly includes water.

entries.name: Miamin
entries.note: H4326 points to H4509; distinguish its several bearers.

entries.name: Mibhar
entries.note: H4006 points to H4005 choice; youth is unsupported. [Strong H4006](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4006.htm).

entries.name: Mibsam
entries.note: Strong H4017 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: smelling sweet. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Mibzar
entries.note: H4014 points to H4013 fortress; defending broadly agrees, taking away is unsupported.

entries.name: Micah
entries.note: H4318/H4320/H4321 link Micah/Micaiah forms to the divine-name question; poor/humble is a conflicting derivation. Several people share the forms. [Strong H4318](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4318.htm); [Strong H4320](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4320.htm); [Strong H4321](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4321.htm).

entries.name: Micaiah
entries.note: The H4318/H4319/H4321/H4322 chain reaches H4320, who is like Jah. Hitchcock gives God rather than the specific Jah element; retain this grammatical/source distinction and the different bearers.

entries.name: Micha
entries.note: H4316/H4318 point to H4320; Hitchcock provides only a Micaiah cross-reference, not an independent gloss.

entries.name: Michaiah
entries.note: H4321/H4322 refer to H4320; Michael is a different form using God rather than Jah. Hitchcock's cross-reference also inherits Micah's unsupported poor/humble gloss. [Strong H4321](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4321.htm); [Strong H4322](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4322.htm).

entries.name: Michal
entries.note: Strong H4324 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: who is perfect?. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Michmach
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Michmethah
entries.note: H4366's Michmethath corresponds to Michmethah in Joshua 16:6; gift/death of a striker is unsupported. [Strong H4366](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4366.htm).

entries.name: Michri
entries.note: Strong H4381 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: selling. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Michtam
entries.note: H4387 is a Psalm heading term rather than a personal name; golden is not its supplied whole-word meaning.

entries.name: Middin
entries.note: H4081 refers to H4080 Midian; Joshua 15:61 identifies a town, not Abraham's son. Do not copy the dictionary's borrowed identity boilerplate into this town's card. [Strong H4081](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4081.htm).

entries.name: Midian
entries.note: Strong links the name to contest/quarrel rather than judgment, covering or habit; distinguish person, people and territory.

entries.name: Migdalel
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Migdalgad
entries.note: H4028 differs from tower compassed about; no supplied reference validates the joined form. [Strong H4028](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4028.htm).

entries.name: Migdol
entries.note: Tower is a plausible Hebrew association but this particular place headword gives probably Egyptian origin, not a corroborating etymology.

entries.name: Migron
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Mijamin
entries.note: H4326 points to H4509. [Strong H4326](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4326.htm).

entries.name: Mikloth
entries.note: The pinned transcription's gloss is rods, not little wants/voices. Its description a place in the Desert is inconsistent with the personal occurrences in 1 Chronicles 8:32 and 9:37; do not reproduce it.

entries.name: Milalai
entries.note: Talk agrees; circumcision is unsupported.

entries.name: Milcah
entries.note: Genesis 11 and Numbers 26 concern different Milcahs; the latter is explicitly a daughter (Numbers 26:33), despite Strong's imprecise Israelite description. [Strong H4435](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4435.htm).

entries.name: Milcom
entries.note: Strong relates Milcom/Malcam to king and Molech. Their king is a concise proposed possessive sense, not an identification with the LORD.

entries.name: Miletum
entries.note: Miletum is the KJV inflected form of Miletus G3399, which gives uncertain origin, not red/scarlet.

entries.name: Millo
entries.note: H4407 gives the fortified structure sense; H1037 is the larger Beth-millo compound, so it should not become another person. Fullness is only a root association. [Strong H1037](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1037.htm); [Strong H4407](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4407.htm).

entries.name: Miniamin
entries.note: Strong explicitly includes Miniamin in its KJV field; the Compare suffix obscured the match.

entries.name: Minneiah
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Minni
entries.note: H4508 does not establish reckoned/prepared. [Strong H4508](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4508.htm).

entries.name: Minnith
entries.note: Strong gives Minnith a distinct enumeration derivation; same as Minni does not establish identity or etymological equivalence.

entries.name: Miriam
entries.note: The lexical proposal is not a blanket judgment about every woman named Miriam.

entries.name: Mishael
entries.note: H4332/H4333 differ substantially from asked/lent. Mishael in Daniel 1:6–7 is given Meshach as his Babylonian name; this does not define his faith. [Strong H4332](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4332.htm); [Strong H4333](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4333.htm).

entries.name: Mishal
entries.note: Strong H4861 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: parables; governing. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Misham
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Misheal
entries.note: H4861 supports requesting, not lent/pit. [Strong H4861](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4861.htm).

entries.name: Mishma
entries.note: Strong H4927, H4926 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: hearing; obeying. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Mishmannah
entries.note: Taking away provision is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Mishraites
entries.note: H4954 tentatively derives the group-name from stretching out. [Strong H4954](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4954.htm).

entries.name: Mispar
entries.note: Strong explicitly identifies Mispar but its H4457 link is the tongs word, an internal digital mismatch; its printed number gloss can be reported only with that caveat. Mispereth needs separate variant review.

entries.name: Misrephoth-maim
entries.note: H4956 supplies this compound; hot waters is a loose inference, not a precise translation.

entries.name: Mithcah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H4989 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H4989](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4989.htm).

entries.name: Mithnite
entries.note: An inhabitant designation, with a probable underlying slenderness name; loin/gift/hope are not established.

entries.name: Mithredath
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Mitylene
entries.note: G3412 differs from purity/cleansing/press. [Strong G3412](https://biblehub.com/greek/3412.htm).

entries.name: Mizar
entries.note: Strong H4706, H4705 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: little. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Mizpah
entries.note: Genesis 31:49 provides a watch-related naming explanation, but no exact Strong candidate supplied here; dictionary comparison incomplete.

entries.name: Mizraim
entries.note: H4714 points to H4693 Egypt at the border, not directly tribulations. The ancestor in Genesis 10:6 and his descendants/territory must be kept distinct. [Strong H4714](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4714.htm).

entries.name: Mizzah
entries.note: Strong H4199 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: defluxion from the head. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Mnason
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Moab
entries.note: Genesis 19:37 grounds the lineage; the descendant, nation and land are distinct referents. [Strong H4124](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4124.htm).

entries.name: Moladah
entries.note: Strong H4137 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: birth; generation. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Molech
entries.note: H4432 supplies Molek/king for the deity designation; not an ordinary person's name.

entries.name: Molid
entries.note: H4140 gives a personal agent sense, not merely nativity/generation. [Strong H4140](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4140.htm).

entries.name: Mordecai
entries.note: Strong H4782 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: contrition; bitter; bruising. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Moreh
entries.note: H4176 points to H4175 teacher/archer/early rain; stretching is not its selected name sense.

entries.name: Moriah
entries.note: H4179 differs from bitterness of the Lord. [Strong H4179](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4179.htm).

entries.name: Moserah
entries.note: H4149 explicitly includes Moserah and Moseroth (Deuteronomy 10:6; Numbers 33:30); shared etymology alone does not resolve every itinerary question.

entries.name: Moses
entries.note: Exodus 2:10 expressly explains the naming by drawing him out of water; retain that scriptural explanation.

entries.name: Mozah
entries.note: H4681 differs from unleavened. [Strong H4681](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/4681.htm).

entries.name: Muppim
entries.note: Strong supplies apparently wavings, not mouth/covering; Genesis 46:21 identifies the Benjaminite.

entries.name: Mushi
entries.note: Touch broadly agrees; withdrawing is not independently established as the name sense.

entries.name: Myra
entries.note: G3460 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong G3460](https://biblehub.com/greek/3460.htm).

entries.name: Mysia
entries.note: Strong G3465 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: criminal; abominable. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Naam
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Naamah
entries.note: H5279 includes different women and a town; Naaman is a distinct name despite the shared root. [Strong H5279](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5279.htm).

entries.name: Naarah
entries.note: The feminine name Naarah is not automatically the same person/form as Naarai; Strong also recognizes a place usage.

entries.name: Naashon
entries.note: Foretelling/conjecturing is broadly related; a lexical proposal does not characterize the bearer.

entries.name: Nabal
entries.note: 1 Samuel 25:25 explicitly makes the name/folly association. [Strong H5037](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5037.htm).

entries.name: Naboth
entries.note: Strong H5022 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: words; prophecies. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nachon
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Nachor
entries.note: G3493 refers to H5152, which includes Abraham's grandfather and brother. Joshua 24:2 mentions Terah as father of Abraham and Nachor, so the Greek dictionary's grandfather-only summary must not govern that Hebrew occurrence. [Strong G3493](https://biblehub.com/greek/3493.htm).

entries.name: Nadab
entries.note: Voluntary generosity is supported; prince is not established as the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Nagge
entries.note: G3477's identification with Nogah H5052 is tentative.

entries.name: Nahaliel
entries.note: H5160 supports valley, not inheritance. [Strong H5160](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5160.htm).

entries.name: Nahallal
entries.note: Strong H5096, H5097 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: praised; bright. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Naham
entries.note: Comfort agrees; leader is unsupported and Nahamani should not be merged automatically.

entries.name: Naharai
entries.note: H5171 differs from nostrils/hot/anger. [Strong H5171](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5171.htm).

entries.name: Nahash
entries.note: Strong H5176, H5175 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: snake; serpent. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nahath
entries.note: Rest agrees; leader is not supplied.

entries.name: Nahbi
entries.note: H5147 gives occult/concealed; its digital KJV field says Nakbi, but lemma and Numbers 13:14 identify Nahbi. [Strong H5147](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5147.htm).

entries.name: Nahor
entries.note: Strong H5152 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: hoarse; dry; hot. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nahshon
entries.note: H5177 is the same name form as Naashon, but Hitchcock only provides a cross-reference.

entries.name: Nahum
entries.note: H5151 supports comfort, not penitent. [Strong H5151](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5151.htm).

entries.name: Nain
entries.note: Strong compares a habitation/pasture word including pleasant place; the Hebrew-origin relationship remains probable.

entries.name: Naioth
entries.note: Habitations agrees; beauties is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Naomi
entries.note: Ruth 1:20 contrasts Naomi with Mara in the narrative. [Strong H5281](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5281.htm).

entries.name: Naphish
entries.note: Strong H5305 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the soul; he that rests, refreshes himself, or respires. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Naphtali
entries.note: Genesis 30:8 explicitly gives the wrestling association; distinguish son, tribe and territory.

entries.name: Narcissus
entries.note: G3488 names the flower and a narcotic association; stupidity is an interpretive extension, not a verdict about the man. [Strong G3488](https://biblehub.com/greek/3488.htm).

entries.name: Nason
entries.note: G3416 identifies Mnason (Acts 21:16), not exact Nason; its origin is uncertain and helper/entry-way is unestablished.

entries.name: Nathan
entries.note: Given agrees; rewarded is not separately established.

entries.name: Nathan-melech
entries.note: H5419 supports gift/king, not counsel. [Strong H5419](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5419.htm).

entries.name: Nathanael
entries.note: Strong G3482, H5417 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the gift of God. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Naum
entries.note: G3486 points to Nahum H5151; the ancestor is not thereby the prophet.

entries.name: Nazareth
entries.note: G3478 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong G3478](https://biblehub.com/greek/3478.htm).

entries.name: Nazarite
entries.note: A vow/status designation (Numbers 6:2,13), not a personal name; distinguish Nazarite from Nazarene.

entries.name: Neah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Neapolis
entries.note: The pinned Strong G3496 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G3496](https://biblehub.com/greek/3496.htm).

entries.name: Neariah
entries.note: Child/servant are related senses of the young-person root; Strong specifically proposes servant.

entries.name: Nebai
entries.note: Budding broadly agrees; speaking/prophesying are not independently selected name meanings.

entries.name: Nebaioth
entries.note: H5032 supports growth/fruitfulness, not words/prophecies. Son and people/land uses are distinct. [Strong H5032](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5032.htm).

entries.name: Neballat
entries.note: Strong H5041 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: prophecy; budding. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nebat
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Nebo
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H5015 includes a deity, mountain and town; speaks/prophesies is unestablished. Isaiah 46:1's deity is not the mountain of Numbers 33:47. [Strong H5015](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5015.htm).

entries.name: Nebuchadnezzar
entries.note: Strong H5019, H5020 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: Nebuchadrezzar, tears and groans of judgment. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Nebushasi_hahban
entries.note: The underscore-containing form has no exact candidate or KJV reference; treat as an apparent transcription artifact pending source review.

entries.name: Nebuzar-adan
entries.note: H5018 does not establish fruit/prophecies of judgment. [Strong H5018](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5018.htm).

entries.name: Necho
entries.note: Strong identifies Necho but provides no lame/beaten derivation; 2 Chronicles 35:20 supplies the KJV king.

entries.name: Nedabiah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Neginoth
entries.note: H5058 is a musical term in Psalm headings, not a person/place. The local witness appends Psalm 4's Neginoth heading to Psalm 3:8 and Psalm 6's heading to Psalm 5:12; those containing verse labels are not correct citations for the headings. [Strong H5058](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5058.htm).

entries.name: Nehelamite
entries.note: Strong proposes a patronymic and a dream-related root; vale/brook are not established. Jeremiah 29:24 identifies Shemaiah with this designation.

entries.name: Nehemiah
entries.note: Consolation agrees; repentance of the Lord is not independently established.

entries.name: Nehum
entries.note: H5149 gives passive comforted, not penitent. [Strong H5149](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5149.htm).

entries.name: Nehushta
entries.note: Strong H5179 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: made of brass. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nehushtan
entries.note: 2 Kings 18:4 concerns the brazen serpent designation; trifling is an interpretive shade rather than a distinct literal metal meaning.

entries.name: Neiel
entries.note: The pinned Strong H5272 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H5272](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5272.htm).

entries.name: Nekoda
entries.note: Strong H5353 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: painted; inconstant. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nemuel
entries.note: H5241 points to Jemuel H3223; sleeping is unsupported.

entries.name: Nepheg
entries.note: H5298 differs from weak/slacked. [Strong H5298](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5298.htm).

entries.name: Nephish
entries.note: 1 Chronicles 5:19's Nephish is a spelling variant of Naphish; Strong H5305 identifies the Ishmaelite name, rather than a separate etymology.

entries.name: Nephishesim
entries.note: Nehemiah 7:52 supplies a family designation; no exact candidate supplied for this form.

entries.name: Nephthalim
entries.note: G3508 explicitly equates the form with Naphtali H5321; Matthew uses the tribal/territorial designation. [Strong G3508](https://biblehub.com/greek/3508.htm).

entries.name: Nephthoah
entries.note: H5318 identifies Nephtoach; its KJV field Neptoah is a transcription/spelling problem. Joshua 15:9 and 18:15 print Nephtoah, not the exact Hitchcock Nephthoah form.

entries.name: Nephusim
entries.note: H5304 derives from scatter; Hitchcock only redirects to a differently spelled form and gives no independent meaning.

entries.name: Ner
entries.note: H5369 supports lamp, not new-tilled land. [Strong H5369](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5369.htm).

entries.name: Nereus
entries.note: Strong relates Nereus to a sea/wet root, not the Hebrew personal name Ner; the bare same as Ner is uncorroborated.

entries.name: Nergal
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Nergal-sharezer
entries.note: H5371 names two Babylonians; H8272 supplies foreign origin without establishing treasurer, so that gloss remains uncorroborated. [Strong H5371](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5371.htm).

entries.name: Neri
entries.note: Strong relates Neri to Neriah, light of Jah, rather than my light.

entries.name: Neriah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Nethaneel
entries.note: H5417 supports the relation to Nathanael as a cognate form, not identity of all bearers. [Strong H5417](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5417.htm).

entries.name: Nethaniah
entries.note: Strong H5418 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the gift of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nethinims
entries.note: A service-group designation, not one person's name.

entries.name: Neziah
entries.note: H5335 differs from conqueror/strong. [Strong H5335](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5335.htm).

entries.name: Nezib
entries.note: Strong H5334 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: standing-place. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nibhaz
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Nibshan
entries.note: H5044 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H5044](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5044.htm).

entries.name: Nicanor
entries.note: Strong G3527 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a conqueror; victorious. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nicodemus
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Nicolaitanes
entries.note: G3531 supplies the lexical group designation; Revelation 2:6 and 2:15 directly attest the plural Nicolaitanes. This does not prove identity with the Nicolas of Acts 6:5. [Strong G3531](https://biblehub.com/greek/3531.htm).

entries.name: Nicolas
entries.note: G3532 prints Nicolaus while Acts 6:5 has Nicolas; Nicodemus is a distinct Greek name (G3530) and person. The snapshot's heretic label is historical commentary, not an identification established by Acts 6:5.

entries.name: Nicopolis
entries.note: G3533 identifies a location but Titus 3:12 alone does not establish a modern geographical identification.

entries.name: Niger
entries.note: G3526 identifies Simon's surname; color-derived etymology alone establishes no further ethnic biography. [Strong G3526](https://biblehub.com/greek/3526.htm).

entries.name: Nimrah
entries.note: Strong gives Nimrah clear water; Nimrim is a related but separate form and context, not automatic identity.

entries.name: Nimrod
entries.note: Hitchcock itself qualifies rebellion with probably an unknown Assyrian word; preserve the uncertainty rather than assigning moral significance.

entries.name: Nimshi
entries.note: The pinned Strong H5250 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H5250](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5250.htm).

entries.name: Nineveh
entries.note: Strong H5210 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: handsome; agreeable. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Nisan
entries.note: Month name, not a personal name; no standard/miracle derivation supplied.

entries.name: Nisroch
entries.note: H5268 does not establish flight/proof/temptation/delicate. [Strong H5268](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5268.htm).

entries.name: No
entries.note: The proper name No (Jeremiah 46:25; Ezekiel 30:14) is an Egyptian city. Do not match the common English word no or derive it from forbidding.

entries.name: Noadiah
entries.note: H5129 covers a man and a prophetess; witness/ornament is not its supplied derivation.

entries.name: Noah
entries.displayMeaning: Noah the patriarch: rest; Noah daughter of Zelophehad: movement
entries.note: H5146 rest differs from H5270 movement. Genesis 5:29 supplies consolation wordplay for the patriarch; Numbers 26:33,27:1 name the woman. Do not merge their identities or replace the woman's sense with rest. [Strong H5146](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5146.htm); [Strong H5270](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5270.htm).

entries.name: Nob
entries.note: Strong H5011 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: discourse; prophecy. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nobah
entries.note: Person and place share the name in Numbers 32:42; distinguish their references.

entries.name: Nod
entries.note: The pinned Strong H5113 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H5113](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5113.htm).

entries.name: Nodab
entries.note: Strong H5114 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: vowing of his own accord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Noe
entries.note: G3575 points to Noah H5146; Hitchcock provides only an alias cross-reference.

entries.name: Nogah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H5052 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H5052](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5052.htm).

entries.name: Noha
entries.note: H5119's Nohah (1 Chronicles 8:2) is the likely underlying form; the input Noha spelling needs correction before exact KJV display.

entries.name: Non
entries.note: H5126 concerns Joshua's father. Supplied G137 is Aenon, a place, falsely matched through its digital spelling; exclude it from Non.

entries.name: Noph
entries.note: H5297 refers to H4644, not honeycomb/distillation. The source inconsistently calls Noph Upper Egypt but Moph Lower Egypt; flag the geography boilerplate rather than propagate it. [Strong H5297](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5297.htm).

entries.name: Nophah
entries.note: Strong H5302 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fearful; binding. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Nun
entries.note: H5126 is Nun/Non; Hitchcock's cross-reference supplies no independent meaning.

entries.name: Nymphas
entries.note: G3564 gives a tentative compound with gift, not simply spouse/bridegroom. KJV Colossians 4:15 supplies the bearer; the etymology is not biography. [Strong G3564](https://biblehub.com/greek/3564.htm).

entries.name: Obadiah
entries.note: Strong H5662 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: servant of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Obal
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Obed
entries.note: H5744/G5601 include distinct bearers; Ruth 4 identifies Jesse's father. [Strong H5744](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5744.htm); [Strong G5601](https://biblehub.com/greek/5601.htm).

entries.name: Obed-edom
entries.note: Strong H5654 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: servant of Edom. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Obil
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Oboth
entries.note: H88 differs from dragons/fathers/desires. [Strong H88](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/88.htm).

entries.name: Ocran
entries.note: Strong H5918 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a disturber; that disorders. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Oded
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Og
entries.note: H5747 differs from cake as the direct name gloss. [Strong H5747](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5747.htm).

entries.name: Ohad
entries.note: Strong H161 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: praising; confessing. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ohel
entries.note: Tent/tabernacle agrees; brightness is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Olympas
entries.note: G3652 marks the contraction tentative; this historical name background does not define the Christian's worship. [Strong G3652](https://biblehub.com/greek/3652.htm).

entries.name: Omar
entries.note: Speaking is supported; bitter is not established.

entries.name: Omega
entries.note: A letter used as a divine designation in Revelation, not an ordinary personal name.

entries.name: Omri
entries.note: H6018 differs from the more specific sheaf of corn. [Strong H6018](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6018.htm).

entries.name: On
entries.note: Numbers 16:1 names On son of Peleth (H203); Genesis 41:45 names the Egyptian city (H204). Pain/iniquity must not be assigned indiscriminately to either.

entries.name: Onam
entries.note: H208 gives strong but Hitchcock only points to On/Onan; do not collapse their identities.

entries.name: Onesimus
entries.note: Philemon 11 makes the useful/unprofitable wordplay. [Strong G3682](https://biblehub.com/greek/3682.htm).

entries.name: Onesiphorus
entries.note: G3683 explicitly identifies Onesiphorus but misspells its KJV field Onespiphorus. 2 Timothy 1:16 and 4:19 confirm the textual spelling.

entries.name: Ono
entries.note: Strength agrees; grief/iniquity is not independently supplied by H207.

entries.name: Ophel
entries.note: H6077 points to H6076; tower is related, darkness/cloud is unsupported. [Strong H6077](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6077.htm).

entries.name: Ophir
entries.note: Strong H211 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fruitful region. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Ophni
entries.note: H6078 is framed as an inhabitant adjective, while Joshua 18:24 lists a town; do not silently substitute one category for the other.

entries.name: Ophrah
entries.note: H6084 supports fawn, not dust/lead; a man and two places share the form. [Strong H6084](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6084.htm).

entries.name: Oreb
entries.note: Strong H6159, H6158 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a raven. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ornan
entries.note: Ornan H771 is the alternate name connected with Araunah; rejoice is unsupported.

entries.name: Orpah
entries.note: H6204 points to H6203 nape, not skull. [Strong H6204](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6204.htm).

entries.name: Oshea
entries.note: Numbers 13:16 explicitly says Moses called Oshea Jehoshua. That named person's relationship does not make all Hoshea/Oshea and Joshua bearers identical.

entries.name: Othni
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Othniel
entries.note: H6274 differs from hour of God. [Strong H6274](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6274.htm).

entries.name: Ozem
entries.note: Strong H684 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that fasts; their eagerness. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ozias
entries.note: G3604 points to Uzziah H5818; do not identify every Uzziah with the king in Matthew.

entries.name: Ozni
entries.note: The pinned Strong H244 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H244](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/244.htm).

entries.name: Paarai
entries.note: Strong H6474 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: opening. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Padan-aram
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Padon
entries.note: H6303 supports redemption, not ox-yoke. [Strong H6303](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6303.htm).

entries.name: Pagiel
entries.note: This is the snapshot's proposed lexical gloss, not an assertion about divine providence or a description of the person. Hitchcock gives competing prevention/prayer glosses.

entries.name: Pahath-Moab
entries.note: H6355 points to pit H6354, whereas Hitchcock gives ruler. This discrepancy requires checking the original printing before adopting a confident title etymology.

entries.name: Pai
entries.note: H6464 records Pai/Pau as variants. [Strong H6464](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6464.htm).

entries.name: Palal
entries.note: Strong H6420 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: thinking. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Palestina
entries.note: H6429 gives rolling/migratory, not watered or causes ruin.

entries.name: Pallu
entries.note: H6396 differs from hidden; marvelous is only a loose association. [Strong H6396](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6396.htm).

entries.name: Palti
entries.note: Deliverance agrees; flight is not the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Paltiel
entries.note: Deliverance agrees; banishment is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Pamphylia
entries.note: G3828 supports the sense, but its digital derivation cites G4443 fire where G5443 tribe is expected; verify original before assigning the error to Strong's printed edition. [Strong G3828](https://biblehub.com/greek/3828.htm).

entries.name: Paphos
entries.note: Strong G3974 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: which boils, or is very hot. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Parah
entries.note: H6511 points to H6510; increasing is not independently selected as the place name meaning.

entries.name: Paran
entries.note: The pinned Strong H6290 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H6290](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6290.htm).

entries.name: Parbar
entries.note: The source gives foreign origin and identifies a Jerusalem quarter, without establishing suburb as its etymology. KJV 1 Chronicles 26:18 uses a location designation.

entries.name: Parmashta
entries.note: Esther 9:9 provides the personal identity, but no exact candidate supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Parmenas
entries.note: The pinned Strong G3937 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G3937](https://biblehub.com/greek/3937.htm).

entries.name: Parnach
entries.note: Strong H6535 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a bull striking, or struck. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Parosh
entries.note: H6551 points to H6550; fruit of a moth is not a separate supported meaning. The digital description our Israelite appears corrupt.

entries.name: Parshandatha
entries.note: H6577 does not establish given by prayer. [Strong H6577](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6577.htm).

entries.name: Paruah
entries.note: Flourishing agrees; flies away is not established.

entries.name: Pasach
entries.note: Broken piece broadly relates to division; Strong gives an agent form.

entries.name: Pasdammin
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference or exact entry for Pasdammin; H6450 Pas-dammim is a possible form requiring confirmation.

entries.name: Paseah
entries.note: Halting agrees; passing over is not the actual name gloss supplied.

entries.name: Pashur
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Patara
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign place-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: G3959 does not establish trodden under foot. [Strong G3959](https://biblehub.com/greek/3959.htm).

entries.name: Pathros
entries.note: Strong does not establish mouthful of dough/persuasion of ruin; Pathrusim is an ethnic form and needs separate context.

entries.name: Patmos
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Patrobas
entries.note: G3969 differs from following the father's steps and marks the contraction tentative. [Strong G3969](https://biblehub.com/greek/3969.htm).

entries.name: Pau
entries.note: Strong explicitly includes Pau and Pai as variants; Hitchcock's cross-reference alone does not itself supply the lexical sense.

entries.name: Paul
entries.note: G3972 covers both an apostle and a Roman; separate Saul/Paul from Sergius Paulus in context.

entries.name: Paulus
entries.note: G3972 covers the proconsul and apostle; Acts 13:7 is Sergius Paulus, not the apostle. [Strong G3972](https://biblehub.com/greek/3972.htm).

entries.name: Pedahzur
entries.note: Strong H6301 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: strong or powerful savior; stone of redemption. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Pedaiah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Pekah
entries.note: H6492 differs from at liberty; opening is a root association. [Strong H6492](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6492.htm).

entries.name: Pekahiah
entries.note: Strong H6494 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: it is the Lord that opens. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Pekod
entries.note: H6489 describes a symbolic Babylonian designation; noble/rulers is a differing historical analysis.

entries.name: Pelaiah
entries.note: H6411 differs from Lord's secret/miracle. [Strong H6411](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6411.htm).

entries.name: Pelaliah
entries.note: Strong H6421 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: entreating the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Pelatiah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Peleg
entries.note: Genesis 10:25 explains Peleg through the earth being divided; H6389 glosses earthquake despite pointing to H6388 stream. Preserve the KJV explanation and expose the lexical difference. [Strong H6389](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6389.htm).

entries.name: Pelethites
entries.note: A collective guard/messenger designation, not the name of one individual; judges/destroyers are not the snapshot's gloss.

entries.name: Pelonite
entries.displayMeaning: Inhabitant of an unknown Palon; separate-related
entries.note: An inhabitant adjective with an unused place name; falling/secret is not supplied.

entries.name: Peniel
entries.note: Genesis 32:30 explicitly explains Peniel; H6439 also covers Penuel and distinct personal bearers. [Strong H6439](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6439.htm).

entries.name: Peninnah
entries.note: Strong tentatively derives Peninnah from a probably pearl word; precious stone broadly agrees, face is not established.

entries.name: Pentapolis
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV occurrence supplied; do not add it as an established KJV personal/place name.

entries.name: Pentateuch
entries.note: No supplied KJV reference or Strong entry identifies Pentateuch as a person/place.

entries.name: Pentecost
entries.note: Pentecost names a festival, not a person or place; the fiftieth sense is explicitly supported.

entries.name: Penuel
entries.note: H6439 supplies the lexical proposal; Hitchcock only gives an alias cross-reference. Distinguish people from the Genesis place.

entries.name: Peor
entries.note: H6465 identifies the mountain; H1187 is the larger Baal-peor deity compound, not automatically the mountain's identity. [Strong H1187](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/1187.htm); [Strong H6465](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6465.htm).

entries.name: Perazim
entries.note: Strong H6559 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: divisions. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Peresh
entries.note: H6570 points to H6569, which explicitly gives excrement/dung. This is a documented dictionary disagreement, not a moral description or a demand to replace the historical gloss offensively.

entries.name: Perez
entries.note: H6557 points to H6556; divided is compatible in the broad break/breach sense. [Strong H6557](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6557.htm).

entries.name: Perez-Uzza
entries.note: 1 Chronicles 13:11 names Perez-uzza in relation to Uzza; strength is a proposed root substitution rather than the compound's explicit personal-name element.

entries.name: Perga
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Pergamos
entries.note: G4010 differs from height/elevation. [Strong G4010](https://biblehub.com/greek/4010.htm).

entries.name: Perida
entries.note: Strong H6514 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: separation; division. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Perizzites
entries.note: H6522 is an ethnic designation and broadly agrees with village/open-country habitation.

entries.name: Persia
entries.note: H6539/H6540 do not establish cuts/nail/gryphon/horseman. [Strong H6539](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6539.htm); [Strong H6540](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6540.htm).

entries.name: Persis
entries.note: Strong gives a feminine ethnic name; Persis in Romans 16:12 is a woman, not the territory Persia.

entries.name: Peruda
entries.note: H6514 supplies the proposal; Hitchcock only redirects to Perida.

entries.name: Peter
entries.note: G4074 identifies the apostle's name; the lexical comparison is not a theological conclusion. [Strong G4074](https://biblehub.com/greek/4074.htm).

entries.name: Pethahiah
entries.note: H6611 identifies Pethachjah but its KJV field Pethakiah is misspelt; 1 Chronicles 24:16 and Ezra 10:23 print Pethahiah. Gate is not the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Pethuel
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Peulthai
entries.note: H6469 differs in grammatical construction from my works. [Strong H6469](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6469.htm).

entries.name: Phalec
