entries.note: G5317 explicitly identifies Phalec with Peleg; Luke 3:35 supplies the genealogy. The snapshot's son of Shem is not a precise immediate-parent statement; Genesis 10:25 names Eber as father.

entries.name: Phallu
entries.note: Admirable broadly agrees; hidden is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Phalti
entries.note: H6406 supports deliverance, not flight; name forms Palti/Phalti belong to different bearers in different passages. [Strong H6406](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6406.htm).

entries.name: Phalti Palti
entries.note: Phalti Palti is a combined spelling label, not one exact KJV name; 1 Samuel 25:44 has Phalti and Numbers 13:9 Palti. Do not invent a composite person.

entries.name: Phanuel
entries.note: G5323 points to Penuel H6439; vision is a looser paraphrase.

entries.name: Pharaoh
entries.note: H6547/G5328 establish a title used by many kings; disperses/spoils is unsupported, and all Pharaoh references cannot form one person's biography. [Strong H6547](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6547.htm); [Strong G5328](https://biblehub.com/greek/5328.htm).

entries.name: Pharez
entries.note: Genesis 38:29 expressly connects Pharez with breach; other bearers and the family must retain their own contexts.

entries.name: Pharisees
entries.note: G5330 provides this group-name analysis; it is not one person's name.

entries.name: Pharpar
entries.note: H6554 differs from produces fruit. [Strong H6554](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6554.htm).

entries.name: Phebe
entries.note: Strong supports bright; pure is not the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Phenice
entries.note: G5403 and G5405 refer to distinct locations; Acts 11:19 concerns the region, Acts 27:12 the Cretan haven. Red/purple is not supplied as the selected meaning.

entries.name: Phichol
entries.note: The pinned Strong H6369 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H6369](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6369.htm).

entries.name: Philadelphia
entries.note: The city's name is associated with a Pergamene king's designation; the common love-of-brother word and the city are distinct lexical uses.

entries.name: Philemon
entries.note: G5371 gives friendly, not specifically who kisses.

entries.name: Philetus
entries.note: 2 Timothy 2:17 identifies the man in a specific teaching context; the gloss does not describe his moral character. [Strong G5372](https://biblehub.com/greek/5372.htm).

entries.name: Philip
entries.note: Lover of horses is supported; warlike is not the explicit gloss. Different rulers and disciples named Philip require separate identities.

entries.name: Philippi
entries.note: G5375 covers the Macedonian city; Matthew 16:13 concerns Caesarea Philippi, a distinct place with a Philip-related qualifier. Do not merge their verse records.

entries.name: Philistines
entries.note: H6430 is the gentilic from H6429 Pelesheth, which supplies migratory, not village dwellers. Keep people and territory distinct. [Strong H6430](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6430.htm); [Strong H6429](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6429.htm).

entries.name: Philologus
entries.note: Strong G5378 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a lover of letters, or of the word. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Phinehas
entries.note: H6372 explicitly qualifies its derivation; bold aspect/trust is not corroborated. This lexical proposal is not a judgment of the priest's character.

entries.name: Phlegon
entries.note: The pinned Strong G5393 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G5393](https://biblehub.com/greek/5393.htm).

entries.name: Phrygia
entries.note: Strong G5435 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: dry; barren. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Phurah
entries.note: Growth broadly agrees; fruit-bearing is more specific than H6513 establishes.

entries.name: Phygellus
entries.note: The pinned Strong G5436 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G5436](https://biblehub.com/greek/5436.htm).

entries.name: Phylacteries
entries.note: Matthew 23:5 uses phylacteries for objects, not persons or places; G5440 supplies guard-case rather than things to be observed.

entries.name: Pi-beseth
entries.note: H6364 does not supply the Bast derivation, so it remains an uncorroborated historical proposal here.

entries.name: Pi-hahiroth
entries.note: H6367 supports a pass/gorge association rather than requiring Hiroth to be a separately identified person. [Strong H6367](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6367.htm).

entries.name: Pilate
entries.note: Strong G4091 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: armed with a dart. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Pinon
entries.note: H6373 probably points to Punon H6325; pearl/gem/beholder is not supplied.

entries.name: Piram
entries.note: H6502 derives from H6501 wild ass; the suffix of them is not specified. [Strong H6502](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6502.htm).

entries.name: Pirathon
entries.note: Strong H6552 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: his dissipation or deprivation; his rupture. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Pisgah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Pisidia
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign region-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: G4099 does not establish pitch/pitchy. [Strong G4099](https://biblehub.com/greek/4099.htm).

entries.name: Pison
entries.note: Strong H6376 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: changing; extension of the mouth. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Pithom
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Pithon
entries.note: H6377 differs from mouthful/persuasion. [Strong H6377](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6377.htm).

entries.name: Pochereth
entries.note: H6380 is Pochereth of Zebaim, the full designation in Ezra 2:57 and Nehemiah 7:59. A truncated Pochereth should retain the full name, not cutting of mouth of warfare.

entries.name: Pontius
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Pontus
entries.note: The pinned Strong G4195 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G4195](https://biblehub.com/greek/4195.htm).

entries.name: Poratha
entries.note: Strong H6334 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fruitful. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Potiphar
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Potipherah
entries.note: H6319 does not establish scatters/demolishes fat; supplied Potipherah lacks KJV references, whose printed form is Poti-pherah (Genesis 41:45). [Strong H6319](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6319.htm).

entries.name: Prisca
entries.note: Strong G4251 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: ancient. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Priscilla
entries.note: G4252 is a diminutive of G4251 ancient; same person/variant forms must be established by context.

entries.name: Prochorus
entries.displayMeaning: before the dance; leader of a chorus
entries.note: G4402 supplies the before/dance components; presiding over choirs is a compatible traditional interpretation. [Strong G4402](https://biblehub.com/greek/4402.htm).

entries.name: Puah
entries.note: Exodus 1:15's midwife Puah is H6326 (brilliancy); Judges 10:1's Puah is H6312 (blast). One spelling hides distinct Hebrew names.

entries.name: Publius
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Pudens
entries.note: The pinned Strong G4227 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G4227](https://biblehub.com/greek/4227.htm).

entries.name: Pul
entries.note: Strong H6322 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: bean; destruction. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Punites
entries.note: H6324 proposes a place/name root meaning turn, not behold/my face; an ethnic adjective.

entries.name: Punon
entries.note: H6325 differs from precious stone/beholds. [Strong H6325](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6325.htm).

entries.name: Pur
entries.note: Esther 3:7 and 9:24 explicitly explain Pur as the lot; Purim names the associated days. This is a common word/festival designation, not a personal name.

entries.name: Puteoli
entries.note: Sulphureous is more specific than G4223 establishes.

entries.name: Putiel
entries.note: H6317 differs from fatness. This source-dependent etymology does not establish the bearer's attitude toward God. [Strong H6317](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6317.htm).

entries.name: Quartus
entries.note: Strong G2890 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: fourth. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Raamah
entries.note: H7484 refers to H7483; thunder agrees, evil is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Raamiah
entries.note: H7485 differs from evil from the Lord; thunder is only a related shaking association. [Strong H7485](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7485.htm).

entries.name: Rab-saris
entries.note: A court official's title/designation, not an ordinary given name. Preserve distinct Assyrian (2 Kings 18:17) and Babylonian (Jeremiah 39:3) uses.

entries.name: Rab-shakeh
entries.note: An official title; 2 Kings 18:17 concerns the king of Assyria's official. H7262's Babylonian label must not override the KJV setting.

entries.name: Rabbah
entries.note: H7237 supports great, not contentious; two different places share the name. [Strong H7237](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7237.htm).

entries.name: Rabbi
entries.note: A title of address (Matthew 23:7,8), not a personal proper name. Rabboni is a related address form requiring its own Greek entry.

entries.name: Rabmag
entries.note: H7248 identifies an official title, not a Hebrew phrase for destroying multitudes.

entries.name: Raca
entries.note: G4469 is a term of contempt in Matthew 5:22, not the name of a person. [Strong G4469](https://biblehub.com/greek/4469.htm).

entries.name: Rachab
entries.note: Matthew 1:5's Rachab is the woman's name; preserve it separately from the Hebrew Rahab epithet for Egypt.

entries.name: Rachal
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Rachel
entries.note: The pinned Strong H7354/G4478 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H7354](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7354.htm); [Strong G4478](https://biblehub.com/greek/4478.htm).

entries.name: Raddai
entries.note: Ruling is supported; coming down is not established.

entries.name: Ragau
entries.note: G4466 points to Reu H7466; shepherd is not independently selected.

entries.name: Raguel
entries.note: H7467 supports friend, not shepherd. Numbers 10:29's kinship language must be read in context; Strong's summary alone does not settle every Reuel/Raguel bearer. [Strong H7467](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7467.htm).

entries.name: Rahab
entries.note: H7294 is Egypt's boastful epithet; H7343 is Joshua 2:1's woman with a different Hebrew spelling. H7343's proud gloss and G4460's G7343 cross-reference require source review; do not apply Egypt's hostile epithet as a moral description of Rahab.

entries.name: Raham
entries.note: Compassion agrees; friend is not supplied as the selected name sense.

entries.name: Rakkath
entries.note: H7557 differs from empty/temple of the head. [Strong H7557](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7557.htm).

entries.name: Rakkon
entries.note: Strong H7542 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: vain; void; mountain of enjoyment. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ram
entries.note: H7410 supplies high; elevated/sublime broadly agrees.

entries.name: Ramah
entries.note: H7414 refers to H7413 height; Ram is a different form and the four Ramah locations must remain distinct. [Strong H7414](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7414.htm).

entries.name: Ramath
entries.note: Joshua 19:8 prints Ramath of the south; H7418 identifies this compound and supports height. Ramatha is not independently established by the supplied row.

entries.name: Ramath-lehi
entries.note: Judges 15:17 supplies the naming context; a place rather than a person.

entries.name: Ramath-mizpeh
entries.note: The pinned Strong H7434 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H7434](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7434.htm).

entries.name: Ramathaim-zophim
entries.note: Strong H7436 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the two watch-towers. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ramiah
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Ramoth
entries.note: H7216 names two places; do not merge all Ramoth references. [Strong H7216](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7216.htm).

entries.name: Raphah
entries.note: H7498 expressly includes Raphah as a Rapha variant, giant; 1 Chronicles 8:2 prints Raphah. The equation with Raphu and relaxation/physic/comfort is not established by this name entry.

entries.name: Reaiah
entries.note: Vision broadly relates to seeing, but Strong supplies Jah as subject.

entries.name: Reba
entries.note: H7254 points to H7253; lies/stoops is unsupported. [Strong H7254](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7254.htm).

entries.name: Rebekah
entries.note: Strong proposes an unused fetlock-tying root, not fattened/appeased. Both are historical lexical explanations, not biblical descriptions of Rebekah.

entries.name: Rechab
entries.note: Four horses/square is not supplied by H7394.

entries.name: Reelaiah
entries.note: H7480 identifies Reelaiah through lemma though digital KJV field says Reeliah; shepherd/companion is unsupported. [Strong H7480](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7480.htm).

entries.name: Regem
entries.note: A stone connection is supported; purple is not established.

entries.name: Regemmelech
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Rehabiah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H7345 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H7345](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7345.htm).

entries.name: Rehob
entries.note: Strong recognizes multiple persons and places. Context, not a shared breadth sense, must establish their identities.

entries.name: Rehoboam
entries.note: Liberty is a looser historical paraphrase of enlargement, not an independently proved etymology.

entries.name: Rehoboth
entries.note: H7344 lists different places; Genesis 26:22 supplies the room/space explanation. [Strong H7344](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7344.htm).

entries.name: Rehpaim
entries.note: Rehpaim appears transposed; H7497 gives Rephaim/giants. Physicians/relaxed are not the explicit sense of that word; confirm the intended spelling before display.

entries.name: Rehum
entries.note: H7348 points to H7349.

entries.name: Rei
entries.note: H7472 supports companion, not shepherd; my friend is a different grammatical interpretation. [Strong H7472](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7472.htm).

entries.name: Rekem
entries.note: Divers-colored/pictures broadly agrees; vain is not established.

entries.name: Remaliah
entries.note: H7425's unused-root sense is tentative; exaltation is not the supplied meaning.

entries.name: Remmon
entries.note: H7417 points to H7416; greatness/elevation is unsupported for this town. The same dictionary entry also names other places and a deity. [Strong H7417](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7417.htm).

entries.name: Remphan
entries.note: Strong calls this a transliteration of Chiun, not prepared/arrayed. Its Egyptian idol classification is historical commentary; Acts 7:43 supplies the biblical referent.

entries.name: Rephael
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Rephaiah
entries.note: H7509 supports healing, with the subject clearer than medicine of the Lord. [Strong H7509](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7509.htm).

entries.name: Rephidim
entries.note: The snapshot gives ballusters; beds/rest is a competing explanation, not established by the given entry.

entries.name: Resen
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Reu
entries.note: H7466 supports friend, not shepherd. [Strong H7466](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7466.htm).

entries.name: Reuben
entries.note: Strong uses an imperative, not one who sees. Genesis 29:32 provides Leah's narrative explanation and governs its biblical presentation.

entries.name: Reuel
entries.note: Friend agrees; shepherd is not independently selected in H7467.

entries.name: Reumah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H7208 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H7208](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7208.htm).

entries.name: Rezeph
entries.note: Coal is supported; pavement is not the explicit gloss of the linked word here.

entries.name: Rezin
entries.note: H7526 probably points to H7522; messenger is unsupported.

entries.name: Rezon
entries.note: H7331 supports prince, not lean/small/secret. [Strong H7331](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7331.htm).

entries.name: Rhegium
entries.note: Strong G4484 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: rupture; fracture. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Rhesa
entries.note: G4488 apparently points to Rephaiah H7509; will/course is not supplied.

entries.name: Rhoda
entries.note: The pinned Strong G4498 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong G4498](https://biblehub.com/greek/4498.htm).

entries.name: Rhodes
entries.note: Strong proposes a rose connection, while Rhoda is a different named woman; an etymological relationship does not identify island and person.

entries.name: Ribai
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Riblah
entries.note: H7247 differs from quarrel/greatness to him. [Strong H7247](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7247.htm).

entries.name: Rimmon
entries.note: Pomegranate is supported; exalted is not the explicit headword gloss. Deity, places, and the man Rimmon in 2 Samuel 4:2 must be distinguished; the snapshot's abbreviated identity list is incomplete.

entries.name: Rinnah
entries.note: H7441 points to H7440; the shout may express joy or grief.

entries.name: Riphath
entries.note: H7384 does not establish remedy/release/pardon; the ancestor and descendants are distinct referents. [Strong H7384](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7384.htm).

entries.name: Rissah
entries.note: Strong H7446 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: watering; distillation; dew. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Rithmah
entries.note: H7575 points to H7574, whose KJV gloss is juniper and botanical proposal is Spanish broom; noise is unsupported.

entries.name: Rizpah
entries.displayMeaning: hot stone; live coal or pavement
entries.note: H7532 points to H7531; coal is supported, bed/extension not supplied. [Strong H7532](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7532.htm).

entries.name: Rogelim
entries.note: Strong H7274 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a foot or footman. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Rohgah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Romamti-ezer
entries.displayMeaning: I have raised up a help
entries.note: H7320 differs in grammatical construction from exaltation of help. [Strong H7320](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7320.htm).

entries.name: Roman
entries.note: A civic/ethnic designation, not a given name; Strong derives Roman from Rome, not directly strong/powerful.

entries.name: Rome
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Rosh
entries.note: H7220 points to H7218; Genesis 46:21 names the man. A possible foreign-nation referent is separate. [Strong H7220](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7220.htm).

entries.name: Rufus
entries.note: Mark 15:21 and Romans 16:13 share the name; identification as the same man is a separate historical inference.

entries.name: Ruhamah
entries.note: A symbolic designation rather than a separate ordinary person's name; H7355 is the underlying verb, not a dedicated proper-name entry.

entries.name: Rumah
entries.note: H7316 supports exalted association, not rejected. [Strong H7316](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7316.htm).

entries.name: Ruth
entries.note: Strong H7327, G4503 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: drunk; satisfied. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Sabaoth
entries.note: G4519 supplies hosts; Lord belongs to the surrounding title Lord of Sabaoth, not to this word alone.

entries.name: Sabeans
entries.displayMeaning: Sabeans: people of Sheba/Seba; disputed drinkers reading in Ezekiel
entries.note: H7614/H7615 relate to Sheba; H5436 to Seba. H5433 also lists Sabean as a rendering associated with drinking, pertinent to Ezekiel 23:42. Do not force captivity/conversion/old age or one people-origin on all three contexts. [Strong H7614](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7614.htm); [Strong H7615](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7615.htm); [Strong H5436](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5436.htm); [Strong H5433](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5433.htm).

entries.name: Sabtah
entries.note: Strong H5454 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a going about or circuiting; old age. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Sabtechah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Sacar
entries.note: The pinned Strong H7940 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H7940](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7940.htm).

entries.name: Sadducees
entries.note: A sect designation, not an individual name; Strong's origin from Zadok is probable and its historical descriptions are commentary.

entries.name: Sadoc
entries.note: G4524 points to Zadok H6659.

entries.name: Salah
entries.note: H7974 points to H7973, whose direct senses differ from mission/sending. [Strong H7974](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7974.htm).

entries.name: Salamis
entries.note: Strong G4529 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: shaken; test; beaten. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Salathiel
entries.note: G4528 and Hebrew H7597 cover the form; asked agrees, lent is not independently selected.

entries.name: Salcah
entries.note: H5548 differs from thy basket/lifting up. [Strong H5548](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5548.htm).

entries.name: Salem
entries.note: Hebrews 7:2 explicitly interprets Salem as peace. Complete/perfect is a related root sense, not a reason to replace that biblical explanation.

entries.name: Salim
entries.note: G4530 probably relates to G4531 shaking; foxes/fists/path are unsupported by this comparison.

entries.name: Sallai
entries.note: H5543 records Sallai/Sallu variants, not exaltation/basket. [Strong H5543](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5543.htm).

entries.name: Salma
entries.note: Strong H8007 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: peace; perfection. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Salmon
entries.note: G4533 points to H8012/H8008; do not derive Salmon from the similar peace root.

entries.name: Salome
entries.note: G4539 refers to H7965 peace; Salmon is a distinct name, not a meaning by itself. [Strong G4539](https://biblehub.com/greek/4539.htm).

entries.name: Samaria
entries.note: KJV 1 Kings 16:24 expressly links the city name to the hill's owner Shemer; Strong's root proposal should not replace the narrative explanation.

entries.name: Samlah
entries.note: H8072 probably relates to H8071; left hand/astonishment is not supplied.

entries.name: Samos
entries.note: G4544 explicitly marks affinity uncertain. [Strong G4544](https://biblehub.com/greek/4544.htm).

entries.name: Samothracia
entries.note: Strong gives a geographical compound, not proof that the island was possessed jointly by two peoples.

entries.name: Samson
entries.note: Sun agrees; service and second time are not independently supplied.

entries.name: Samuel
entries.displayMeaning: heard of God; KJV narrative associates asking
entries.note: H8050/G4545 give heard of God; 1 Samuel 1:20 explains Hannah's naming because she asked him of the LORD. Preserve that narrative alongside the lexical proposal. [Strong H8050](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8050.htm); [Strong G4545](https://biblehub.com/greek/4545.htm).

entries.name: Sanballat
entries.note: Strong H5571 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: bramble-bush; enemy in secret. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Sanhedrin
entries.note: No KJV occurrence supplied for this English form; institutional term, not a personal name.

entries.name: Sansannah
entries.note: H5578 supports bough, not the added enemy. [Strong H5578](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5578.htm).

entries.name: Saph
entries.note: Strong H5593 relates the Philistine's name to H5592; rushes/sea-moss are not established by that entry.

entries.name: Saphir
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Sapphira
entries.note: G4551 points to G4552 sapphire, not relates/tells. [Strong G4551](https://biblehub.com/greek/4551.htm).

entries.name: Sarah
entries.note: Sarah Abraham's wife is H8283 (princess); Numbers 26:46's Sarah daughter of Asher is H8294 (Serah, superfluity). Do not merge the women or impose one etymology on both.

entries.name: Sarai
entries.note: H8297 derives from prince H8269; my princess is a historical grammatical interpretation, not independently proved here.

entries.name: Sardis
entries.note: G4554 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong G4554](https://biblehub.com/greek/4554.htm).

entries.name: Sardites
entries.note: An ethnic/family plural from Sered; removing a dissension is not the actual gloss in this entry.

entries.name: Sarepta
entries.note: G4558 refers to Zarephath H6886; goldsmith's shop is a contextual expansion of refinement.

entries.name: Sargon
entries.displayMeaning: foreign royal name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H5623 does not establish takes away protection. [Strong H5623](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5623.htm).

entries.name: Sarid
entries.note: Remaining agrees; hand of a prince is not established.

entries.name: Saron
entries.note: G4565 points to Sharon H8289, whose derivation is probable; name equivalence does not collapse identities.

entries.name: Sarsechim
entries.note: H8310 does not establish master of wardrobe; punctuation and identity within Jeremiah 39:3 require separate textual study. [Strong H8310](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8310.htm).

entries.name: Saruch
entries.note: Strong relates Saruch to Serug, tendril. Branch agrees; layer/lining are not the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Satan
entries.note: H7854 may denote an opponent or specifically Satan by context; distinguish ordinary-word and proper-designation uses.

entries.name: Saul
entries.note: H7586 supports asked, not ditch/death. G4549/G4569 refer to the apostle's Saul form; the king and Edomite are separate bearers. [Strong H7586](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7586.htm); [Strong G4549](https://biblehub.com/greek/4549.htm); [Strong G4569](https://biblehub.com/greek/4569.htm).

entries.name: Sceva
entries.note: Strong G4630 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: disposed; prepared. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Schaaph
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Seba
entries.note: H5434 does not establish drunkard/turns; the ancestor and country are distinct referents. [Strong H5434](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5434.htm).

entries.name: Sebat
entries.note: Strong H7627 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: twig; scepter; tribe. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Secacah
entries.note: Covering/defense broadly agrees; shadow is not separately established as the place name sense.

entries.name: Sechu
entries.note: H7906 differs from defense/bough. [Strong H7906](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7906.htm).

entries.name: Secundus
entries.note: Strong G4580 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: second. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Segub
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Seir
entries.note: H8165 supports rough, not demon/tempest. Seirath is a distinct form and location. [Strong H8165](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8165.htm).

entries.name: Sela
entries.note: Strong H5554, H5553 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a rock. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Sela-hammah-lekoth
entries.note: H5555 directly supplies this; exact input spelling has no supplied verse references.

entries.name: Selah
entries.displayMeaning: Selah in Psalms: musical pause; Selah in 2 Kings: rock-city
entries.note: H5542 is the musical notation; H5554 identifies Sela/Selah in 2 Kings 14:7. The psalm term is not the city or a person. [Strong H5542](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5542.htm); [Strong H5554](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5554.htm).

entries.name: Seled
entries.note: Strong H5540 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: affliction; warning. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Seleucia
entries.note: G4581 derives the city name from the king, not directly from waves.

entries.name: Sem
entries.note: G4590 explicitly refers to H8035; Luke 3:36 names the patriarch. [Strong H8035](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8035.htm); [Strong G4590](https://biblehub.com/greek/4590.htm).

entries.name: Semachiah
entries.note: Strong H5565 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: joined to the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Semaiah
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV occurrence supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Semei
entries.note: G4584 points to H8096 famous, based on report/hearing; obeying is not the proper-name gloss. [Strong G4584](https://biblehub.com/greek/4584.htm).

entries.name: Senaah
entries.note: Bramble broadly agrees; enemy is not established.

entries.name: Seneh
entries.note: H5573 supplies thorn; Hitchcock only redirects to Senaah, a different spelling requiring independent identification.

entries.name: Senir
entries.note: H8149 differs from bed-candle/changing. [Strong H8149](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8149.htm).

entries.name: Sennacherib
entries.note: Strong H5576 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: bramble of destruction. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Seorim
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Sephar
entries.note: H5611 points to H5610 census; book/scribe is a different root-related expansion. [Strong H5611](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5611.htm).

entries.name: Sepharad
entries.note: The snapshot's Assyrian regional attribution is historical commentary; Obadiah 20 names Sepharad without establishing that geography or a book-descending etymology.

entries.name: Sepharvaim
entries.note: 2 Kings 17:24 grounds the place; no exact candidate supplied for this spelling, so two books/scribes remains uncorroborated.

entries.name: Serah
entries.note: H8294 differs from lady of scent/song/morning star. [Strong H8294](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8294.htm).

entries.name: Seraiah
entries.note: Strong H8304 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: prince of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Seraphim
entries.note: H8314 is a creature designation, not a personal name. Input has no verse reference; distinguish Isaiah's creatures from serpent uses by context.

entries.name: Sered
entries.note: H5624 differs from dyer's vat. [Strong H5624](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5624.htm).

entries.name: Sergius
entries.note: Strong G4588 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: net. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Serug
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Seth
entries.note: Genesis 4:25 explicitly connects the name with God appointing another seed. [Strong H8352](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8352.htm); [Strong G4589](https://biblehub.com/greek/4589.htm).

entries.name: Sethur
entries.note: Hidden is supported; destroying is not established.

entries.name: Shaalabbim
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Shaalbim
entries.note: H8169 differs from beholds the heart. [Strong H8169](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8169.htm).

entries.name: Shaalbonite
entries.note: An inhabitant designation, not an independent given name or a fully established fox's-building compound.

entries.name: Shaaraim
entries.note: Gates agrees; valuation/hairs is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Shaashgaz
entries.note: H8190 does not establish presses fleece/shears sheep. [Strong H8190](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8190.htm).

entries.name: Shabbethai
entries.note: Rest is supported; the possessive my is not explicit in Strong's proposal.

entries.name: Shachia
entries.note: H7634 explicitly gives Shachia from the margin and the base name Shobjah; this is a textual-form distinction, not protection of the Lord.

entries.name: Shadrach
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign Babylonian name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H7714/H7715 identify Hananiah's imposed name (Daniel 1:7); tender/nipple is unsupported. The narrative supplies his fidelity; the name's origin does not define his allegiance. [Strong H7714](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7714.htm); [Strong H7715](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7715.htm).

entries.name: Shage
entries.note: Strong H7681 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: touching softly; multiplying much. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shalem
entries.note: Genesis 33:18 in KJV names Shalem. Supplied H8003 is the adjective complete; H8004 Salem's Jerusalem identification cannot automatically relocate this Genesis verse.

entries.name: Shalim
entries.note: H8171 Shalim/Shaalim in 1 Samuel 9:4 differs from Salim G4530; do not equate by spelling alone. [Strong H8171](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8171.htm).

entries.name: Shalisha
entries.note: Three is supported; prince/captain are not established.

entries.name: Shallum
entries.note: H7967 points to H7966; H7968 is Shallun, not an interchangeable English Shallum spelling at every reference.

entries.name: Shalmai
entries.note: H8014/H8073 cover the Shalmai/Shamlai variant. [Strong H8014](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8014.htm); [Strong H8073](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8073.htm).

entries.name: Shalman
entries.note: H8020 identifies Shalman in Hosea 10:14; the snapshot does not derive peaceable/perfect/rewarding.

entries.name: Shalmaneser
entries.note: No exact candidate supplied; Assyrian royal name in 2 Kings 17:3 should not be segmented into unsupported Hebrew meanings.

entries.name: Shamariah
entries.note: H8114 supports guarding, not throne. [Strong H8114](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8114.htm).

entries.name: Shamed
entries.note: No exact name headword or defensible alias was established in the supplied Strong snapshot. Hitchcock: destroying; wearing out. Keep this name and gloss unresolved; do not guess from a similar spelling.

entries.name: Shamer
entries.note: H8106 points to H8105; dregs agrees, keeper is a related root association rather than the selected name sense.

entries.name: Shamgar
entries.note: H8044 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H8044](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8044.htm).

entries.name: Shamhuth
entries.note: Strong H8049 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: desolation; destruction. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shamir
entries.displayMeaning: Shamir places: thorn/gem; personal form: observed
entries.note: H8069/H8068 concern the places; supplied H8053 is a personal variant and its H8103 cross-reference is anomalous. Do not give Joshua's place the person's derivation.

entries.name: Shammah
entries.note: H8048 points to H8047; multiple men bear the form. [Strong H8048](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8048.htm).

entries.name: Shammai
entries.note: The source proposes destructive rather than the possessive my desolations; its H8073 link needs separate checking because that headword is Shamlai, not an obvious source for this gloss.

entries.name: Shammoth
entries.note: No exact candidate supplied for the 1 Chronicles 11:27 personal name.

entries.name: Shammuah
entries.note: H8051's pinned digital record gives renowned but cites H8074 desolation, an apparent inconsistent root reference. 2 Samuel 5:14 directly attests Shammuah among David's sons. The original printed derivation has not been checked. [Strong H8051](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8051.htm).

entries.name: Shamsherai
entries.note: Strong H8125 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: there a singer or conqueror. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shapham
entries.note: H8223 is Shapham; Shaphan rabbit and lip/brink analyses should not be merged into it.

entries.name: Shaphat
entries.note: The pinned Strong H8202 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H8202](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8202.htm).

entries.name: Sharai
entries.note: Strong H8298 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: my lord; my prince; my song. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Sharar
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Sharezer
entries.note: H8272 does not establish overseer of treasury/storehouse; Assyrian and Israelite bearers are distinct. [Strong H8272](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8272.htm).

entries.name: Sharon
entries.note: Plain is supported; the possessive his and song are not established.

entries.name: Shashai
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shashak
entries.note: H8349 differs from bag of linen/sixth bag. [Strong H8349](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8349.htm).

entries.name: Shaul
entries.note: Asked is supported; lent and grave are not the explicit name gloss. Shaul and Saul are spelling forms, not a reason to merge the Edomite with Israel's king.

entries.name: Shaveh
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Shealtiel
entries.note: H7597/H7598 support the Hebrew/Aramaic form related to Greek Salathiel. [Strong H7597](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7597.htm); [Strong H7598](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7598.htm).

entries.name: Shear-jashub
entries.note: Strong H7610 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the remnant shall return. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Sheariah
entries.note: Tempest broadly agrees; gate is not the supplied root sense.

entries.name: Sheba
entries.displayMeaning: Sheba H7614: foreign name, uncertain meaning; Sheba H7652: seven
entries.note: The two Hebrew forms and several bearers/regions must remain separate; captivity/old man/repose/oath is not a single supported meaning. [Strong H7614](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7614.htm); [Strong H7652](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7652.htm).

entries.name: Shebam
entries.note: Strong H7643 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: compassing about; old men. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shebaniah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shebarim
entries.note: H7671 supports breakings, not hopes. [Strong H7671](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7671.htm).

entries.name: Sheber
entries.note: Breaking agrees; hope belongs to another possible Hebrew word and is not the linked headword's sense.

entries.name: Shebna
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shebuel
entries.note: H7619 explicitly offers alternatives; seat is unsupported. [Strong H7619](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7619.htm).

entries.name: Shecaniah
entries.note: Strong H7935 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: habitation of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shechem
entries.note: H7927 is the place and H7928 people; back/shoulder is related but early in the morning is not the selected name meaning.

entries.name: Shedeur
entries.note: H7707 differs from field of light/light of Almighty. [Strong H7707](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7707.htm).

entries.name: Shehariah
entries.note: Strong H7841 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: mourning or blackness of the Lord. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shelah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shelemiah
entries.note: H8018 differs from God is my perfection/happiness/peace. [Strong H8018](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8018.htm).

entries.name: Sheleph
entries.note: Strong H8026 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: who draws out. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shelesh
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shelomi
entries.note: H8015 supports peace, not the full set of happiness/recompense; Shelomith is a distinct feminine name. [Strong H8015](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8015.htm).

entries.name: Shelumiel
entries.note: Strong gives Shelumiel its own peace-of-God compound; Hitchcock's equation with Shelemiah must not imply the same Hebrew form or same individual.

entries.name: Shem
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Shema
entries.note: H8087/H8090 relate to H8088; obeying is not its direct name gloss. Several people and a place share the form. [Strong H8087](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8087.htm); [Strong H8090](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8090.htm).

entries.name: Shemaiah
entries.note: Strong makes Jah the hearing subject, whereas Hitchcock makes the bearer hear/obey the Lord; preserve that grammatical difference.

entries.name: Shemariah
entries.note: Guard agrees; Strong supplies Jah as subject rather than my God is guard.

entries.name: Shemeber
entries.note: H8038 differs from force/strong. [Strong H8038](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8038.htm).

entries.name: Shemer
entries.note: Strong relates the name to preserved wine settlings, not directly guardian/thorn. 1 Kings 16:24's landowner Shemer requires his own identity.

entries.name: Shemida
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Sheminith
entries.note: H8067 describes a musical term in 1 Chronicles 15:21, not a person/place. [Strong H8067](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8067.htm).

entries.name: Shemiramoth
entries.note: Strong H8070 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: the height of the heavens. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shemuel
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shen
entries.note: H8129 selects the rock/crag place-name sense of H8127 tooth; ivory/change is unsupported here. [Strong H8129](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8129.htm).

entries.name: Shenazar
entries.note: H8137 identifies Shenatstsar but prints Senazar in its KJV field; 1 Chronicles 3:18 has Shenazar. Treasurer of a tooth is unestablished.

entries.name: Shenir
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shephatiah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H8203 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H8203](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8203.htm).

entries.name: Shephi
entries.note: Strong H8195 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: beholder; honeycomb; garment. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shepho
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shephuphan
entries.note: The pinned Strong H8197 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H8197](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8197.htm).

entries.name: Sherah
entries.note: Relationship agrees; flesh is a related root association rather than the direct gloss.

entries.name: Sherebiah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Sheshach
entries.note: H8347 does not establish bag of flax/linen; Jeremiah 51:41 directly associates the designation with Babylon. [Strong H8347](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8347.htm).

entries.name: Sheshai
entries.note: Strong tentatively relates Sheshai to Shashai (whitish), not six/mercy/flax.

entries.name: Sheshan
entries.note: H8348 only tentatively relates the name to lily; rose/joy/flax are not separately established.

entries.name: Sheshbazzar
entries.note: H8339/H8340 identify Sheshbazzar with Zerubbabel, but that identity is the source's interpretation and is not expressly stated in the KJV. Joy/vintage is unestablished. [Strong H8339](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8339.htm); [Strong H8340](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8340.htm).

entries.name: Shethar
entries.note: Strong H8369 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: putrefied; searching. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Shethar-boznai
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Sheva
entries.note: H7724/H7864 support a false/vanity association, not elevation/fame/tumult; the men in the supplied verses are distinct. [Strong H7724](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7724.htm); [Strong H7864](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7864.htm).

entries.name: Shibboleth
entries.note: Judges 12:6 uses Shibboleth as a pronunciation test word, not a personal/place name. Sibboleth is the pronunciation variant, not a second person's name.

entries.name: Shibmah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shicron
entries.note: H7942 supports drunkenness, not gift/wages; this lexical proposal does not prove anything about the settlement's inhabitants. [Strong H7942](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7942.htm).

entries.name: Shiggaion
entries.note: A technical term in Psalm 7's title (and related Habakkuk 3:1 form), not a proper name; trouble/comfort are not the explicit lexical gloss.

entries.name: Shihon
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shihor-libnah
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference for Shihor-libnah; H7884 spells Shihor-libnath and gives darkish whiteness. Do not silently equate the two forms.

entries.name: Shilhi
entries.note: Weapon/armor broadly corresponds to armed; bough is not the explicit personal-name gloss. Shilhim is a different form and needs separate review.

entries.name: Shillem
entries.note: H8006 points to H8005; retribution agrees, peace/perfection is not separately selected.

entries.name: Shiloah
entries.note: H7975 records Shiloah and the Siloah form; the cross-reference is supported, without changing the spelling in Isaiah 8:6. [Strong H7975](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7975.htm).

entries.name: Shiloh
entries.note: Genesis 49:10's Shiloh (H7886) is treated by this dictionary as a Messianic epithet, distinct from the place H7887 (Joshua 18:1). Sent is a competing etymology; do not collapse the prophetic referent into the town.

entries.name: Shiloh (name of a city)
entries.note: H7887 is the place, related to H7886 tranquil; distinguish it from the Genesis 49:10 designation. No verse references supplied for this parenthetical input label.

entries.name: Shilom
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference or exact Strong entry for Shilom; do not silently substitute Shiloh or Shallum.

entries.name: Shilshah
entries.note: Three is supported; chief/captain are not established.

entries.name: Shimeah
entries.note: H8093/H8096 are distinct forms/people sharing an English spelling; Shimeath is not automatically the same name, perdition is not the selected meaning.

entries.name: Shimei
entries.note: H8096 gives famous; H8092 is a related form. Hearing is a root association, not evidence every Shimei is one man or obeys. [Strong H8092](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8092.htm); [Strong H8096](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8096.htm).

entries.name: Shimeon
entries.note: Ezra 10:31 prints Shimeon, related to the Simeon name; the headword's patriarch identity is not a claim that Ezra's bearer is Jacob's son.

entries.name: Shimma
entries.note: Shimma is a spelling cross-reference to Shimeah; the supplied candidate index is empty, so canonical matching remains incomplete.

entries.name: Shimon
entries.note: H7889 differs from providing well/fatness/oil. [Strong H7889](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7889.htm).

entries.name: Shimrath
entries.note: Strong H8119 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: hearing; obedient. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shimri
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shimrith
entries.note: H8116 gives a feminine guard formation; Shimron is a separate name and the bare cross-reference to Shimri obscures that distinction. [Strong H8116](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8116.htm).

entries.name: Shimshai
entries.note: The distinction between sun and son matters: Strong gives sunny, not my son.

entries.name: Shinab
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shinar
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign region-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H8152 does not establish watch of him that sleeps. [Strong H8152](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8152.htm).

entries.name: Shiphi
entries.note: Strong H8230 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: multitude. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shiphrah
entries.note: H8236 points to H8235; handsome broadly agrees, trumpet is unsupported.

entries.name: Shisha
entries.note: H7894 gives whiteness from the marble word H7893; pleasant is unsupported. [Strong H7894](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7894.htm).

entries.name: Shishak
entries.note: Strong H7895 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: present of the bag; of the pot; of the thigh. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Shitrai
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shittim
entries.note: H7851 selects the acacia-tree sense; thorns is imprecise as a name gloss. [Strong H7851](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7851.htm).

entries.name: Shiza
entries.note: Strong H7877 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: this gift. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Shoa
entries.note: H7772 describes a people designation, not a group literally named tyrants.

entries.name: Shobab
entries.note: H7727 differs from returned/spark. It names distinct men and is not a moral judgment derived from their names. [Strong H7727](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7727.htm).

entries.name: Shobach
entries.note: Strong H7731, H7730 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: your bonds; your chains. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Shobai
entries.note: H7630 points to Shobi H7629; turning captivity is not the selected grammatical construction.

entries.name: Shobal
entries.note: H7732 differs from path/ear of corn. [Strong H7732](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7732.htm).

entries.name: Shobek
entries.note: Forsaken is related but changes the grammatical voice; made void is not established.

entries.name: Shochoh
entries.note: H7755 derives from H7753 hedge/shut in; defense broadly agrees, bough is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Shoham
entries.note: H7719 points to H7718 gem, not keeping back; the man's name need not identify a mineral species conclusively. [Strong H7719](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7719.htm).

entries.name: Shomer
entries.note: Keeper is supported; dregs is not the explicit gloss for this name.

entries.name: Shophach
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Shophan
entries.note: Numbers 32:35 has Atroth, Shophan; H5855 treats the compound Atroth-Shophan. Hid is supported; rabbit is not the selected name gloss. [Strong H5855](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5855.htm).

entries.name: Shoshannim
entries.note: A musical heading in Psalm 45/69 and related titles, not a personal name. Strong supplies lily/trumpet senses, not those that shall be changed.

entries.name: Shua
entries.displayMeaning: Shua man: cry/riches; Shua woman: wealth
entries.note: H7770/H7774 are separate forms and people; do not merge Canaanite Shua with the Israelitess. H7769 has cry/riches, not a complete proof of saving.

entries.name: Shuah
entries.displayMeaning: Shuah: dell or ditch; Canaanite Shuah: cry/riches-related
entries.note: H7744/H7746 are dell/chasm forms; H7770 points to H7769 cry/riches for the Canaanite in Genesis 38. Different bearers and Hebrew words require separate senses; swimming is unsupported. [Strong H7744](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7744.htm); [Strong H7746](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7746.htm); [Strong H7770](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7770.htm).

entries.name: Shual
entries.note: Fox is supported; path and first are not established. Distinguish the man and district.

entries.name: Shubael
entries.note: H7619 explicitly offers alternative roots; seat of God is not corroborated.

entries.name: Shuham
entries.note: H7748 supports humiliation, not talking/thinking/budding. [Strong H7748](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7748.htm).

entries.name: Shulamite
entries.note: Song of Solomon 6:13 uses an epithet. The snapshot's Solomon's queen label is interpretive identification, not an explicit personal name or relationship proved by that verse.

entries.name: Shunem
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Shuni
entries.note: H7764 supports rest, not changed. [Strong H7764](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7764.htm).

entries.name: Shuphim
entries.note: H8206 gives Shuppim, which the input supplies as an alternative to Shuphim; 1 Chronicles 7:12 names Shuppim. Wearing out/shore is not established.

entries.name: Shur
entries.note: H7793 points to H7791; ox/beholder are not separate selected place-name meanings.

entries.name: Shushan
entries.note: H7800 points to H7799 lily; rose/joy are expansions rather than its selected name gloss. [Strong H7800](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7800.htm).

entries.name: Shuthelah
entries.note: Strong H7803 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: plant; verdure; moist; pot. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Sia
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Sibbechai
entries.note: H5444 supports vegetation association, not cottage/springs. [Strong H5444](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5444.htm).

entries.name: Sibmah
entries.note: Strong H7643 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: conversion; captivity. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Sichem
entries.note: Sichem is the Genesis place spelling corresponding to Shechem H7927, with base H7926.

entries.name: Siddim
entries.note: H7708 differs from explicitly tilled field. [Strong H7708](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7708.htm).

entries.name: Sidon
entries.note: Fishing is supported; hunting/venison should not override Strong's specific fishery sense. Genealogical Sidon and the city require distinct identities.

entries.name: Sigionoth
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for Sigionoth; do not treat a Psalm/Habakkuk heading variant as a person.

entries.name: Sihon
entries.note: H5511 differs from rooting out/conclusion. [Strong H5511](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5511.htm).

entries.name: Sihor
entries.note: Black/dark agrees; trouble is not established. Identification with the whole Nile is historical/geographical interpretation beyond the name's lexical sense.

entries.name: Silas
entries.note: G4609 shortens G4610, not three/third.

entries.name: Silla
entries.note: H5538 supplies a raised-earth association compatible with exalting as a root-related proposal. [Strong H5538](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5538.htm).

entries.name: Siloa
entries.note: G4611 links Siloam to Shiloah H7975 (rill). John 9:7 explicitly interprets Siloam as Sent, which governs biblical presentation. Siloa/Siloe are variant labels; same as Shilhi does not establish the same etymology or entity.

entries.name: Silvanus
entries.note: G4610 supports a woodland association; who loves the forest adds a verb not supplied by the entry.

entries.name: Simeon
entries.note: Genesis 29:33 supplies the LORD-heard explanation for Jacob's son; G4826 covers different later bearers. [Strong H8095](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8095.htm); [Strong G4826](https://biblehub.com/greek/4826.htm).

entries.name: Simon
entries.note: Strong relates Simon/Symeon to Simeon, hearing; obeys is a related interpretation rather than the direct gloss. Many people share the name.

entries.name: Sin
entries.note: Geographical Sin is not the English moral noun sin.

entries.name: Sinai
entries.note: H5514 explicitly marks derivation uncertain; bush/enmity is unestablished. [Strong H5514](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5514.htm).

entries.name: Sinim
entries.note: Strong gives an otherwise unknown name, not a south-country derivation or certain modern identification.

entries.name: Sinon
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV occurrence supplied; spelling requires review.

entries.name: Sion
entries.displayMeaning: Hermon summit: peak; Jerusalem Sion: Zion
entries.note: H7865 identifies the Hermon summit in Deuteronomy 4:48; G4622 derives the Jerusalem form from H6726 Zion. Noise/tumult cannot be applied to both. [Strong H7865](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/7865.htm); [Strong G4622](https://biblehub.com/greek/4622.htm).

entries.name: Sippai
entries.note: Strong supports a basin association, not silver as a lexical element; 1 Chronicles 20:4 identifies the Philistine.

entries.name: Sisamai
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Sisera
entries.note: H5516 explicitly marks derivation uncertain; the judge-era opponent and later Nethinim family are distinct bearers. [Strong H5516](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5516.htm).

entries.name: Sitnah
entries.note: Genesis 26:21 explains the well through striving; hatred is a broad related gloss, not the exact headword sense.

entries.name: Sivan
entries.note: Month name, not a personal name.

entries.name: Smyrna
entries.note: G4667 points to G4666. [Strong G4667](https://biblehub.com/greek/4667.htm).

entries.name: So
entries.note: 2 Kings 17:4 names So king of Egypt; do not match the common English word so or infer a grain measure.

entries.name: Socoh
entries.note: H7755/H7753 supplies fencing, not the Succoth tents derivation.

entries.name: Sodi
entries.note: H5476 derives from counsel/secret, but my secret is a different grammatical interpretation. [Strong H5476](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5476.htm).

entries.name: Sodom
entries.note: Strong proposes an unused scorch root; its volcanic/bituminous parenthesis is historical explanation, not a geological assertion in Genesis.

entries.name: Solomon
entries.note: Peaceable agrees; perfect/recompense is not independently supplied as the selected personal-name meaning.

entries.name: Sopater
entries.note: G4986 differs from defends the father; Sosipater is a related but distinct form, not automatically the same bearer. [Strong G4986](https://biblehub.com/greek/4986.htm).

entries.name: Sophereth
entries.note: Strong H5618 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: scribe, numbering. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Sorek
entries.note: Vine agrees; hissing/yellow are not separate supplied place-name meanings.

entries.name: Sosthenes
entries.note: G4988 differs from a simple savior/strong gloss; Acts 18:17 and 1 Corinthians 1:1 require contextual identity assessment. [Strong G4988](https://biblehub.com/greek/4988.htm).

entries.name: Sotai
entries.note: Strong H5479 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: conclusion in pleading; binding. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Spain
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Stachys
entries.note: G4720 points to G4719. [Strong G4720](https://biblehub.com/greek/4720.htm).

entries.name: Stephanas
entries.note: Strong G4734 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: crown; crowned. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Stephen
entries.note: G4736 points to G4735 crown; Hitchcock provides only a cross-reference to Stephanas. The people remain distinct.

entries.name: Suah
entries.note: H5477 differs from speaking/entreating/ditch. [Strong H5477](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5477.htm).

entries.name: Succoth
entries.note: Genesis 33:17 explicitly explains the booths name; other Egyptian/Palestinian occurrences need separate place identities.

entries.name: Succoth-benoth
entries.note: Literal compound broadly agrees; H5524's brothel interpretation is historical commentary and does not prove prostitutes as the only lexical translation.

entries.name: Sud
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established in the KJV set
entries.note: No supplied reference or exact Strong identification for Sud; do not import a non-KJV bearer or river.

entries.name: Sur
entries.note: Strong H5495, H5494 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that withdraws or departs; rebellion. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Susanna
entries.note: Lily agrees with G4677; rose/joy are not independently supplied.

entries.name: Susi
entries.note: H5485 supports horse, not swallow/moth. [Strong H5485](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/5485.htm).

entries.name: Sychar
entries.note: Strong relates Sychar to the Hebrew strong-drink word; end is unestablished. This proposal does not characterize the inhabitants or establish the city's identity with another town.

entries.name: Syene
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Syntyche
entries.note: G4941 gives accident in the sense of occurrence, not speaks/discourses; this is a lexical proposal, not a judgment that the Christian woman's life lacked purpose. [Strong G4941](https://biblehub.com/greek/4941.htm).

entries.name: Syracuse
entries.note: Strong G4946 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that draws violently. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Taanach
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Taanach-shilo
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference or exact entry for Taanach-shilo; do not silently normalize to Taanath-shiloh.

entries.name: Tabbath
entries.note: Strong H2888 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: good; goodness. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Tabeal
entries.note: H2870 supplies an active relation to God, not simply good God.

entries.name: Taberah
entries.note: Numbers 11:3 explicitly explains the memorial. [Strong H8404](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8404.htm).

entries.name: Tabitha
entries.note: Acts 9:36 explicitly interprets Tabitha as Dorcas; Strong gives gazelle. Clear-sighted is not an independent established meaning.

entries.name: Tabor
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Tabrimon
entries.note: H2886 digitally spells Tabrimmon; 1 Kings 15:18 supplies Tabrimon. It retains Rimmon as a deity-name, not pomegranate/navel/middle as a single established gloss. [Strong H2886](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2886.htm).

entries.name: Tadmor
entries.note: Palm is supported with uncertainty; bitterness is not established.

entries.name: Tahan
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Tahapenes
entries.displayMeaning: meaning not established for this spelling
entries.note: No supplied reference for Tahapenes; H8471 Tahapanes and its Egyptian variants are possible aliases, not confirmation of secret temptation.

entries.name: Tahath
entries.note: Strong relates both station and personal name to underneath, not fear/going down as an exact compound.

entries.name: Tahpenes
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Tahrea
entries.note: H8475 refers to H8390, which tentatively refers to H772 earth; anger/wicked contention is unestablished. [Strong H8475](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8475.htm).

entries.name: Talitha-cumi
entries.note: Mark 5:41 explicitly interprets Talitha cumi as Damsel, I say unto thee, arise. It is a spoken Aramaic phrase, not the girl's personal name.

entries.name: Talmai
entries.note: Furrow broadly agrees; suspending waters is not corroborated.

entries.name: Tamah
entries.note: H8547 explicitly marks derivation uncertain. [Strong H8547](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8547.htm).

entries.name: Tamar
entries.note: Several women and a place share the spelling; Genesis 38:6's Tamar must not be merged with David's daughter or granddaughter.

entries.name: Tammuz
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Tanach
entries.note: H8590 explicitly gives Tanach/Taanach variants but marks derivation uncertain; the alias is supported, not an etymology. [Strong H8590](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8590.htm).

entries.name: Tanhumeth
entries.note: Consolation is supported; repentance is not the explicit gloss.

entries.name: Taphath
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Tappuah
entries.note: H8599 points to H8598 apple; swelling is not its selected proper-name gloss. A man and different places share the form. [Strong H8599](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8599.htm).

entries.name: Tarah
entries.note: Strong H8646 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a hair; a wretch; one banished. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Taralah
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Tarea
entries.note: H8390 tentatively refers to H772; howling/doing evil is not established. [Strong H8390](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8390.htm).

entries.name: Tarpelites
entries.note: An ethnic collective in Ezra 4:9; Strong gives foreign derivation, not ravishers or succession of miracles.

entries.name: Tarshish
entries.note: H8659 probably relates to H8658, whose gem identity is itself tentative. People, region and ship designation require separate contexts.

entries.name: Tarsus
entries.note: G5019 differs from winged/feathered and marks its own comparison tentative. [Strong G5019](https://biblehub.com/greek/5019.htm).

entries.name: Tartak
entries.note: Strong H8662 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: chained; bound; shut up. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Tartan
entries.note: KJV 2 Kings 18:17 places Tartan among Assyrian officers; H8661 gives foreign origin without deriving general lexically.

entries.name: Tatnai
entries.note: H8674 does not establish gives/overseer of tributes. [Strong H8674](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8674.htm).

entries.name: Tebah
entries.note: Butchery/murder broadly agrees; guard/cook are not the explicit name gloss.

entries.name: Tebaliah
entries.note: Dipping/baptism is related; goodness is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Tebeth
entries.displayMeaning: probably foreign month-name; meaning not supplied
entries.note: H2887 confirms the tenth month, not goodness as an etymology. [Strong H2887](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2887.htm).

entries.name: Tehinnah
entries.note: Strong H8468, H8467 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: entreaty; a favor. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Tekel
entries.note: Aramaic inscription word, not a personal name; H8625 gives to balance.

entries.name: Tekoa
entries.note: H8620 points to H8619 trumpet; confirmed is unsupported. [Strong H8620](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8620.htm).

entries.name: Tel-melah
entries.note: Strong H8528 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: heap of salt. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Telabib
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Telah
entries.note: H8520 differs from moistening/greenness. [Strong H8520](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8520.htm).

entries.name: Telassar
entries.note: Strong H8515 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: taking away; heaping up. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Telem
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Telharsa
entries.note: H8521 differs from suspension of the plow; no supplied reference validates Telharsa as the exact KJV spelling. [Strong H8521](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8521.htm).

entries.name: Tema
entries.note: Strong H8485 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: admiration; perfection; consummation. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Teman
entries.note: H8487 points to H8486; Africa/perfect is not independently selected. People and region remain distinct.

entries.name: Terah
entries.note: H8646 explicitly marks derivation uncertain; father of Abraham and wilderness station are different referents. [Strong H8646](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8646.htm).

entries.name: Teraphim
entries.note: KJV Genesis 31:19 renders the household objects images, and Judges 17:5 prints teraphim; the plural refers to objects, not a person's name.

entries.name: Tertius
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Tertullus
entries.note: G5061 explicitly marks derivation uncertain; do not borrow third from the distinct Tertius G5060 without evidence. [Strong G5061](https://biblehub.com/greek/5061.htm).

entries.name: Tetrarch
entries.note: A governmental title (Matthew 14:1; Luke 3:1), not a personal given name; Strong supports the literal fourth-part derivation.

entries.name: Thaddeus
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Thahash
entries.note: H8477 points to H8476, whose species identification and origin are tentative; haste/silence is unsupported. [Strong H8477](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8477.htm).

entries.name: Thamah
entries.note: Strong H8547 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that blots out; that suppresses. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Tharah
entries.note: Cross-reference spelling lacks exact candidate and verse context.

entries.name: Thebez
entries.note: H8405 differs from muddy/eggs/linen. [Strong H8405](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8405.htm).

entries.name: Thelasar
entries.note: H8515 includes Telassar/Thelasar forms in the source family; 2 Kings 19:12 and Isaiah 37:12 supply the differing KJV spellings. Equivalence does not establish an etymology.

entries.name: Theophilus
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Thessalonica
entries.note: G2332 has Thessalian and victory components, without fixing victory against as the exact relation. Its pinned digital definition wrongly locates the city in Asia Minor; Acts 27:2 explicitly calls Aristarchus a Macedonian of Thessalonica. [Strong G2332](https://biblehub.com/greek/2332.htm).

entries.name: Theudas
entries.note: Strong G2333 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: flowing with water. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Thomas
entries.note: John 11:16 explicitly supplies the Didymus/Thomas equivalence; it does not identify an otherwise unnamed twin.

entries.name: Thummim
entries.note: H8550 describes the priestly objects/epithet, not a human person. Its truth symbolism is the dictionary's explanation, distinct from the KJV occurrence. [Strong H8550](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8550.htm).

entries.name: Thyatira
entries.note: Strong G2363 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: a perfume; sacrifice of labor. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Tibbath
entries.note: No exact candidate or KJV reference supplied for this spelling.

entries.name: Tiberias
entries.note: G5085 refers to G5086 Tiberius, probably related to the Tiber; good vision/navel is unsupported. Town and lake uses remain distinct. [Strong G5085](https://biblehub.com/greek/5085.htm).

entries.name: Tiberius
entries.note: Strong gives a probable relation to the river, not literally son of Tiber.

entries.name: Tibni
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Tidal
entries.note: H8413 differs from breaks the yoke/knowledge of elevation. [Strong H8413](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8413.htm).

entries.name: Tiglath-pileser
entries.note: Strong H8407 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that binds or takes away captivity. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Tikvah
entries.note: H8616 points to H8615; hope/line agrees, congregation is not independently supplied.

entries.name: Tilon
entries.note: H8436 differs from murmuring. [Strong H8436](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8436.htm).

entries.name: Timeus
entries.note: The snapshot prints Timaeus (ligature) and compares H2931, unclean, rather than establishing perfect/admirable/honorable. Mark the competing derivations unresolved; Mark 10:46 identifies Bartimaeus's father.

entries.name: Timnah
entries.displayMeaning: Timnah places: assigned portion; Timna person: restraint
entries.note: H8553/H8555 are distinct Hebrew forms sharing Timnah in KJV; forbidding fits the personal form, not every town.

entries.name: Timnath
entries.note: H8553 differs from image/figure/enumeration. [Strong H8553](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/8553.htm).

entries.name: Timnath-heres
entries.note: Strong gives portion of sun for Timnath-heres, not image of sun; the Timnath-serah variant has a distinct second element and must not be silently assigned the same reconstructed sense.

entries.name: Timon
entries.note: The compared sources broadly agree on this core lexical proposal.

entries.name: Timotheus
entries.note: G5095 supports valued of God; honor is the component noun. [Strong G5095](https://biblehub.com/greek/5095.htm).

entries.name: Tiphsah
entries.note: H8607's KJV field Tipsah is misspelt; the place in 1 Kings 4:24 is Tiphsah. Passage is supported; Passover is not established.
